  • Bring rigour to the business — reviewing sales play metrics and effectiveness with partners and Braze leadership across regions
  • Operate cross-functionally as a connector across Tech and Cloud Partnerships, Partner Marketing, and Partner Education & Enablement to ensure the agency motion is fully supported everywhere we compete

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of partnerships experience in a modern cloud technology company, G/SIs, or Agency, with a track record of increasing scope and impact
  • A proven, quantifiable history of driving sourced pipeline and influenced revenue through a mature SaaS partner program — you know what great looks like because you've built it
  • Deep fluency in the agency and marketing services ecosystem: service offering design, marketing, lead generation, and the KPIs that matter to a professional services organisation
  • Firsthand experience navigating agency and consultancy environments, with an intimate understanding of their org structures, business dynamics, and how to build a compelling business case with them
  • A demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, take on complex strategic and operational mandates, and scale a program across a large, distributed organisation
  • The gravitas and executive presence to represent Braze credibly with senior partner and internal stakeholders, paired with the grit and resilience to keep pushing when the path isn't linear
  • Willingness to travel across the globe as needed to invest in your most strategic partner relationships

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™. Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Runokulma, Keuruu, määräaikainen
description:
Haemme vammaispalveluihin Keuruulle Runokulman yksikköön sairaanhoitajaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ajalle 1.9.2026 - 1.11.2027.

Runokulma on koti 15 kehitysvammaiselle aikuiselle, jotka tarvitsevat ympärivuorokautista hoitoa, ohjausta ja huolenpitoa. Työtä tehdään suurella sydämellä osana moniammatillista tiimiä, joka tukee asukkaiden omia voimavaroja ja toimintakykyä. Tavoitteena on luoda turvallinen ja mielekäs ympäristö, jossa asukkaamme voivat elää omannäköistään ja arvokasta elämää.

Sairaanhoitajana työsi painottuu asiakaslähtöiseen hoito- ja ohjaustyöhön. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat asukkaiden terveyden ja toimintakyvyn tukeminen, lääkehoidon toteutuksen ohjaus ja seuranta sekä moniammatillinen yhteistyö asukkaiden, läheisten ja eri verkostojen kanssa. Työ sisältää myös asumispalveluohjaajan tehtäviä Runokulman arjessa. Työ on pääsääntöisesti kaksivuorotyötä. Yö- tai viikonlopputyötä voi olla vain hyvin satunnaisesti tarpeen mukaan.

Sairaanhoitajana vastaat alueellisesti Runokulman, Keuruun toimintakeskus Navikan, Multian Omakodin ja työ- ja toimintakeskuksen, Petäjäveden työ- ja toimintakeskuksen, Uuraisten Uuraspajan ja Uurastuvan sekä Äänekosken Kalevankodin ja Mintakan lääkehoitosuunnitelmista, lääkehoidon näytöistä sekä erikseen sovittavista sairaanhoitajan konsultoinneista. Alueellinen työ on ennalta sovittua ja muodostaa vain osan työajastasi. Pääasiallinen työskentelypisteesi sijaitsee Runokulmassa Keuruulla. Tehtävässä tarvitset kuitenkin auton käyttömahdollisuuden.

13 hengen tiimissämme on sekä kokeneempia konkareita että alan uusia ammattilaisia. Otamme uuden tekijän avosylin vastaan ja huolehdimme yhdessä siitä, että pääset osaksi tiivistä työyhteisöä. Työsi tukena ovat myös säännöllisesti kokoontuvat vammaispalveluiden sairaanhoitajien tiimit.

Etsimme yksikköömme reipasta työntekijää, jonka työotteessa näkyy motivaatio asiakkaiden toimintakyvyn tukemiseen sekä taito työskennellä voimavaralähtöisesti. Arvostamme tekijää, joka tunnistaa omat vahvuutensa, osaten hyödyntää niitä arjen työssä.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka 3032,90 €/kk. Tehtäväkohtaisen palkan lisäksi maksamme työkokemuslisää 5 vuodesta 3 % ja 10 vuodesta 8 %. Huomioithan myös julkisen sektorin hyvät työehdot esimerkiksi lomapäivien osalta. Lomapäivien kertymä määräytyy työkokemuksesi perusteella - mitä enemmän kokemusta, sitä enemmän ansaittuja lomapäiviä. Työsuhde-etuina tarjoamme monipuolisesti erilaisia yritysalennuksia, joita voit hyödyntää henkilöstökortilla.

Keuruu tunnetaan oppivana ja kehittyvänä yrityskaupunkina, jossa Keski-Suomen maakuntabrändin lupaus - parhaat palat löytyvät keskeltä - toteutuu aidosti. Kaupungissa toimii aktiivinen yrityskenttä ja useita elinvoimaisia kyliä, joissa yhdessä tekemisen kulttuuri on yhä vahvasti läsnä. Lue lisää: https://keuruu.fi/

*****************************

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon henkilöstä annetun lain (559/1994) edellyttämä pätevyys, laillistettu sairaanhoitaja.

Edellytämme tehtävässä tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista soveltuvuutta (vesirokko ja tuhkarokko). Influenssa- ja hinkuyskärokotuksen osalta työnantaja määrittää tarpeen. Lisäksi edellytetään ajantasaista lääkehoitosuunnitelman mukaista lääkehoidon osaamista tai sen suorittamista työsuhteen alussa.

Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n mukainen rikosrekisteriote (ikääntyneiden tai vammaisten kanssa työskentely).

Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon työ- ja virkaehtosopimuksen mukaisesti (SOTE-sopimus). Tehtävässä noudatetaan koeaikaa.

Haastattelut on alustavasti suunniteltu pidettävän viikoilla 35-36.

Lämpimästi tervetuloa työkaveriksi!

title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
description:
About Us

inforcer is one of the fastest growing technology organisations in the world and a leading provider of cutting-edge cybersecurity and AI solutions to support to the SMB market. We provide MSPs (Managed Service Providers) with the fundamental technology they need to manage and secure Microsoft 365 at scale and deliver AI services. Our mission is to be inforced in every MSP!

About the Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to design and build internal software used across the business. This role blends backend, frontend, and automation engineering, with a clear focus on internal products rather than customer‑facing features. You will work closely with teams across the organisation to turn operational challenges into scalable, reliable internal tools.

You’ll own systems end to end: from UI to APIs, data, and integrations. This is a hands‑on role for someone who enjoys shipping, iterating, and building solutions that save time, reduce errors, and improve how teams work.

What you’ll be doing

  • Designing and building internal web applications, tools, and dashboards from scratch and on top of existing systems.

  • Writing production code across the stack, including backend services, APIs, frontend interfaces, and automations.

  • Building and extending APIs, integrations, and workflows to connect internal and third‑party systems.

  • Developing internal UIs using modern frontend frameworks and collaborating closely with users to improve usability.

  • Translating manual or inefficient business processes into secure, well‑designed internal products.

  • Owning technical design decisions: data models, permissions, integrations, performance, and edge cases.

  • Iterating quickly based on internal feedback, usage data, and business priorities.

  • Partnering with non‑technical stakeholders to understand pain points and turn them into practical solutions.

  • Writing lightweight technical documentation and specs for internal systems and workflows.

  • Monitoring and maintaining the tools you ship, including debugging issues and shipping improvements quickly.

What We Can Offer You

Steep Learning curve: We believe people leave organisations when learning stops. We promise a steep and continuous learning curve to both challenge and develop our people. You are responsible for your own learning, but you’ll be surrounded by exceptional people and strong enablement, if you choose to lean into it, in an environment where it’s safe to make mistakes, try new things, and improve.

Real impact: We operate in a high-trust and autonomous environment where you can make a real impact and difference in your role and across the company.

Transparency and Honesty: We believe honest and clear communication creates a highly collaborative culture. It gives you the “why” we make decisions and allows you to effectively make your own. We won’t pull the wool over your eyes, we are a fast-growing start-up that comes with its own unique challenges, but we all work hard to solve them, together, as a team.

A+ Global Team: Our people power every part of our business, and we look for individuals who bring genuine passion to their role and operate at their very best. A-players thrive when surrounded by other A-players. Our level of growth and rate of change can be hard work and challenging, but you’ll be surrounded with exceptional people that are always happy to help.

Regular Team Socials: We celebrate our team, our milestones, promotions and achievements with social events every month.

Employee Recognition: Programs to recognise and reward our top contributors for their achievements and efforts. We live our company values every day and reward those people who embody them.

Skills We Need for This Role

  • Strong software engineering foundation with experience across backend and frontend development.

  • Hands‑on experience building web applications using technologies such as JavaScript or TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React).

  • Experience building APIs and integrations using REST, webhooks, and authentication patterns.

  • Working knowledge of backend development using technologies such as .NET, Python, or Node.js.

  • Solid understanding of databases and data modelling (SQL and/or NoSQL).

  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.

  • Comfortable building automations, scripts, or workflows to streamline internal processes.

  • Ability to take ambiguous business problems and turn them into clear, maintainable technical solutions.

  • Strong problem‑solving skills with attention to detail and reliability.

  • Confident working with non‑technical stakeholders and explaining technical trade‑offs clearly.

  • Builder mindset with a bias towards shipping, learning, and iterating.

Inforcer is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Product Owner – Transport Analytics & Reporting
location: District 2, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh, vn
description:
• As the Product Owner for our internal MS-SQL database, you will take end-to-end responsibility for our transport analytics products. You will steer the product backlog according to business value and drive the development of KPIs and standard reports.
  • Acting as the central point of contact for analytics and reporting, you will moderate requirements and communicate results effectively across various departments, IT, and management levels.
  • You will design and implement insightful dashboards and reports using Power BI Cloud, translating business needs into technical specifications and ensuring consistent, scalable data models.
  • You will spearhead the strategic transition to agentic AI within our reporting landscape, transforming static analytics into autonomous, decision-supporting agents and hence also serve as the use case owner for the “Transport Intelligence Engine”.
  • You will be responsible for writing and managing user stories for our Next Generation Transport Management (NGTM) reporting and analytics platform. This includes defining requirements for data transfer from both external and internal sources, overseeing report and dashboard development, and monitoring dataflows.
  • You will ensure data quality, transparency, and traceability, actively supporting the development of a data-driven organization within our transport and logistics landscape.
  • Education: A university degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, Computer Science, or a comparable field of study.
  • Experience and Know-how:
    • Several years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Product Management and Logistics
    • Experience in managing a project team of developers (MS-SQL, Oracle SQL, and Power BI).
    • Strong competence in defining KPIs and data-driven steering, preferably in a logistics or supply chain context.
    • Expertise with BI tools and databases, especially Power BI Cloud, MS-SQL, and Oracle SQL. A solid understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and data architecture is required.
    • Knowledge with regards to SAP and our TMS (Eurolog, BIT, etc) is a strong plus
    • Proven experience working as a Product Owner or in a similar role, ideally with a background in agile methodologies.
  • Personality and Work Style: You excel at structuring and processing complex topics independently. You are a confident communicator and moderator across different management levels. You demonstrate a high degree of initiative and strategic thinking, always keeping the common goal in sight.
  • Languages: Very good command of English, written and spoken.
  • Committed 13th month bonus
  • Collaboratively yearly performance bonus
  • Meal & Parking allowances
  • Premium insurance for employee
  • Flexible benefits
  • Domestic and international training opportunity
  • Career development program with buddy and mentoring program
  • Good benefits of company activities, team building and year end party
  • Opportunity to work in global projects of fast developing company and being a part of innovation team contributing initiative ideas to the digital transformation era

title: Product Manager
description:
The Role

We are looking for a talented Product Manager for Betsson Georgia brand who will be involved in different processes and help us deliver the best customer experience in the industry. Here we have fast-paced business environment where you will never be short of new challenges. If you want to use the latest technologies while working in a dynamic, friendly and comfortable atmosphere, Betsson Georgia could be the perfect place for you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner closely with the Sports Trading team to align product initiatives with commercial objectives and continuously optimize operational processes;
  • Own the Sportsbook product and its related services, driving continuous improvements to maximize product performance, customer engagement, and user satisfaction;
  • Manage the Sportsbook product budget, ensuring alignment with business KPIs, monitoring budget utilization, and delivering financial targets;
  • Ensure Sportsbook products and services comply with applicable regulatory and compliance requirements, minimizing legal and operational risks;
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across the organization, as well as external vendors and technology partners;
  • Monitor industry trends, market developments, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for innovation and product growth;
  • Drive the implementation of new features, enhancements, and product improvements to maintain market competitiveness;
  • Initiate and lead continuous process optimization initiatives to improve operational efficiency and product delivery;
  • Perform other product-related duties and responsibilities as assigned by the direct manager.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Technology, or a related field;
  • 3–5 years of Product Management experience, preferably within the iGaming, Sports Betting, or Gambling industry;
  • Proven experience managing products throughout the full product lifecycle, from strategy and roadmap to launch and continuous optimization;
  • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and experience using project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello);
  • Understanding of Sports Betting/iGaming market trends and relevant regulatory requirements;
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Product, Trading, Technology, Marketing, and Compliance;
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills;
  • Experience with budgeting, KPI management, and performance reporting;
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills;
  • Fluency in both Georgian and English (written and spoken).

We offer

We offer working in fast growing business with professional management teams and value driven challenging and development oriented organisational culture. Here we have non-formal, creative and comfortable environment. If you enjoy diversity and fast pace then you are right person for this position and in this case there is the right environment provided for you to fulfil your potential.

APPLY:

If you feel you have what it takes to be successful in this role, don't hesitate to apply. Since we will be interviewing candidates continuously send your application as soon as possible to be included in the recruitment process.

title: Product Design Manager
description:
Link to process walkthrough:

Thanks for stopping by and learning more about this role at Sitemate! ✨🏗️

We’d love to hear from you 👩‍💻👩🏽‍💻🧑🏿‍💻👨🏻‍💻

Brief overview of this role:

The Product Design Manager is a hybrid ownership role responsible for product outcomes end-to-end - from early concept and UX exploration through to delivery, release, and production performance.

At Sitemate, Product Design Managers combine UX/UI design expertise with product ownership and delivery management. You’ll work in small, high-trust teams alongside engineers to define problems, design solutions, shape requirements, plan delivery, and take responsibility for what ships - including how it performs once live.

Design, product, and delivery are not separate disciplines here; they are one integrated role. We believe the future of product teams - especially in an AI-accelerated world - belongs to builders who can own all three.

Employment:

  • Full-time

  • Based: Melbourne, Australia or Sydney, Australia

  • Remuneration (Including Super): AUD $60,000 - $150,000 pending your experience

About Sitemate:

Sitemate builds best-in-class software for the built world - empowering construction, infrastructure, and industrial companies to work smarter and faster.

Our flagship product, Dashpivot, helps teams move their processes from paper and spreadsheets into powerful, digital workflows that can be used in the field on mobile or tablet. This enables companies to automate repetitive tasks, track progress in real time, and make better decisions every day.

We’ve achieved strong product-market fit - generating thousands of new monthly leads through word-of-mouth and organic marketing alone.

Backed by Blackbird, Australia and New Zealand’s #1 venture capital firm, and a graduate of the Startmate Accelerator, Sitemate has grown from 5 people in 2018 to over 150 across 18+ countries. Our team blends deep industry experience with cutting-edge product design to build tools that modernise one of the world’s largest and most essential industries.

Life at Sitemate

At Sitemate, you’ll join a team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation - not as buzzwords, but as the principles we work by every day.

We move fast, communicate openly, and operate with trust and autonomy. You’ll have access to key company metrics, clear career development plans, and the opportunity to grow your career based on performance, not tenure.

We believe diverse teams build better products. Our team includes members from 18+ countries - 55% identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51.

How We Work

  • Transparency: Monthly All-Hands meetings share updates on metrics, customer stories, hiring plans, and financial performance. Every session also includes a “Life Story” from one team member - building genuine connection and understanding across our global team.

  • High Velocity: We use best-in-class, integrated systems to eliminate manual work and give you the information you need to make fast, high-quality decisions.

  • Drive: You’ll be rewarded for performance. Seven of our last ten pay increases were proactive - driven by results, not requests.

  • Autonomy: We focus on outcomes, not hours. You’ll have flexibility to manage your day, with no time monitoring or unnecessary meetings.

  • Collaboration: You’ll work closely with talented teammates across engineering, product, design, marketing, sales, and customer success - sharing ideas and learning together every day.

What We Offer

  • Competitive, performance-based remuneration

  • Equity options - own a piece of what you’re helping to build

  • 20 days paid annual leave, plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave

  • Parental leave - 16 weeks for primary and 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support)

  • Learning & Development - professional growth budget and transparent career plans

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - for confidential counseling, mental health support, and life resources

  • Laptop and home office setup budget

  • Flexible work - remote and hybrid options, plus the ability to work from anywhere for several weeks each year

  • Community & Connection - weekly catered lunches, global offsites, and “Life Story” sessions

  • Melbourne office perks - micro-roasted coffee bar, on-site parking & bike storage, wellness & mothers rooms, opposite Southern Cross station

Equal Opportunity

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities. Our team’s diversity is one of our greatest strengths, and we’re committed to ensuring an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Learn More About Sitemate

🎧 Podcasts

  • 2024: CEO Hartley Pike - on scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture

  • 2023: CMO Lance Hodgson - on accelerating your career

  • 2022: CTO Tim Bray - on building quality features that solve real customer problems

💬 Want to know what it’s like to work at Sitemate? Hear it straight from the team: People of Sitemate
⭐ Read what our customers say: G2 Crowd, Trust Radius
🎥 Team Offsites: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025

🔧 Day-to-Day

Design & Product Scoping

  • Preparing high-level concept designs for internal review and customer validation

  • Conducting customer research when required

  • Preparing detailed UX flows and high-fidelity UI designs

  • Creating information architecture (IA) diagrams

  • Defining and reviewing feature scope and acceptance criteria

Delivery & Engineering Collaboration

  • Working closely with engineers and peers to plan, prioritise, and deliver work

  • Reviewing completed engineering work

Production Ownership & Monitoring

  • Monitoring released features and reporting on usage metrics

  • Identifying and raising UX gaps, quality issues, and edge cases

  • Monitoring production support issues and triaging fixes

Collaboration & Communication

  • Maintaining regular collaboration with product/design leadership

  • Communicating clearly in writing (Slack, Confluence, Jira)

⚡ Challenges

  • Breadth of ownership - This is not a pure design or pure product management role. You will move between design, product scoping, delivery coordination, and production support within the same day. If you're looking to specialise in a single discipline, this role won't be the right fit.

  • Pace - We move very quickly. You'll need to be excited to learn fast and ship frequently, not wait for perfect conditions.

  • Owning the outcome, not just the output - You're responsible for what gets built, not just the designs you hand over. If something ships with unclear UX, missed edge cases, or bugs that trace back to insufficient scoping, that's your problem to own and fix.

  • Support and triage are part of the job - Monitoring production, triaging issues raised by customer support, and ensuring quality post-release is core to this role, not a distraction from it.

  • Strong culture and operating standards - We have a strong culture based on core values and standard operating procedures. You may need to unlearn a few things from previous experience.

✅ Who This Role is For

  • Product minded people who enjoy owning product outcomes end-to-end

  • Designers who want deeper accountability and delivery ownership

  • Product thinkers who are comfortable moving between UX, scoping, and execution

  • Individuals energised by pace and shipping

🚫 Who This Role is Not For

  • People who only want to design and are not interested in delivery or product ownership

  • Designers who prefer handing off work rather than owning outcomes through to production

  • Individuals who want clearly separated roles without cross-functional accountability

🎯 Skills & Tools

Must Have:

  • Strong ownership mindset with accountability for outcomes

  • Experience leading product delivery end-to-end (Product Owner or similar)

  • Proactive in experimenting with AI tools to drive efficiency

  • Proficient in Figma, including UI libraries and design systems

  • Strong UX/UI fundamentals with a user-centred approach

  • Experience designing web and/or mobile applications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and pragmatic trade-offs

  • Strong visual design skills and attention to detail

Nice to Have:

  • SaaS product experience

  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS

Essential Tools:

  • Figma

  • Jira

  • Confluence

  • Slack

  • Mixpanel (or other product analytics tools)

Bonus Tools:

  • Figma Make

  • Claude Code

PLEASE Note:

  • We do not use recruitment partners or services, so please save your time and don't reach out

title: Huishoudelijke hulp Houten
description:
Word jij het zonnetje in huis? Kom werken als Huishoudelijke Hulp!

Werkgebied: Houten
Contract: 2-24 uur per week, flexibele werktijden

Bij Miep Huishoudservice en Begeleiding draait alles om het creëren van een écht thuisgevoel – niet alleen voor onze cliënten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je je gewaardeerd voelt, je werk met plezier doet en altijd de steun krijgt die je nodig hebt. Flexibiliteit, persoonlijke aandacht en een fijne werksfeer staan bij ons centraal!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Huishoudelijke Hulp bij Miep Huishoudservice zorg je ervoor dat onze cliënten zich thuis blijven voelen in hun eigen woning, ook als zij zelf niet meer volledig voor het huishouden kunnen zorgen. Jouw taken bestaan uit:

  • Schoonmaken, stofzuigen en andere huishoudelijke werkzaamheden.

  • Cliënten zoveel mogelijk betrekken bij het huishouden.

  • Persoonlijke aandacht en een luisterend oor bieden.

Jij maakt elke dag het verschil! Dankzij jouw hulp blijft het huis van onze cliënten schoon en fijn, waardoor zij langer zelfstandig kunnen blijven wonen. Een sociaal en dankbaar beroep waarin jij elke dag iets moois betekent voor een ander!

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ons bepaal jij je eigen werktijden en -dagen! Extra werken in de vakantie? Geen probleem! Je krijgt een salaris volgens de cao VVT, vanaf € 15,07 bruto per uur afhankelijk van ervaring, met jaarlijkse verhogingen tot € 18,27. Daarnaast ontvang je vakantiegeld (8%) en een eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%), die je ook maandelijks kunt laten uitbetalen. Ook bouw je pensioen op en kun je gebruikmaken van een collectieve zorgverzekering. Reiskosten (zoals auto, fiets, brommer of scooter) en reistijd tussen cliënten worden vergoed.

We investeren in jouw groei met een digitaal onboardingsprogramma via de MiepApp vol e-learnings. Wil je alvast een kijkje nemen? Klik dan hier. Je krijgt een contract voor bepaalde tijd met de intentie tot een vaste aanstelling. Twee keer per jaar organiseren we een medewerkersbijeenkomst om je collega’s beter te leren kennen. Miep is een warme, betrokken werkgever die naar je luistert. Jouw werk is niet alleen belangrijk, maar maakt ook écht een verschil voor onze cliënten!

Wie ben jij?

  • Jij bent het zonnetje in huis, zorgzaam en hebt een groot inlevingsvermogen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je taken.

  • Je spreekt en begrijpt Nederlands.

  • Je bent minimaal 2 uur per week beschikbaar tussen 9:00 en 18:00 uur (ma-vr).

  • Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme en een passie voor schoonmaken zijn minstens zo belangrijk!

  • Je hebt eigen vervoer (auto, scooter of fiets) om naar cliënten te reizen.

Enthousiast geworden?

Wil jij het verschil maken en onze cliënten laten stralen? Solliciteer vandaag nog!
Stuur je CV en motivatie naar ons op en wie weet verwelkomen wij jou binnenkort als onze nieuwe collega. Na je sollicitatie laten we je zo snel mogelijk weten hoe het verder gaat. Bij indiensttreding vragen wij een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) aan.

Meer informatie

title: Water Hygiene Technician
description:
Water Hygiene Technician - Oxfordshire

This could be your opportunity to excel as a Water Hygiene Technician as well as playing a vital role in helping our business succeed.

As our company grows and develops, we are ever expanding our teams. We have a great opportunity for a dedicated Water Hygiene Technician to join our Environment & Safety division.

We are looking for someone who is motivated, dependable and committed to join our team. As a member of the Environment & Safety division it is key that you can work efficiently as part of a team as well as having the capabilities to work independently. Due to the nature of the job, travelling will be part of your day-to-day role.

The tasks you will undertake will include (but are not limited to):

  • Cold water storage tank inspections and recommending remedial works
  • Cold water storage tank cleaning and disinfections
  • Thermostatic mixing valve failsafe checks and servicing
  • Water sampling
  • Water temperature monitoring
  • Showerhead descaling

To be successful in this role, you will be able to demonstrate:

  • Experience in some, or all, of the tasks listed above, or a willingness to be trained
  • A “can do” attitude
  • A full UK driving licence and a willingness to travel

Note: Once in position, it will be a requirement of the role to obtain MOD Security Clearance.

Why SOCOTEC?

Join a thriving community of over 2,000 industry professionals who are passionate about making a real difference. At SOCOTEC UK, we're not just delivering services - we're shaping the future of testing, inspection, and certification across the nation.

What sets us apart? Our people. We've built our reputation on attracting exceptional talent like you and empowering them to deliver excellence at every turn. Our comprehensive range of TIC services means you'll have the opportunity to work on diverse, challenging projects that truly matter.

In this role, you won't just be another employee - you'll be a key player in our continued success story. Your expertise will directly contribute to our mission of building a safer, more sustainable world, while you grow your career alongside some of the industry's finest professionals.

Your Career, Your Way

Build a traditional career path or explore opportunities across multiple disciplines - all within SOCOTEC. Your choice, your direction.

Work Your Way

Local, national, or global projects. Office-based, remote, or hybrid. We offer the flexibility that empowers you to perform at your best.

Committed to Your Growth

From day one, you'll have access to comprehensive training, mentorship, and development programs. We support every step of your professional journey. #YouGrowWeGrow

Think you've got what it takes to add value to our success? We would love to hear from you and look forward to receiving your application.

Building a safer and more sustainable world is the core mission we set out to achieve at SOCOTEC, it is at the heart of everything that we do. We are committed to acting as a key player in society, investing in innovative solutions to ensure social and environmental concerns are at the forefront of all of our business operations.

title: Miljöchef – led en verksamhet som gör skillnad
description:
Vill du vara med och göra skillnad för vår hälsa och miljö? Vi söker nu en engagerad miljöchef till miljö- och byggnadsnämnden. Här har du möjlighet att förena ett tydligt och engagerat ledarskap med hög servicekänsla, förmåga att skapa struktur och effektivitet samt ett engagemang för en hållbar utveckling i Borgholms kommun.

Öland, känt för sin unika natur och höga naturvärden, är en populär destination för både deltidsboende och turister, men det kräver också vår omsorg för att bevara dess skönhet. Här finns också många större och mindre lantbruk. Det innebär en betydande mängd ärenden inom miljö- och hälsoskydd och livsmedels- och serveringstillstånd. 

Miljö- och byggavdelningen är en del av kommunledningsförvaltningen, där du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med cirka 30 kunniga och engagerade kollegor inom administrativa-, bygg- och miljöenheten. 

Borgholms kommun erbjuder högkvalitativ vård, omsorg och skola, samt all samhällsservice du behöver i en omgivning av fantastisk natur. Livet på Öland är en unik kombination av stad och landsbygd, där lugnet under vinterhalvåret skapar en vacker kontrast till den pulserande sommaren. Borgholms kommun rankas också som en av Sveriges tryggaste kommuner och många uppskattar den bekvämlighet och tillgänglighet som livet här erbjuder.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som miljöchef leder du ett team med 11 kunniga och engagerade medarbetare som arbetar med miljö- och hälsoskydd, livsmedelstillsyn och serveringstillstånd. Ditt uppdrag är att skapa förutsättningar för medarbetarna att utvecklas, ta ansvar och bedriva en rättssäker, effektiv och serviceinriktad myndighetsutövning. Genom ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap coachar och stöttar du verksamheten i tillämpningen av gällande lagstiftning och praxis samt i ett professionellt bemötande utifrån våra kärnvärden Välkomnande  Utvecklande  Tillsammans och vår vision: "Med gemensamma krafter utvecklar vi hela Borgholms kommun till något vi är stolta över, nu och i framtiden." 

Du har budget-, personal- och arbetsmiljöansvar. Du rapporterar till chefen för miljö- och byggavdelningen och ingår i avdelningens ledningsgrupp. I rollen bidrar du aktivt till avdelningens utveckling och arbetar tillsammans med övriga chefer för att skapa en välfungerande och hållbar verksamhet. 

Rollen ställer krav på ett självständigt arbetssätt, god initiativförmåga och förmåga att fatta beslut. Samtidigt präglas uppdraget av nära dialog och samverkan med medarbetare, kollegor inom avdelningen och övriga delar av kommunledningsförvaltningen.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Krav: 

Vi söker dig som har:

	• dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda medarbetare med personal-, arbetsmiljö- och verksamhetsansvar
	• erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom miljö- och byggnadsnämndens ansvarsområde eller annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdigt
	• god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift
	• goda kunskaper i engelska
	• goda IT-kunskaper

Meriterande: 

Det är meriterande om du har:

	• erfarenhet av kommunal verksamhet
	• kunskap om lagstiftning som styr verksamheten, exempelvis förvaltningslagen, offentlighets- och sekretesslagen, miljöbalken, livsmedelslagen och alkohollagen
	• erfarenhet av arbete i ärendehanteringssystem
	• erfarenhet av att leda utvecklings- eller förändringsarbete

Personliga egenskaper:

Vi söker en trygg, tydlig och närvarande ledare som skapar engagemang, delaktighet och goda förutsättningar för sina medarbetare att lyckas. Du har ett coachande förhållningssätt samtidigt som du kan fatta beslut, prioritera och skapa struktur när det behövs.

Du är lösningsorienterad, ansvarstagande och har en god förmåga att planera, organisera och driva arbetet framåt. Du har lätt för att samarbeta, bygger förtroendefulla relationer och bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat.

Du har ett starkt servicefokus och ser värdet av en rättssäker och professionell myndighetsutövning med ett gott bemötande gentemot invånare, företag och andra aktörer.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper!

Löneform: Månadslön.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: Tillträde snarast, enligt överenskommelse. .
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Vi använder e-rekrytering för att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsarbetet. Fyll därför i dina uppgifter så omsorgsfullt som möjligt för att ge en rättvisande bild av dig själv. Uppgifterna behandlas och sparas enligt personuppgiftslagen.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

title: Notion Expert (Project-Based)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Notion Expert (Project-Based) based in Italy.

This project-based opportunity is ideal for a Notion specialist who enjoys designing efficient digital workspaces and transforming complex workflows into intuitive systems. You will work directly with stakeholders to optimize collaboration, improve productivity, and create scalable knowledge management solutions. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on implementation, allowing you to build customized workspaces tailored to business needs. You will have the autonomy to recommend improvements, implement best practices, and deliver user-friendly solutions that support long-term growth. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in remote environments and enjoys helping teams work smarter through well-designed systems.

Accountabilities:

The Notion Expert will design, build, and optimize customized Notion environments that improve operational efficiency and collaboration across the organization.

  • Assess existing workflows, documentation, and productivity tools to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Design and implement customized Notion workspaces tailored to business requirements.
  • Create databases, templates, dashboards, project trackers, content calendars, CRMs, knowledge bases, and task management systems.
  • Develop scalable workflows that improve organization, collaboration, and information accessibility.
  • Configure advanced Notion features, including formulas, relations, rollups, and permissions.
  • Deliver documentation and provide walkthroughs or training sessions to ensure successful adoption.
  • Recommend best practices, future enhancements, and opportunities for automation to maximize long-term value.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has extensive experience building sophisticated Notion workspaces, strong organizational skills, and the ability to translate business processes into effective digital systems.

    • Proven experience designing and managing advanced Notion workspaces, supported by a portfolio or project examples.
    • Strong understanding of workflow optimization and productivity system design.
    • Experience creating custom databases, dashboards, templates, and knowledge management solutions.
    • Proficiency with Notion features including formulas, relations, rollups, and permission management.
    • Ability to work independently while managing client communication and project delivery.
    • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

      • Nice-to-have qualifications:

      • Experience using the Notion API.
      • Familiarity with automation platforms such as Make, Zapier, or similar tools.
      • Experience integrating Notion with other business applications and productivity platforms.

        • Benefits:

        • Fully remote project-based opportunity.
        • Flexible work environment with autonomy over project execution.
        • Opportunity to collaborate directly with clients and influence workflow design.
        • Exposure to a variety of business processes and productivity challenges.
        • Opportunity to showcase expertise in system design and digital collaboration.
        • Flexible engagement suitable for experienced independent professionals.

title: Redovisningsekonom till energibranschen
description:
Är du en analytisk och noggrann redovisningsekonom som trivs i en verksamhetsnära roll? Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med månadsbokslut, lageravstämningar och ekonomisk uppföljning inom energihandel. Här får du ett kvalificerat heltidsuppdrag med många kontaktytor och möjlighet att bidra i både löpande ekonomiarbete och verksamhetens IT-projekt.

Om uppdraget Du får en central roll i arbetet med att säkerställa korrekta ekonomiska underlag och bokföringssiffror. Uppdraget innebär nära samarbete med ekonomi, energihandel och andra berörda delar av verksamheten.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

  • genomföra kontoavstämningar och utreda differenser mellan konton

  • uppdatera inventeringsfiler samt kontrollera och analysera lagerdifferenser

  • samarbeta med berörda parter inom bolaget vid utredningar

  • säkerställa korrekt kontering av fakturor

  • uppdatera bokföringsjournaler till Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

  • delta i avstämningsmöten och kvalitetssäkra siffror inför bokföring

  • genomföra rimlighetskontroller av månadssiffror för ekonomi

  • uppdatera exponeringsmodellen med förbrukning och lagersaldo

  • ge löpande stöd vid utredning av lagerdifferenser och tolkning av månadsinventering i IFS

  • stödja Energihandels IT-projekt

  • bistå med underlag och information till revisorer vid behov

Vi söker dig som har

  • goda kunskaper inom redovisning

  • mycket goda kunskaper i Excel

  • god vana av affärssystem, exempelvis IFS

  • en stark analytisk förmåga

  • förmåga att kommunicera och samarbeta med flera delar av verksamheten

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från energibranschen.

title: [PUBG Franchise] Art Director (10년 이상)
description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • PUBG IP를 기반으로 신작 및 transmedia 확장 프로젝트의 비주얼 방향성을 수립하고, IP 전반의 visual foundation을 체계화하며, 내부 및 외부 제작을 전략적으로 리딩하는 조직입니다.
  • 단순 제작 조직이 아니라, IP Visual Core 및 세계관 고도화 / Franchise 확장을 위한 장기적 visual system 구축 / 외부 파트너 및 스튜디오 협업 관리 / 병렬 프로젝트 대응 및 QC 체계 확립을 담당하는 전략 실행 조직입니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

PUBG IP Universe의 core visual foundation 및 세계관 고도화를 리딩하며, 동시에 외부 제작 및 병렬 프로젝트 대응을 매니징합니다. 비주얼 기준을 정의하고 문서화하며, 내외부 제작 파트너가 동일한 방향성과 품질 기준으로 실행할 수 있도록 alignment와 QC 체계를 구축하고 운영합니다. 본 포지션은 최종 Art Director의 방향성과 승인 하에 운영되며, IP 기준 생산과 외부 실행 운영 기능을 분담하여 프로젝트 속도와 일관성을 강화합니다.

  • PUBG IP Universe의 core visual boundaries 정의 및 Visual Foundation 고도화
  • IP 확장 프로젝트를 고려한 visual consistency framework 구축 및 중장기 운영 시스템 설계
  • IP Visual 및 가이드 문서의 구조화, 유지보수 체계 수립, 내부 공유 및 적용
  • 외부 스튜디오 및 개인 아티스트 협업 매니징 (본 포지션은 비주얼 기준/프레임워크의 전문적 정의 및 설계와 주요 마일스톤 최종 비주얼 판단을 담당)
  • 병렬 프로젝트 대응을 위한 리뷰 cadence, milestone gate, acceptance criteria 운영 및 리스크 관리
  • Visual drift, rework, 일정 지연, 품질 편차를 조기에 감지하고 대응안을 제시
  • 최종 AD 및 결정권에게 의사결정에 필요한 옵션과 근거를 정리하여 보고하고, 승인 후 실행을 리딩

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 해외 출장 결격사유가 없는 분
  • AAA 또는 동급 규모 프로젝트에서 아트 퀄리티 바를 리딩한 경험 또는 동급 역할을 수행한 경험
  • 스타일 가이드, 기준 문서, 레퍼런스 시스템 등 비주얼 기준을 정의하고 운영한 경험
  • 외부 파트너(스튜디오, 프리랜서)와의 협업에서 브리핑, 피드백, QC를 리딩한 경험
  • 높은 수준의 비주얼 의도를 언어로 구조화해 설명하고 팀을 정렬시킬 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 역량
  • 콘센트/3D 아트 8년이상 / AD 경력 2년 이상
  • 라이팅에 대한 강한 이해 및 리뷰 경력

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 글로벌 스튜디오 협업 경험
  • 영어 커뮤니케이션 능숙
  • IP 확장 또는 다프로젝트 병렬 운영 경험
  • 팀 리딩 및 멘토링 경험
  • 라이팅 작업 경험(직접 제작 또는 시네마틱/게임 룩 개발 경험)

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > *직무 테스트 (Pre-Test) > 직무 면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합 면접 (Culture Fit Interview) > 학/경력, 평판조회 > 처우협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사

title: Regional Data Centre Director
description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Regional Data Centre Director – Southeast Asia, reporting directly to the Senior Director, DC Operations you will work closely with the Operations team, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Oversees all aspects of data centre operations including the operation, maintenance and repair of all mission critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 data centre operation to achieve 100% uptime and compliance with customer SLAs.
  • Provides support and technical advice to the Data Centre Operations Directors and site teams in all aspects of their roles to ensure efficient and successful data centre operations.

Your Day to Day:

  • Reports and documents operational strategy improvements to ensure the highest level of availability and operational efficiency is achieved for the portfolio.
  • Acts as a key escalation contact, both internally and externally, for emergency events impacting data centre services including technical, operational and security.
  • Provides support to the Data Centre Directors and site teams to facilitate emergency responses procedures, resource coordination, customer communication, root cause analysis and post event remediation.
  • Develop strong relationships with customer operational management contacts.
  • Provides support to drive thorough root cause analysis and produce detailed reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • In conjunction with Data Centre Directors and site teams responsible for contractual compliance, including SLA management, for 3rd party vendors including; FM Services, Smart Hands & Security vendors as well as any other 3rd party vendors (including soft services) engaged directly by AirTrunk.
  • Responsible for managing internal audits of standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to guarantee compliance with AirTrunk and industry standards.
  • Oversees the local change management processes and other documentation required by law, e.g. SWMS, including review and approval of Method of Procedures (MOPs) to support the Facilities Managers.
  • Ensures adherence to security programs across the data centre portfolio. • In conjunction with Data Centre Directors and site teams responsible for ensuring the operating standards of the data centre supports various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, ISO 27001, SOC1, SOC 2 etc. as may be required by AirTrunk.
  • Oversees data centre operations to maintain compliance with local regulatory requirements including environmental, building, fire, electrical, hydraulic, occupational health & safety.
  • Supports the Operations Directors with OPEX/CAPEX budgeting, forecasting and reporting requirements.
  • Ensures data centre budgets stay within financial targets.
  • Ensures adherence to financial control procedures for the data centres.
  • Presents improvements that generate operational and financial efficiencies, including the development and presentation of the business case, to the wider Management team.
  • Prepares reporting of operational metrics, data and risks for Management oversight and control for both day-to-day reporting and long-term trend analysis.
  • Support the Global Head of Operations for the overall strategic planning, long term goals and management responsibilities of the Operations Team.
  • This role is the direct line manager for the Operations Directors and is responsible for ensuring optimum data centre performance across the portfolio.

Requirements

  • 7years or more experience in a critical facilities environment is a must.
  • 3years or more experience directly managing employees.
  • Procurement and contract negotiation experience.
  • Electrical or mechanical trade background not essential but highly desirable.
  • Leadership & Communication Skills – Ability to comprehend, analyse and interpret complex operational documents.
  • Ability to establish and review Method of Procedure documents, incident reports, emergency event summaries, root cause analysis reports, CAPEX/OPEX budget forecasts/reports and O&M manuals.
  • Ability to deliver effective presentations on data centre operations to customers, peers and management.
  • Ability to effectively respond to sensitive issues, complex inquiries or complaints from customers, peers and management.
  • Ability to manage with positive influence and motivate employees and customers to obtain desired levels of performance.

title: Vastgoedexpert Plaatsbeschrijvingen
description:
Bij IFIRMA bouwen we elke dag aan een slimmere vastgoedwereld. Als betrouwbare partner van vastgoedprofessionals bieden we een alles-in-één service: van plaatsbeschrijvingen en keuringen tot fotografie, video, energieverslagen en meer. Onze missie? De vastgoedprofessional ontzorgen, zodat zij kunnen focussen op wat écht telt: hun klanten.

We combineren technologie, snelheid en menselijke warmte in alles wat we doen. IFIRMA is geen klassieke speler: we groeien snel, denken anders en leggen de lat bewust hoog. Met een team van geëngageerde collega’s verspreid over heel Vlaanderen, maken we van klantentevredenheid een topsport.

Bij ons werk je in een omgeving die inzet op persoonlijke groei, ownership en plezier. We geloven in transparantie, wederzijds vertrouwen en elke dag een beetje beter doen.

Klaar om impact te maken? Welkom bij IFIRMA

Ben jij nauwkeurig, communicatief sterk en heb je een passie voor vastgoed? Als Vastgoedexpert Plaatsbeschrijver bij IFIRMA stap je in een dynamische rol waarin geen enkele dag hetzelfde is. Je bezoekt uiteenlopende panden en bent hét visitekaartje van ons bedrijf bij vastgoedprofessionals, eigenaars en huurders. In deze functie vorm je de cruciale schakel tussen de vastgoedpraktijk en een vlekkeloze administratieve afhandeling, waarmee je direct bijdraagt aan de hoge kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Expertise op locatie
    • Je bezoekt zelfstandig diverse residentiële en commerciële panden om de exacte staat ervan vast te leggen.
    • Je analyseert en inspecteert elke ruimte grondig, waarbij je oog hebt voor de kleinste details en eventuele gebreken.
    • Je communiceert op een professionele en empathische manier met de aanwezige klanten en partners op locatie.
  • Rapportering & Kwaliteit
    • Je vertaalt jouw bevindingen ter plaatse naar een helder, objectief en uiterst gedetailleerd verslag.
    • Je verwerkt de verzamelde data en foto's efficiënt in onze digitale systemen, zodat het rapport voldoet aan de IFIRMA-kwaliteitsstandaard.
    • Je zorgt voor een snelle en accurate oplevering van de documenten, waardoor onze klanten direct verder kunnen.
  • Impact op de organisatie
    • Met jouw nauwkeurige verslagen voorkom je discussies achteraf en bied je absolute gemoedsrust aan de vastgoedprofessional en dienst klanten, wat de groei en reputatie van IFIRMA versterkt.


Vereisten

  • Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met de vastgoedsector en bent gebeten door de architectuur en opbouw van panden.
  • Je blinkt uit in klantgerichtheid en weet op elk moment een professionele en warme indruk achter te laten.
  • Je werkt uiterst punctueel, georganiseerd en beschikt over een scherp oog voor detail.
  • Je bent communicatief vaardig en kunt situaties objectief en helder verwoorden.
  • Je toont een grote mate van ownership en kunt uitstekend zelfstandig op pad gaan.
  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Heb je ook een goede basiskennis van het Frans en Engels dan is dit een sterke troef.
  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B en bent flexibel ingesteld wat betreft verplaatsingen.


Voordelen

  • Een voltijds contract van onbepaalde duur binnen een snelgroeiende en ambitieuze organisatie.
  • Een competitief en aantrekkelijk loonpakket dat past bij jouw inzet en expertise.
  • State-of-the-art werkmiddelen om jouw job vlot uit te oefenen, inclusief een MacBook, smartphone en toegang tot ons innovatieve CRM-platform.
  • Alle ruimte voor eigen initiatief, persoonlijke groei en het opnemen van ownership.
  • Een warm, dynamisch en geëngageerd team van collega's waar ook ruimte is voor plezier en het vieren van succes.
Je hebt de keuze om te werken vanuit ons goed bereikbare regio-kantoor in Geel, gecombineerd met structurele mogelijkheden voor thuiswerk.


Wil jij het verschil maken met jouw expertise in de volgende groeifase van IFIRMA?
Solliciteer vandaag nog en maak meteen impact als onze nieuwe plaatsbeschrijver.

title: Lead, Environmental Health & Safety
description:
About Moniepoint MFB


Moniepoint MFB Limited (Moniepoint) is one of Nigeria’s leading digital payments and banking
providers. Serving over 4 million active businesses and 10 million personal users as of 2026,
the bank enables users to accept, process, manage, and grow their money through a full suite
of digital products.


Job Title: Lead, Environmental Health & Safety
Role Overview
The Lead, Environmental Health & Safety is responsible for implementing and managing Moniepoint's Occupational Health, Safety, Environmental & Social, Fire Safety, and Emergency Preparedness programmes
across offices, warehouses, repair centres, and branches. This is a hands-on operational role
focused on preventing workplace incidents and improving the overall working environment
through effective management of fire safety, incident response, contractor safety, environmental
impact, ergonomics, PPE, road safety, and regulatory compliance.


The role is focused on occupational and physical workplace safety and environmental
compliance for Moniepoint’s facilities and operations, and sits within the Facilities &
Administration function. The HSE Manager will work closely with Moniepoint’s ESG Officer by
implementing operational controls, and driving enterprise HSE initiatives, while the ESG Officer
retains strategy, governance and policy ownership.


Key Responsibilities
Occupational Health & Safety (OHS) Programme
● Develop, implement and continually improve the Occupational Health & Safety
Management System (OHSMS) across Moniepoint offices, warehouses, POS repair
centres and branches, in alignment with ISO 45001.
● Conduct routine HSE walk-throughs, safety audits, inspections, and Job Hazard
Analyses (JHAs) across offices, warehouses, existing sites and new branches
● Conduct hazard-specific risk assessments for POS repair centre operations (ESD,
soldering, chemical exposure from flux/solvents, hand-tool use) and warehouse
operations (manual handling, racking and storage safety, loading bay traffic).
● Maintain the OHS risk register and drive timely closure of corrective actions.
● Monthly reporting of HSE performance metrics to Executive Management.
● Operate a permit-to-work system for higher-risk contractor activity during
branch/warehouse projects and developments.
● Maintain HSE oversight for outsourced facility management providers. Conduct periodic
safety audits of contractors, subcontractors, and outsourced facility management
providers engaged on construction/renovation projects, facilities work and logistics
covering safety certifications, PPE compliance, and site conditions, and track their
corrective actions to closure.
● Develop annual HSE objectives and performance targets.
Fire Safety & Emergency Preparedness
● Maintain and coordinate implementation of the Emergency Response Plan across
offices, warehouses, repair centres, and other operational locations.
● Coordinate fire drills and ensure emergency response equipment is present, functional
and inspected on schedule at every Moniepoint location.
● Provide HSE input into Business Continuity and Operational Resilience planning.
Incident & Accident Management
● Maintain the incident and accident investigation procedure and register for physical,
facilities-related incidents at Moniepoint locations.
● Carry out root-cause investigations for workplace and facilities-related incidents and
track corrective actions to closure.
● Analyse incident/accident data for trends across Moniepoint locations and use findings
to prioritise prevention efforts rather than reacting incident-by-incident.
● Ensure serious incidents are escalated to Management and the ESG Officer in
accordance with the Incident Escalation Procedure.
● Share lessons learned from investigations with employees and relevant contractors.
PPE, Ergonomics & Facility Safety
● Ensure appropriate PPE is provided for workers at the POS Repair Centers,
warehouses, and other relevant locations.
● Set and monitor office ergonomics standards such as workstation setup, posture, and
break guidance.
● Work with the Facilities and Procurement teams to ensure new site selection and
construction/renovation criteria include fire and life-safety requirements..
● Conduct safety due diligence and a pre-operational safety audit on any new office,
warehouse or branch before handing over and opening for us, and support the ESG
Officer in conducting Environmental & Social due diligence on such sites where required.
● Work with the Security team to provide input to facility-level security risk assessments
where they intersect with physical workplace safety.
Road Safety
● Provide support to develop and implement road safety programmes for employees and
contractors undertaking work-related travel.
● Provide support to assess and mitigate delivery- and installation-specific risks for
Business Relationship Managers and field agents, including manual handling of POS
hardware and lone-working exposure at merchant premises.
OHS & Environmental Compliance, Permitting and Reporting
● Ensure compliance with applicable occupational health and safety legislation, including
the Labour Act, Factories Act, NSITF requirements, Fire Service regulations, and other
applicable workplace safety requirements.
● Maintain statutory occupational health and safety records and coordinate renewal of
applicable workplace safety permits and certifications, and statutory inspections
● Monitor and log environmental incidents and non-compliance events at Moniepoint
facilities as part of the environmental compliance programme
● Feed OHSE compliance status into the ESG risk and compliance register maintained by
the ESG Officer.
● Provide facility-level environmental data (electricity consumption, waste volumes, water
use) already collected through Facilities & Administration operations, to inform both
operational decision-making and the ESG Officer's enterprise environmental reporting.
Training and Capacity Building
● Design and deliver relevant OHS training such as first aid, firefighting, fire warden and
evacuation marshal training sufficient to cover Moniepoints locations, offices, repair
centres, and warehouses.
● Coordinate delivery of road safety and personnel safety training with the Learning and
Development, Facilities, and Security teams.

Qualifications and Requirements
● Education: Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety,
Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a related discipline.
● Experience: 4–6 years of progressive experience in an HSE/OHS role, with a proven
track record managing multi-site operations, warehouses, corporate real estate, or
financial services infrastructure.
● Certifications: Professional certification is required (e.g., NEBOSH IGC, ISO 45001
Lead Implementer/Auditor, CSP, and/or equivalent membership in a recognized safety
body).
● Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Nigerian workplace safety laws (Labour
Act OHS provisions, Factories Act); working familiarity with IFC Performance Standards
2 and 4 OHS requirements is an advantage.
● Skills: Exceptional risk assessment, root-cause analysis, Job Hazard Analysis (JHA),
fire safety and first-aid training delivery, ergonomics assessment, stakeholder
management, and data-driven reporting capabilities.
● Travel: Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Nigeria to audit and support
regional operational sites.

Why Join Moniepoint?
Join a high-impact team shaping the backbone of Africa’s fintech landscape. At Moniepoint, we
value innovation, ownership, and results. You’ll have the opportunity to grow professionally while
contributing to a mission that empowers businesses and communities.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Ready to revolutionize the energy sector? Join Reactive Technologies and drive safer, smarter, and more sustainable energy solutions.

Reactive Technologies is a leader in accurate grid measurement tools and the company’s mission is to streamline and accelerate the energy sector’s transition to zero-carbon energy.

The company is continuing to expand its services globally across multiple regions, and is therefore looking for an experienced Senior Frontend Developer to strengthen the development team of 10 professionals in Oulu, Finland.

What will you be doing?

As a Senior Frontend Developer, you will play a key part in designing and developing intuitive, scalable and user-friendly cloud-based services that deliver real value to the client professionals operating critical power infrastructure. You will take ownership of the entire UI/UX domain, working closely with stakeholders and designers to create seamless user experiences. The role covers the entire frontend development lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to testing, deployment, and maintenance of production-ready applications. The product’s frontend is built with React and TypeScript, with UI test automation forming part of the development process.Therefore these will be your daily technologies. You will work closely with product management, the Product Owner and the software development team.

What kind of person thrives in this role?

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership of the entire UI/UX domain, combining user experience design with hands-on frontend development to create exceptional user experiences. You combine technical expertise with a user-focused mindset and thrive in a collaborative, low-hierarchy environment where people genuinely support each other.

You are a self-driven individual with the ability to work independently and have a mindset for continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are motivated and excited by building products with real-world impact and want to contribute to accelerating the global energy transition with Reactive Technologies.

We hope you have the following:

  • Several years of professional experience developing and delivering modern frontend applications in production environments
  • Strong experience with React or a comparable modern frontend framework
  • Solid experience with TypeScript
  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture, design patterns and application lifecycle management
  • Experience with UI test automation and quality-focused development practices
  • Full professional working proficiency in English

We consider as an asset:

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Familiarity with design systems, component libraries, accessibility and frontend performance optimization
  • Experience mentoring developers or leading frontend initiatives
  • Working proficiency in Finnish

What Reactive Technologies can offer you:

  • A role in a growing company using cutting-edge technology to enable the global renewable energy transition
  • A role where your skills and insight are truly appreciated
  • Opportunities for professional growth and to develop your skills
  • A motivated and dynamic work community with a flat and agile structure
  • Private healthcare and extensive health insurance coverage
  • Lunch, sports and culture benefit plus extra holidays according to your service years
  • Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and share option scheme

Practicalities:

This is a full-time and permanent position and you will be employed directly by Reactive Technologies Finland Oy. The preferred start date is in September or October 2026. The company’s office is located in Oulu, and ideally you could work from there (hybrid). Please note that we expect you to already have a valid work permit in Finland.

Ready to join Reactive Technologies’ mission?

Please submit your CV and motivation letter (PDF, in English) by 18.8.2026 at the latest via aTalent’s application system.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email.

We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Reactive Technologies here: and you can read more about the company’s newest funding round (in Finnish) here: GreenTech-yhtiö Reactive Technologies päättää 31,4 miljoonan dollarin rahoituskierroksen.

For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalent’s Recruitment Consultant Veera Kokko (044 783 5666, veera.kokko@atalent.fi).

title: Project Manager for new Build Data Centers
description:
The appointed NorthC Project Manager will be the liaison between the NorthC organisation and the consultancy company and contractor(s) managing the design and construction works.


The NorthC Project Manager (PM) has two main tasks:


  1. Delivery of the complete project. For this the PM works closely together with the consultants who will deliver the full detailed design of the data centre and the consultants who will manage the construction site. With a lead role for the PM, the consultants, the contractors and vendors for OFCI equipment are contracted externally. The PM will set up a structured schedule for meetings/calls with the external parties to make sure he/she is fully up to date on the progress of activities and can intervene or take action when necessary to keep the project on track. Building and maintaining relationships with other external stakeholders is also the responsibility of the PM, including the municipality, building authorities, power company, neighbours.
  2. Manage the internal stakeholders, ensure the project is being build according to the NorthC Blueprint, and prepare the project for a smooth hand over to the NorthC Operations and Facilities department in-country. The PM will organise timely reviews with NorthC specialists to check and discuss the design documentation of the project versus the NorthC blueprint.


Over the course of the project the PM will facilitate the drafting of the testing and commissioning plan to ensure the delivery of a flawless operation of the data centre according to the design. The testing and commissioning activities also have the purpose of acceptance test and will provide at the same time an instruction period for the NorthC Operations and Facilities department.


Responsibilities;


  • Managing the design stages and construction of the project
  • Active communication with all stakeholders involved, e.g. consultants, contractors, suppliers, authorities, NorthC stakeholders and specialists
  • Managing the contractors and suppliers involved
  • Monitoring the budget and timeline of all phases of the project and proactively signalling deviations on time
  • Initiating necessary offers and timely start-up of POs within the project
  • Managing the contracts with contractors and suppliers
  • Safeguard the quality of the delivered products with support of the consultants
  • Ensuring a smooth hand over of the project to the NorthC Operations and Facilities department
  • Ensuring the works are in accordance with agreed processes and procedures within the framework of Health & Safety (HSE) and quality systems

Capabilities:


  • Technical knowledge in the field of CSA and MEP installations
  • Fully informed and aware of new developments in the market
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in project management and project management methodologies
  • Can-do-mentality, innovative, flexible, problem-solving thinking, analytical
  • Management skills for managing and motivating project members in the project
  • Excellent communication skills and able to interact at different levels (both technical and managerial)
  • Understands the difference between, goal, objective, process and content details
  • Presentation skills at a professional level
  • Represents the company in a professional manner
  • A team player with integrity, able to deal well with different stakeholder interests
  • Persuasiveness, Ownership and decisiveness
  • German & English speaking and writing at a professional level
  • Career opportunities at the forefront of digitalization
  • Flat hierarchies and a first-name culture ("Du") throughout the entire NorthC Group
  • A hybrid and flexible workplace – work from the office or from home
  • Excellent employee benefits, including a company pension scheme
  • Regular employee events to strengthen the company culture and recognize employee contributions
  • Complimentary refreshments, including water, coffee, tea, and fresh fruit

title: Butikssäljare till OKQ8 Pajala, deltid
description:
Är du en serviceinriktad lagspelare?

I så fall kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt arbete i en spännande miljö där ingen dag är den andra lik, med stor variation på arbetsuppgifterna. Ena stunden jobbar du med merförsäljning i kassan, för att snabbt skifta till att hyra ut en bil, servera mat, eller så ser du till att stationen är ren och fräsch. För oss är alla uppgifter lika viktiga, och vi hjälps åt att genomföra dem med högsta kvalitet. På våra stationer är det ofta ett högt tempo där du och dina kollegor tar hand om våra kunder genom service i världsklass.

Nu söker vi en ny kollega till OKQ8

OKQ8 Pajala

.

Vi söker

Vi värdesätter dina personliga egenskaper framför tidigare erfarenhet och utbildning. Du är en positiv person som gillar att träffa nya människor. Du tycker om att arbeta i högt tempo och ser fram emot att vara en del av ett sammansvetsat team som tillsammans löser det arbetsdagen har att bjuda på. Det är meriterande om du tidigare jobbat med service eller försäljning. B-Körkort är det enda formella kravet.

Vi erbjuder

OK Norrbotten erbjuder en spännande arbetsplats, med rolig atmosfär och härliga kollegor. Här arbetar människor i alla åldrar med olika bakgrund. Vi tror på utveckling av oss själva. Det du inte kan innan du börjar – det lär vi dig! Att arbeta på en av våra stationer ger dig en fin språngbräda in i arbetslivet och karriären.

Som Butikssäljare arbetar du skift. Denna tjänst är en tillsvidareanställning på 35 timmar per vecka . Stationen har öppet vardagar mellan klockan 06:00 - 22:00 och helger mellan klockan 07:00 - 22:00.

Kan du göra oss ännu bättre? Sök då tjänsten redan idag!

OK Norrbotten är en ekonomisk förening som ägs av ca 119 000 medlemmar. Föreningen ingår i OKQ8-kedjan med 18 bemannade bensinstationer, en återförsäljare och 15 automatstationer. OK Norrbotten har en stark lokal närvaro och finns i länets alla kommuner. Vi har 215 bilkunniga medarbetare som brinner för att göra livet enklare för våra medlemmar och kunder. OK Norrbottens överskott stannar i Norrbotten. Det som inte återinvesteras i föreningens anläggningar delas ut till medlemmarna i form av återbäring.

OK Norrbotten arbetar för att vara en jämställd arbetsplats med medarbetare som trivs och utvecklas och där olikheter uppmuntras. Vi vill vara ett företag som speglar samhället, med en inkluderande kultur som hjälper till att minska utanförskap och bidrar till mångfald.

Hela samhället ställer om mot en fossilfri framtid. Vi vill leda utvecklingen i branschen genom att driva förändring och arbetar aktivt för att minska vårt eget klimatavtryck, såväl som att hjälpa våra kunder att göra bättre och mer hållbara val utifrån sina förutsättningar. Vill du vara med och bidra till hållbar utveckling på riktigt? Välkommen att följa med på vår resa!

title: Säljare
description:
Vill du göra skillnad och har ett hjärta som klappar lite extra för idrott? Då kan det vara dig vi söker! Vi letar efter en säljare till vårt Malmökontor som vill vara med och förenkla vardagen för tusentals idrottsföreningar – och samtidigt bidra till något större.

På SportAdmin drivs vi av en tydlig vision: att vara föreningens, lagets och medlemmens bästa vän. Vi är på en spännande digitaliseringsresa tillsammans med idrottssverige, med mål i sikte att frigöra tid för det som verkligen räknas: glädjen och gemenskapen inom idrotten.

Som säljare på vår avdelning för nysälj blir du en central del av denna resa. Med din hjälp skapar vi ännu bättre förutsättningar för föreningar att lyckas både på och utanför planen. Är du redo att sätta på dig matchtröjan och hjälpa oss att ta svensk idrott till nästa nivå?

Om SportAdmin

Vi är ett snabbväxande tillväxtföretag och fyrfaldigt Gasellbolag. Från vårt kontor i centrala Malmö utgår 57 medarbetare som sedan 2005 har arbetat för att skapa en enklare vardag för den svenska idrottsrörelsen, genom att bland annat underlätta medlemshantering, kommunikation och betalningar. Vår kärlek till idrotten genomsyrar allt vi gör och vi jobbar stenhårt för att vara föreningens, lagets och medlemmens bästa vän. I början av 2024 slog vi oss samman med Lime Technologies, och vi är nu ett eget affärsområde inom Lime-koncernen.

Vad kommer du att göra?

Här välkomnas du av ett team på fem säljare som stöttar varandra och har kul längs vägen. Du kommer att hitta och inleda kontakten med nya föreningar, följa upp med kartläggningsmöten och guida kunderna hela vägen fram till att avtalet skrivs. Därefter tar vårt Customer Success-team över med systemutbildning och fortsatt kundkontakt.

Jobbet innebär komplex försäljning, vilket kräver att du snabbt kan sätta dig in i ny information och förstå kundernas verksamhet. Varje kundresa ser olika ut, vilket också gör jobbet både varierat och utvecklande.

Sammanfattningsvis kommer din roll att inkludera:

  • Bearbetning av nya föreningar, främst via telefon.
  • Genomförande av behovsanalys via digitala möten.
  • Presentation av lösning, främst via digitala möten men även fysiska vid större affärer.
  • Vecko- och månadsvisa säljmöten och workshops för avdelningens och din personliga fortsatta utveckling.
  • Interna möten med Customer Success-teamet för att säkerställa en smidig uppstart av föreningen.

Vem är du?

För oss handlar det inte om vilken utbildning du har gått – vi letar efter dig som är en vass kommunikatör, full av driv och gillar att skapa nya affärer. Vi tror att rätt personlighet och inställning väger tyngst helt enkelt. Vi tänker oss att du:

  • Kan uttrycka dig obehindrat i svenska både i tal och skrift, detta då språket används dagligen i kontakt med kunder.
  • Har erfarenhet av B2C- eller B2B-försäljning i miljöer där kundkontakt sker utanför butik, exempelvis inom telecom.
  • Gärna har jobbat med komplex värdebaserad försäljning inom SaaS, vilket ses som meriterande.
  • Gärna har erfarenhet av föreningsliv inom idrott, antingen som anställd, styrelse, ledare eller aktiv utövare.
  • Är snabbtänkt, modig och duktig på att uttrycka dig

Om du, precis som vi, uppskattar att jobba tillsammans på kontoret och tycker att arbetsglädje växer bäst bland kollegor – då kommer du trivas bra här!

Vi erbjuder

Vi arbetar hårt och målmedvetet under veckorna, men ser alltid till att ha roligt längs vägen. Med rätt inställning och en genuin passion för det du gör skapar vi en arbetsmiljö där vi både trivs och presterar på topp. Vi anser att om någon av våra anställda har söndagsångest har vi som företag misslyckats. Vi tror att kreativitet och slutresultat blir avsevärt bättre om man varje söndag längtar efter att komma in på kontoret nästkommande dag.

Vi är resultatdrivna och tävlingsinriktade, vilket är nödvändigt då vi är mitt uppe i att förändra, digitalisera och automatisera en hel bransch. Vi behöver hela tiden utmana oss själva för att kunna lösa framtidens problem och leva upp till att vara föreningens, ledarens och medlemmens bästa vän. Utöver detta får du möjlighet att träna två gånger i veckan på arbetstid, njuta av härliga fredagsfrukostar och delta i andra trevliga sociala aktiviteter.

Besök gärna vår karriärsida för att läsa mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss.

Ansökan

Det är viktigare för oss att hitta rätt person än att det går snabbt. Vi tillämpar löpande rekrytering och räknar med att tillsätta tjänsten under hösten. Du ansöker genom att fylla i ansökningsformuläret. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar per e-post.

För frågor rörande rekryteringsprocessen och rollen, vänligen kontakta agnes.arberg@lime.tech
