title: FTZ - Salgskonsulent til FTZ Truck (Midt- og Nordjylland)
description:
FTZ - Salgskonsulent til FTZ Truck (Midt- og Nordjylland)
  
	

	
	
	
	
		
	
		
	
	
	
	

	

	  
	
	
	
		
	

	
	









	
	


	
	




			
		

		


	




	

	

		

  			
	    

    

		    	
Flere fordele. For dig. For fremtiden.

		    	Salgskonsulent til FTZ Truck (Midt- og Nordjylland)
    

    

    

  

		

			  

				

					

								
FTZ er i gang med at etablere et nyt forretningsområde med fokus på reservedele til trucksegmentet og søger derfor en salgskonsulent til Midt- og Nordjylland. Du får en central rolle i den videre opbygning af området og bliver en vigtig drivkraft i arbejdet med at styrke vores markedsposition, skabe stærke kunderelationer og omsætte vores ambitioner til konkrete resultater.

Om os

Du bliver en del af et nyoprettet team, hvor vi arbejder selvstændigt og aldrig alene. Selvom vi ikke deler kontor, er dialogen tæt. Vi mødes typisk online, men ringer, sparrer og deler viden hver dag, både når tingene lykkes og når vi støder på udfordringer. Det giver et stærkt fællesskab med både din leder og kolleger. 

"Vi giver en grundig introduktion til jobbet, så du kommer godt fra start. Du får et stærkt netværk og en solid organisation af læne dig op ad" - fortæller Head of Truck Allan Lindegaard Rasmussen. 

Hos os arbejder du inden for tydelige rammer og klare forventninger og med frihed til at planlægge din egen arbejdsdag. Du har strukturen, der giver overblik og tryghed, og samtidig fleksibiliteten til at prioritere, hvor du skaber størst værdi. Med Salesforce som dit stærke værktøj og et team, der altid står klar til at støtte dig, kan du bruge tiden på det, der virkelig betyder noget, nemlig opsøgende salg og opbygning af langvarige relationer. 

Sådan kan din dag se ud

Du starter dagen med at åbne Salesforce, dit digitale værktøj, der giver dig fuldt overblik over dagens kundebesøg. Du styrer selv din dagsplan og har fleksibilitet til at prioritere undervejs. 

Første stop er hos en ny potentiel kunde. Du er klar til dialogen, stiller de rigtige spørgsmål og finder frem til, hvordan vi kan skabe værdi for deres forretning. Senere besøger du en fast kunde, hvor du følger op på samarbejdet og styrker relationen. Sådan fortsætter dagen og du er på farten, i dialog, og bruger din energi og dit kommercielle mindset til at opbygge tillid og skabe relationer. 

Når det passer ind i din daglige arbejdsrytme, opdaterer du dine aktiviteter i Salesforce. Det giver dig overblik over pipeline og sikrer, at du altid er et skridt foran, uden at gå på kompromis med din tid hos kunderne. Du går hjem med følelsen af at have gjort en forskel. 

Dine opgaver omfatter bl.a.:

Opsøgende salg og opbygning af nye relationer

Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende kundeforhold

Udarbejdelse af tilbud og kontrakter

Deltagelse i messer og brancheevents

Samarbejde med interne afdelinger for at sikre kundetilfredshed

Opfølgning og rapportering af salgsaktiviteter

Om dig - sådan ser vi dig i rollen

Du kommer med erfaring fra truck- og trailerbranchen og kender markedet, produkterne og kundernes behov indgående. Du har erfaring fra en lignende salgsrolle, eller du kan have en teknisk baggrund som f.eks mekaniker inden for det tunge segment og ønsker at bruge din faglige viden i en kundevendt rolle.

Du arbejder sikkert i CRM-systemer og digitale værktøjer, og du trives med at være ude hos kunderne, tage initiativ og opbygge langvarige relationer baseret på tillid og faglig sparring. Du arbejder målrettet, følger dine opgaver til dørs og tager ansvar for resultaterne.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har solid teknisk forståelse og en oprigtig interesse for produkter og løsninger til truck- og trailersegmentet.

Har lyst til at være med til at opbygge et nyt område og sætte dit præg på udviklingen.

Deler din viden og erfaring med kolleger og kunder.

Arbejder struktureret med fokus på kvalitet, opfølgning og kontinuitet.

Forbereder dig grundigt og planlægger dine kundemøder, så de skaber værdi.

Har et kommercielt mindset og motiveres af at skabe resultater og nå dine mål. 

Vi tilbyder
FTZ vil fortsat være den ultimative partner for værksteder over hele landet, med en ensartet service, der matcher vores høje standarder. Derfor vil du i FTZ opleve en udviklingsorienteret kultur med en høj grad af samarbejde på tværs af kolleger og afdelinger. Vi skaber rammerne for at alle medarbejdere kan levere en dedikeret indsats, hvor faglighed og professionalisme kan blomstre. 

Vores tre værdier - Ordentlighed, Samarbejde og Udvikling - binder os sammen, og dem arbejder aktivt for at efterleve hver dag. Det er gennem vores værdier, engagement og indsats at vi sammen gør en forskel. Det skal du have lyst til at blive en del af. Derudover får du: 

Et spændende og udfordrende job med gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.

Bred indsigt i virksomheden gennem oplæringsforløbet

Et arbejdsmiljø med en glad og uformel omgangstone

Gode arbejdsforhold, løn efter kvalifikationer, en pensionsordning, og sundhedsforsikring.

Stillingen er på fuld tid med tiltrædelse efter aftale. 

Vil du vide mere?
Hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Truck Allan Lindegaard Rasmussen på 2966 2548. 

Læs mere om FTZ her.

Ansøgninger behandles løbende, og vi afholder samtaler løbende.

title: Director, Channel & Partners
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

About the role

Cursor is building its partner ecosystem across APJ, and this is a build-from-the-ground-up role at the centre of it. As the in-market partner builder for your market, you own the partner business end to end. You set the strategy, stand it up, and run it, all at the same time. You work as the business partner to the in-market Regional Vice President, turning their go-to-market priorities into partner-led pipeline and co-sell wins. Two engines drive the market, Technology partnerships and Transformation partnerships, both building on relationships Cursor already holds.

Japan is a partner-first market. You cannot operate effectively without strong local partners, and this is the most pressing of our APJ in-market needs despite being at the earliest stage. This is a standing start: you will land Cursor's first local partners in Japan, open co-sell motions, and stand up FDE capacity in a market with no coverage today.

This is a team of one in-market with a speed mandate. You report into the Director of Partnerships APJ, which keeps the craft and standards under partnerships without splitting your accountability to the market.

This is an in-market role. You will spend a significant share of your time in person with partner principals, delivery teams, and customers across your market, and you will work closely with a small, high-talent-density global partnerships team that values in-person collaboration and fast, direct communication.

What you'll do

• Own the in-market partner business from concept to completion. Set the market partner strategy and sequencing from greenfield, then execute it personally.

• Accelerate Cursor's global partners into your market and incubate them to productivity, across Technology and Transformation partnerships.

• Where gaps exist, recruit, onboard, and manage local partners from the ground up.

• Build and run co-sell motions, stand up FDE (forward deployed engineer) capacity, and drive C-level access and value-amplification programs through to landed wins.

• Turn partner relationships into qualified pipeline and closed co-sell revenue that feeds the in-market RVP number.

• Build the data picture for your market and use it to drive decisions, priorities, and forecasting.

• Own the operating system that keeps it repeatable: reporting, tracking, tiering, onboarding flows, partner QBRs, and cadence.

• Act as business partner to the in-market RVP, translating their go-to-market priorities into partner motion and giving them a clear, data-backed view of the business.

• Take ambiguous problems, from routes to market and contracting to partner economics, co-sell mechanics, channel conflict, localisation, FDE accreditation, and customer access, and drive them to a working outcome without the path laid out for you.

You may be a fit if

• You are fluent in Japanese and deeply understand the local technology and services partner ecosystem, especially SIs/GSIs. In a partner-first market, this is essential.

• You have professional working proficiency in English. You will engage consistently with HQ and present plans to English-speaking stakeholders, so you can operate and communicate confidently in English. Fluency in both Japanese and English is the highest-value combination for this role.

• You are a builder-operator, a doer rather than a coordinator, energized by owning a business from greenfield and running it as it grows.

• You have built and scaled technology, consulting, GSI, ideally in enterprise software, and carried a number against that work.

• You are fluent across partner business plans, program mechanics, enablement, and co-sell economics, and comfortable being accountable for the outcomes.

• You make decisions from data and can stand up the reporting and operating cadence yourself.

• You build durable relationships with partner principals and alliance leads, the kind of person partners choose to invest behind.

• You navigate negotiation and channel conflict with judgment, and you identify and influence the right internal and external people quickly.

• You operate credibly across diverse markets and decision-making styles, and you move fast.

Du er faglig engasjert og ønsker å videreutvikle deg sammen med klinikken.

title: Senior Talent Partner – Corporate Development and Strategy
description:
United Kingdom | Remote

6 month - Fixed Term Contract - Working US hours

What will I be doing?

You'll be partnering with one of our global enterprise clients, supporting the hiring of senior Corporate Development and Strategy talent across North America.

This is a specialist hiring project focused on senior-level appointments, from Senior Manager through to Vice President. You'll be recruiting exceptional professionals with backgrounds in Corporate Development, Strategy Consulting, M&A and Strategic Finance, working alongside a highly accomplished leadership team.

The hiring volume is intentionally low – around 10 hires per year – but every search is business-critical. Success in this role comes from your ability to deliver quality over quantity, build credibility with demanding stakeholders and proactively identify exceptional talent in highly competitive markets.

Your expertise, professionalism, resilience and willingness to go the extra mile will be what makes you successful in this role.

Typical activities all hang off your main goals of finding exceptional talent whilst delivering a rock star client experience and an equally outstanding candidate experience – enhancing the brand of both our client and Join Talent.

Typical activities include:

  • Creating and gaining buy-in for hiring strategies across complex executive and senior leadership searches
  • Building trusted relationships with senior Hiring Managers, HR and business leaders, becoming a genuine talent advisor rather than simply filling vacancies
  • Partnering with demanding, high-performing stakeholders and confidently managing expectations throughout the hiring process
  • Conducting deep market mapping and proactive executive search across Corporate Development, Strategy, M&A and related functions
  • Directly sourcing and headhunting senior candidates through a variety of channels
  • Screening and assessing candidates against both technical capability and organisational fit
  • Presenting high-quality shortlists supported by market insight and hiring recommendations
  • Managing the end-to-end candidate journey, ensuring an exceptional experience throughout
  • Providing market intelligence, competitor insights and talent mapping to support business decisions
  • Maintaining accurate data within ATS and client recruitment systems

Role Requirements

  • Significant experience recruiting Corporate Development, Strategy, M&A or Executive Finance professionals
  • Proven success delivering senior-level searches from Senior Manager through to VP and Executive level
  • Experience partnering with senior business leaders and managing challenging stakeholder relationships
  • Strong executive search and proactive sourcing capability
  • Global talent acquisition experience, particularly across North America, would be highly advantageous
  • Experience utilising ATS platforms and recruitment technology
  • Strong commercial awareness and ability to provide market insights
  • Complying with Join Talent's values and ethical standards in every client interaction
  • Maintaining a positive attitude that contributes to both client success and team culture

Skills & Experience

  • Executive Search, RPO or in-house Talent Acquisition experience recruiting senior corporate functions
  • Demonstrable success delivering complex, niche searches with low hiring volumes and high expectations
  • Outstanding stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Strong capability in market mapping, talent intelligence and executive sourcing
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Commercially minded with exceptional attention to detail
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously in a remote environment
  • Resilient, adaptable and solution-focused
  • Team player – there's little room in a growing business for lone wolves, and collaborating with colleagues and clients is key to our success

A bit about us…

Join Talent is a great place to be. We are EMEA's fastest growing Recruitment insourcing business (boutique RPO or embedded talent solution - we are not precious about the term!). Whatever you call it, it is in-house at pace!

Our ethos is scarily simple - we hire amazingly talented recruiters and recruitment leaders, support them really well, and provide them with a fantastic set of tools to create hiring success.

Companies often talk about how they put people first, we mean it to the bottom of our souls - and if you want to use your TA prowess to check that out just message anyone from our team of over 200 recruiters and ask them for their views on how well we do at putting our team first and creating a great culture.

We provide growing businesses with the technology, manpower and expertise required to enable them to hire, onboard and manage the talent they need to meet their growth plans. Our model provides flexibility and pace for rapid deployment of hiring scale-up solutions.

Established in early 2019 Join Talent is in many respects the ‘new kid on the block’ in the market, but we support some of the world's most exciting brands, and have over 200 team members across 19 countries today .... and still growing!

We work in an industry agnostic manner, and this is reflected in the diversity of our clients who include companies as diverse as Amazon, OnBuy, Mambu, Zego, Booking.com, Celonis and Frontiers.

Kotihoidossa tarjoat asiakkaillesi turvaa, hoivaa ja vastuullista läsnäoloa heidän omassa kodissaan. Saat merkityksellisen työn, jossa olet tärkeässä roolissa asiakkaidemme arjessa. Mukana kulkee moniammatillinen ja kannustava tiimi, jonka kanssa et jää yksin. Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, joustavaa ja positiivista työotetta sekä kykyä sopeutua muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja toimia itsenäisesti. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je functie is het ondersteunen van HAZOP-studies als lid van het facilitatieteam. Je helpt sessies voorbereiden, houdt informatie en acties zorgvuldig bij en leert hoe procesrisico’s systematisch worden besproken en vastgelegd.

Daarnaast werk je mee aan projecten binnen de Process-afdeling en ontwikkel je je stap voor stap tot een zelfstandige Process Engineer. Je ontvangt de benodigde training en begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. Naarmate je kennis groeit, krijg je meer ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid binnen projecten.

De ontwikkeling binnen process engineering kost tijd. Daarom zoeken we iemand die ambitie combineert met geduld, nieuwsgierigheid en de bereidheid om eerst de basis goed te beheersen. Je werkt vooral samen met het HAZOP-team en de volledige Process-afdeling. De werksfeer is vriendelijk en gericht op samenwerken, leren en duidelijke communicatie.

Wat ga je doen?

  • HAZOP-studies ondersteunen als onderdeel van het facilitatieteam

  • HAZOP-sessies organisatorisch en inhoudelijk voorbereiden

  • Technische informatie, verslagen, actielijsten en projectdocumentatie nauwkeurig verwerken en bijhouden

  • Meewerken aan projectwerkzaamheden binnen de Process-afdeling

  • Technische vraagstukken analyseren en leren deze gestructureerd te benaderen

  • Bijdragen aan correcte administratie en verbeteringen in werkprocessen

  • Samenwerken en afstemmen met process engineers, HAZOP-collega’s en andere projectbetrokkenen

  • Werken met Microsoft Office en verschillende engineeringapplicaties

  • Je werkzaamheden organiseren, prioriteiten afstemmen en tijdig vragen stellen wanneer iets niet duidelijk is

Wat zeggen onze Vicomezen over Vicoma?

Wat neem je mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding (bijv. Chemical Engineering of vergelijkbaar)

  • Relevante academische kennis is een fijne bijkomstigheid

  • In het bezit van VOL-VCA (of bereid dit te behalen)

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse (C1) en Engelse taal (B2)

  • Affiniteit met duurzaamheid en innovatie binnen de industrie

  • Geduld en het besef dat vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling binnen process engineering tijd vraagt

  • Goede organisatorische vaardigheden en het vermogen om informatie overzichtelijk vast te leggen

  • Een open, communicatieve en collegiale houding

  • De bereidheid om (incidenteel) op klantlocatie te werken

Benieuwd wat Vicoma je te bieden heeft?

Bij Vicoma draait het om meer dan alleen technische ontwerpen. Je krijgt volop ruimte om te groeien, zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk. Je werkt samen met ervaren engineers in hechte teams waarin kennisdeling en samen leren vanzelfsprekend zijn en eigen initiatief echt wordt gewaardeerd.

En omdat werk niet alles is, zorgen we er ook voor dat de randvoorwaarden kloppen: goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, aandacht voor werk-privébalans en extra voordelen die bijdragen aan jouw werkplezier.

Ben jij klaar om samen met ons de industrie van morgen vorm te geven?

Stuur dan jouw open sollicitatie via de knop hieronder en vertel ons waarom jij bij Vicoma past!

title: Huishoudelijke hulp Doetinchem
description:
Word jij het zonnetje in huis? Kom werken als Huishoudelijke Hulp!

Werkgebied: Doetinchem
Contract: 2-24 uur per week, flexibele werktijden

Bij Miep Huishoudservice en Begeleiding draait alles om het creëren van een écht thuisgevoel – niet alleen voor onze cliënten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je je gewaardeerd voelt, je werk met plezier doet en altijd de steun krijgt die je nodig hebt. Flexibiliteit, persoonlijke aandacht en een fijne werksfeer staan bij ons centraal!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Huishoudelijke Hulp bij Miep Huishoudservice zorg je ervoor dat onze cliënten zich thuis blijven voelen in hun eigen woning, ook als zij zelf niet meer volledig voor het huishouden kunnen zorgen. Jouw taken bestaan uit:

  • Schoonmaken, stofzuigen en andere huishoudelijke werkzaamheden.

  • Cliënten zoveel mogelijk betrekken bij het huishouden.

  • Persoonlijke aandacht en een luisterend oor bieden.

Jij maakt elke dag het verschil! Dankzij jouw hulp blijft het huis van onze cliënten schoon en fijn, waardoor zij langer zelfstandig kunnen blijven wonen. Een sociaal en dankbaar beroep waarin jij elke dag iets moois betekent voor een ander!

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ons bepaal jij je eigen werktijden en -dagen! Extra werken in de vakantie? Geen probleem! Je krijgt een salaris volgens de cao VVT, vanaf € 15,07 bruto per uur afhankelijk van ervaring, met jaarlijkse verhogingen tot € 18,27. Daarnaast ontvang je vakantiegeld (8%) en een eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%), die je ook maandelijks kunt laten uitbetalen. Ook bouw je pensioen op en kun je gebruikmaken van een collectieve zorgverzekering. Reiskosten (zoals auto, fiets, brommer of scooter) en reistijd tussen cliënten worden vergoed.

We investeren in jouw groei met een digitaal onboardingsprogramma via de MiepApp vol e-learnings. Wil je alvast een kijkje nemen? Klik dan hier. Je krijgt een contract voor bepaalde tijd met de intentie tot een vaste aanstelling. Twee keer per jaar organiseren we een medewerkersbijeenkomst om je collega’s beter te leren kennen. Miep is een warme, betrokken werkgever die naar je luistert. Jouw werk is niet alleen belangrijk, maar maakt ook écht een verschil voor onze cliënten!

Wie ben jij?

  • Jij bent het zonnetje in huis, zorgzaam en hebt een groot inlevingsvermogen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je taken.

  • Je spreekt en begrijpt Nederlands.

  • Je bent minimaal 2 uur per week beschikbaar tussen 9:00 en 18:00 uur (ma-vr).

  • Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme en een passie voor schoonmaken zijn minstens zo belangrijk!

  • Je hebt eigen vervoer (auto, scooter of fiets) om naar cliënten te reizen.

Enthousiast geworden?

Wil jij het verschil maken en onze cliënten laten stralen? Solliciteer vandaag nog!
Stuur je CV en motivatie naar ons op en wie weet verwelkomen wij jou binnenkort als onze nieuwe collega. Na je sollicitatie laten we je zo snel mogelijk weten hoe het verder gaat. Bij indiensttreding vragen wij een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) aan.

title: Data Scientist - Fintech
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Data Scientist - Growth

Location: Madrid (Hybrid: 4 days office / 1 day WFH)

Stack: Python, SQL, GCP (BigQuery, AI Platform, Cloud Functions), ML Libraries, CRM (Salesforce), LLMs.

Why This Role Exists

Ebury is executing an ambitious strategic growth plan across multiple business verticals. To power this expansion, we need to bridge the gap between advanced data science and real-world sales execution. This role exists to drive innovation in Growth modelling and deliver the actionable, data-driven insights that fuel our global sales engine.

Today, optimizing sales performance requires continuous experimentation and refining how we identify commercial opportunities. Tomorrow, we want to scale and seamlessly integrate our predictive models—such as Lead Scoring, conversion, and profitability models—directly into our sales enablement platforms so our teams can make faster, smarter, and highly optimized decisions every day.

What You'll Own 📌

Growth Modelling & Predictive Analytics

  • Drive innovation in Growth modelling by identifying opportunities for improvement, experimenting with new methodologies, and continuously refining models to enhance accuracy and performance.
  • Develop and refine models for sales enablement and growth, using Python to drive better sales performance and decision-making. These models include, but are not limited to: Lead Scoring models, conversion models, profitability models, etc.
  • Analyse and optimise sales data to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities that enhance lead scoring and sales strategies, contributing to overall business growth.

Cross-Functional Integration & Tool Adoption

  • Collaborate with Data Engineers and Sales Analysts to integrate models into sales enablement platforms, ensuring the delivery of actionable insights to sales teams and business stakeholders.
  • Support the adoption of advanced analytics tools within the sales team, providing clear guidance on model outputs while working closely with senior data scientists for continuous improvement and learning.

What You Bring

Must-Have

  • 2+ years of experience in Data Science or related roles
  • Proficiency in Python and extensive experience with machine learning libraries.
  • Solid understanding of statistical methods and machine learning models, with the clear ability to interpret model results and rigorously assess their performance.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (including Data Engineers, Sales Analysts, and business stakeholders) to ensure models align perfectly with business objectives.
  • A problem-solving mindset with the ability to identify data-driven solutions to complex sales and growth challenges, helping optimize sales strategies and decision-making processes.
  • Self-motivation and curiosity, with a strong desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment, continuously improving both technical and business skills.
  • Fluency in English (Spanish is a plus).

Highly Valued

  • Experience with GCP (Google Cloud Platform) tools and services, such as BigQuery, AI Platform, and Cloud Functions, for deploying scalable data solutions.
  • Experience with A/B testing or experimentation frameworks is a plus, particularly for optimising sales strategies based on model performance.
  • Knowledge of sales analytics and CRM systems, understanding how data insights can improve lead quality and sales outcomes (familiarity with tools like Salesforce is a plus).
  • Expertise in leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for processing unstructured data, such as text analysis and sentiment analysis, to enhance risk assessment and decision-making.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing large datasets, as well as experience working with both structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Previous hands-on experience building lead scoring models, Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) models, and churn models.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary + Performance-based discretionary bonus.
  • Other Benefits: Private health insurance, flexible remuneration, and a day off on your birthday.
  • Career Progression: A well-structured career path with clear opportunities for growth.
  • Vibrant Culture: Join a collaborative environment in our Madrid office where Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Analysts work as one.
  • Continuous Learning: Personal development through certifications and specialized training.

#LI-JC1

#LI-HYBRID

About us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

title: Projektimyyjä
description:
Tule Anfralle projektimyyjäksi Kempeleeseen

Mikä homma?

Etsimme Anfran kasvavaan tiimiin oma-aloitteista ja yhteistyökykyistä projektimyyjää, joka intohimoisella ja osaavalla otteellaan luo lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu asiakaskontaktit ja myynti Suomessa ja Pohjois-Ruotsissa. Osallistut laskentavaiheeseen ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä tuotannon johdon kanssa. Onnistumisesi työssä edellyttää yhteistyötä tuotannon johdon, laskentainsinöörien ja rakennesuunnittelijoiden kanssa. Saat hyvän alun työhösi Anfran kattavalla perehdytyksellä.

Työllistyt Anfra Oy:lle vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen, ja toivomme, että voit aloittaa syksyn aikana.

Työ edellyttää työmatkoja Suomessa ja Pohjois-Ruotsissa.

Tehtävän palkkapaketti on peruspalkka + provisio, ja palkkatavoitteesi on 4500–6500 € kuukaudessa. Kokemuksen karttuessa sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä jopa 9500 € kuukausiansioon palkkausjärjestelmällämme. Voit myös tutustua erinomaisiin työsuhde-etuihimme, jotka tukevat arkeasi, urasivuillamme.

Mitä kaipaamme sinun työkalupakkiin?

Sinulla on rakennusalan tuntemus, jota myyntityössä tarvitaan, joko työkokemuksen tai koulutuksen kautta, sekä aiempaa kokemusta itsenäisestä ja tuloksellisesta myyntityöstä. Hallitset sujuvasti IT-taidot, jotka tukevat myyntityötä, ja hyppäät rohkeasti Anfran mukana rakennusalan digitalisaation etulinjaan. Käytössämme on Pipedrive -myyntiohjelmisto, Admicom -laskentaohjelmisto ja lukuisia muita ohjelmistoja.

Olet kehittymishaluinen tiimipelaaja, ja Anfran arvot hauskuus, avoimuus, jämäkkyys ja huolenpito kuvaavat myös sinun toimintatapojasi. Arki kasvavassa yhtiössä ja hyvässä joukkueessamme on vauhdikasta ja palkitsevaa, joten uskomme että sinäkin viihdyt kanssamme, mikäli innostut tekemisen meiningistä sekä sopivasta itsesi haastamisesta.

Suhtaudut uteliaasti uusiin toimintatapoihin ja sytyt kasvun tuomista mahdollisuuksista, ollen myös sinnikäs haasteenpaikoissa. Sinulla on jatkuva halu oppia uutta ja kyky pysyä muutoksen kyydissä pelottomasti - sillä se minkä opit eilen, voi olla huomenna jo vanhentunutta tietoa. Ennen kaikkea koet merkityksellisenä saada jättää ammattitaitoisen kädenjälkesi Anfran kehittymiseen.

Kiinnostuitko tulemaan anfralaiseksi?

Voit hakea mukaan Anfran joukkueeseen urasivujemme kautta 19.8.2026 mennessä! Tutustumme uusiin hakijoihin rullaavasti, huomioithan että voimme edetä rekrytointiprosessissa jo hakuajan sisällä.

Rekryprosessimme etenee seuraavasti:

  1. Ilmaise kiinnostuksesi anfralaiseksi jättämällä meille hakemus urasivujemme kautta simppelillä hakusysteemillämme (katso jos et usko!)

  2. Rekrytointiammattilaisten lisäksi hyödynnämme rekrytointiprosessissamme automatiikkaa ja tekoälyä. Jos perusasiat mätsäävät, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä tutustumiskeskustelun merkeissä.

  3. Jatkoon valitut henkilöt pääsevät esittelemään itseään lisää sinulle sopivana hetkenä henkilöarviointien kautta (itsenäisesti tehtävät persoonallisuusarviointi ja kykytestit)

  4. Näiden pohjalta meillä onkin jo mukavasti lisätietoja, ja kutsumme sopivia henkilöitä jatkotapaamisiin tutustelemaan Anfran tiimiläisten kanssa ja kuulemaan lisää meiningistämme

  5. Kaikki natsaa? Ei muuta kun kättä päälle ja mukaan Anfran huippuun joukkueeseen!

Mikäli sinulla jäi kysyttävää, voit olla yhteydessä sähköpostitse toimitusjohtaja Tomi Puoskari tomi.puoskari@anfra.fi tai henkilöstöjohtaja Tuomo Hilliahoon tuomo.hilliaho@anfra.fi.

Työmahdollisuus vielä pähkinänkuoressa:

  • Projektimyyjän Tehtävä Anfran Kempeleen toimistolla.

  • Sinulla on rakennusalan tuntemus, jota myyntityössä tarvitaan, joko työkokemuksen tai koulutuksen kautta, sekä aiempaa kokemusta itsenäisestä ja tuloksellisesta myyntityöstä.

  • Olet kehittymishaluinen tiimipelaaja, ja Anfran arvot hauskuus, avoimuus, jämäkkyys ja huolenpito kuvaavat myös sinun toimintatapojasi.

  • Tehtävän palkkausmalli on peruspalkka + provisio, ja palkkatavoitteesi on 4500-6500 € / kk, kovilla tuloksilla jopa 9500 € / kk.

  • Voit myös tutustua erinomaisiin työsuhde-etuihimme, jotka tukevat arkeasi, urasivuillamme.

title: Tekniker til Audi Gladsaxe - En del af Semler Mobility Joboplysninger | SEMLER
description:

 Vi udvider vores team og søger i den forbindelse snarest en struktureret og teamorienteret tekniker. Så hvis du kunne tænke dig at blive en del af Danmarks største Audi værksted og arbejde med et af bilbranchens bedste bilmærker - Så er du måske vores nye kollega! 


 
 Om jobbet
 Du kommer til at indgå i et team af flere dygtige teknikere, hvor vores største fokus er kvaliteten i arbejdet, samarbejde og den gode kundeservice. Du får naturligvis din egen lift, adgang til digitale hjælpemidler og dit eget værktøj. Du vil få en hverdag med afvekslende opgaver, men dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være service og reparation.  


 
 Om dig
 Du er uddannet automekaniker eller har en lignende erhvervsmæssig baggrund. Du er teknisk velfunderet, og kommer til at arbejde med de nyeste teknologier. Vi forestiller os, at du er løsningsorienteret, forstår vigtigheden i at overholde fastlagte processer, men også tør at tage fat og gå nye veje når muligheden byder sig. Du trives i en til tider travl hverdag, hvor du altid formår at holde overblikket.
 
 Vi forventer desuden, at du har kørekort (Minimum kat. B). Kendskab til Audi vil være en fordel, men ikke et krav. Hvis du kommer med erfaring fra andre mærker, sørger vi for at få opgraderet dine kompetencer og certificeringer.
  
 Om os
 Audi Gladsaxe er en del af Semler Gruppen, som har over 100 års erfaring inden for import og salg af biler, og består af mere end 3.000 medarbejdere. Vores specialiserede medarbejdere og mangeårige erfaring giver os en stærk placering på markedet. Det kræver at vi er dedikerede og sætter en ære i vores arbejde hver eneste dag.
 
 Vi tilbyder løn efter kvalifikationer, pension, sundhedssikring og en hel del andre fordelagtige medarbejdergoder samt muligheden for at blive en vigtig del af en stor og professionel organisation. 


 
 Hvad kan du forvente af mig som leder?
 Rasmus Lindeborg Vilhelmsen siger:
 "Som din leder kan du forvente en dedikeret og ambitiøs tilgang, hvor jeg prioriterer dine muligheder for udvikling og trivsel højt. Jeg arbejder målrettet for at skabe et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til stor frihed i dine egne arbejdsopgaver. Samtidig kan du regne med, at jeg er tilgængelig for sparring og hjælp, når du har brug for det. Jeg ønsker at støtte dig i at nå dine mål og sikre, at vi sammen opnår succes gennem samarbejde, respekt og fælles engagement".
  
 Lyder det som noget for dig?
 Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt, og behandler derfor ansøgninger løbende. Søg gerne allerede i dag. 


 Ansøgningsfristen er den 1. september 2026. Har du yderligere spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Servicechef Nickey Sendrup Larsen på telefon 9243 3638 eller  nisl@audi.dk  


 
 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! 

                 
     
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
     
                 

             

         

     


    
 
        
 
         

     

                                         

                                        
 
    
    
 
        
   
         

     

    
 
        
  

     

    
    
 
        
   Din vej. Fælles fremtid  


 Som ny kollega i Semler Gruppen bliver du en del af et stort fællesskab på mere end 3000 kollegaer. Vi er fordelt over hele landet, og arbejder med alt fra landbrugets tungeste maskiner til selvkørende teknologi og delebiler.   



 At være en del af en stor organisation betyder, at der er talrige muligheder for at udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt. Vi har f.eks. en hel uddannelsesafdeling, som tilbyder efteruddannelse og certificeringer i samarbejde med vores producenter. Sidst men ikke mindst kan vi hjælpe dig på vej med vores udviklingsværktøj GROW, som intelligent og systematisk matcher dine kompetencer op imod udviklingsmulighederne i Semler Gruppen.  



 Alle er vi forenet af et sæt fælles værdier, der fungerer som den daglige gps for vores måde at arbejde på.   



 Vi er ordentlige. Vi holder hvad vi lover, også når det kræver en omvej. Sådan er det, når ambitionen er at have de mest tilfredse kunder og leverandører i de brancher vi opererer i.   



 Vi er dedikerede. Vi står distancen og kommer i mål.   



 Vi er nytænkende. Fordi man ikke bliver Danmarks største bilaktør af at køre på autopilot.  



 Vi har glimt i øjet. Med respekt for hinanden og godt humør bliver det rarere at gå på arbejde.

title: Head of Service Management Office
description:
Outokumpu is looking for Head of Service Management Office based in Helsinki to own and continuously improve IT Service Management (ITSM) ways of working, processes and principles across the company.

As a Head of Service Management Office, you will act as a leader in relation to adapting new methodologies, nurturing lean and agile mindset, and overall service management culture throughout the organization.

Your role:

Define, streamline and enforce Service Management and ITSM policies for operational efficiency.

Setting the agenda for service management, raising awareness of SM and frameworks, effective, joined-up and value-led processes, managing service assurance and working with the wider IT community to

develop SM culture.

Define, agree, monitor, and report on service performance, user satisfaction and operational metrics towards IT Leadership.

Act as a centralized focal point bridging technical teams, senior management, and suppliers.

Lead Service Integration including the Service Management Office and related tools and reports

Prepares roadmaps for tools and processes

Prepares budgets and forecasts, ensuring compliance and cost-efficiency.

Ensures services and applications are available, secure, and perform effectively.

Drives standardization, automation, and improvement initiatives.

Define, agree and monitor the consistency of the IT service structure and CMDB within the company.

Ensure documentation, knowledge documents are available.

About you:

Several years of progressive professional experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant field or equivalent experience

Advanced practitioner with significant experience in service management and service delivery

Proven, deep understanding of service management methodologies, tools and techniques such as ITIL (with qualifications or demonstrable real-world experience)

Fluent English language, spoken and written

Analytical approach and proactive skills on continuous improvement

Ability to build up trust and respect by excellent co-operation and communication skills

What we offer

Collaborative culture: a supportive, international environment focused on teamwork and continuous improvement

Competitive compensation and benefits

The autonomy and trust to take responsibility, be proactive, and work independently.

Hybrid work (50/50)

You will be located in Helsinki and report to Head of Group Functions and IT Excellence, Sari Vehtari. You have the flexibility to limited travel based on job requirements.

For more information about the position, please contact Head of Group Functions and IT Excellence, Sari Vehtari: sari.vehtari(at)outokumpu.com or if you have questions regarding your application or the process: Talent Acquisition Partner Miikka Enbuske miikka.enbuske(at)outokumpu.com

If you are motivated to succeed and can see yourself in this role please submit your application latest by 20th of August, 2026.

The position might be filled before the final application date, so don't hesitate to apply earlier!

The selected candidate will be required to pass a security clearance vetting and health check (including drug tests) before commencing employment

Vil du arbejde med mennesker, udvikle dig og være en del af et stærkt fællesskab? Så kom med på holdet hos 3 som butikskonsulent i vores butik i Roskilde.

I 3butikken Roskilde er vi mere end bare kolleger, vi er et ambitiøst team, der løfter i flok. Vi arbejder målrettet med salg og kundeservice, og vi har en stærk kultur, hvor proaktivitet, udvikling og resultater er i fokus. Det betyder, at vi altid er på jagt efter nye muligheder og vi gør det med energi, fællesskab og en stærk vindermentalitet.

Hos os er det ikke din erfaring, der tæller mest, det er din lyst, energi og vilje til at lære. Du behøver ikke have prøvet kræfter med butik eller salg før, vi lærer dig det hele. Vi leder efter dig, der vil gøre en forskel for andre og være en del af noget større.

Din kommende butikschef Elias beskriver arbejdet i butikken således: “Man bliver hurtigt en del af fællesskabet her. Vi hepper på hinanden, deler viden og arbejder målrettet for at nå vores mål. Det motiverer mig hver dag at være i et team, hvor alle vil fremad".

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Som butikskonsulent bliver du en vigtig del af et tæt team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det sjovt imens vi skaber gode oplevelser for vores kunder. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet, at:


Lytte til kundernes behov og guide dem til de rigtige løsninger



Opnå dine egne salgsmål og være med til at sikre butikkens resultater



Gøre opmærksom på kampagner og lanceringer i butikken - vi er dem, der skaber synlighed og energi, når der sker noget nyt


Foruden at hjælpe kunderne fysisk i butikken, vil du også kontakte eksisterende kunder telefonisk, hvor du f.eks. gennemgår deres abonnementer eller yder hjælp via vores kundeservicelinje. Det giver dig bred erfaring med både salg, rådgivning og kundeservice - noget der uden tvivl styrker dit CV.

Vi lægger stor vægt på støtte, samarbejde og udvikling i hverdagen. Hos os må du gerne være ny - vi sørger for at sætte dig godt ind i tingene!

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du behøver ikke at have salgserfaring, men måske kan du genkende dig selv i noget af dette:


Du er imødekommende og serviceminded og har let ved at tale med mange typer mennesker



Du motiveres af at gøre andre glade og yde god service



Du er nysgerrig på at lære og har lyst til at udvikle dig - både fagligt og personligt



Du trives i en aktiv hverdag med små succeser og tempo med et godt hold af kollegaer


Uanset om du holder sabbatår, er nyuddannet eller i gang med at skifte retning - så er du velkommen hos os.

Hvad får du hos os?


En arbejdsplads med plads til forskellighed, støtte og stærkt fællesskab



Onboardingdage på hovedkontoret og grundig oplæring fra erfarne kolleger i butikken, så du bliver hjulpet godt i gang



Gode udviklingsmuligheder - både i rollen og i din videre karriere hos 3. Du kan læse mere om mulighederne, bl.a. 3Academy, her



Fast grundløn, provision, mobil med betalt abonnement, sundhedsforsikring, pension og gode rabatter


Sådan søger du

Vedhæft dit CV og en ansøgning, hvor du kort fortæller lidt om dig selv og hvorfor du gerne vil være en del af 3. Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker stillingsopslaget ned, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

title: Partner Management Associate
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About The Role:

  • You will be responsible for the entire life cycle management of big events since the sales and legal team has signed the commercial contract till the events' final closing
  • You will be the main point of contact between all the stakeholders, from the event organizer to all the internal teams involved.
  • Although being the overall owner of the whole process you will work as part of a team, you will be in charge of making things happen in time and form by managing other department's tasks.
  • Communicate product needs (Fever usability) and process needs to HQ, and work with product/engineering to deliver on them. to have a consolidated list of all the requirements and prioritize them with the product team.
  • Create and maintain exhaustive Q&A to have an answer to potential user incidences managed by our user support team.
  • Make sure that all the requirements needed to achieve the project goals have all the necessary documentation
  • Depending on the event, your presence on-site might be required during the launch or other important dates

About You:

You are degree qualified, with a project management background. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and pride yourself on your flexible, detail-oriented, analytical, and organized mindset.

In order to be successful in this role, you will be expected to be an entrepreneurial individual. The role requires a mix of project management and operational experience. You will have to be very comfortable coordinating other departments to ensure the delivery of requirements on time, also delivering results in an ambiguous environment, being exceptionally detail-oriented while looking around corners.

  • 1+ years in a project management role or consulting background. This is not a position for an events background, but having event experience is a plus.
  • Fluent level of English and Spanish, other languages are a plus!
  • Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You will also have strong analytical, relationship management, and organizational skills.
  • You'll be solution-focused, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions.
  • You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships.
  • Highly organized and efficient
  • Curious and keen to push boundaries and try new concepts
  • Able to communicate with events partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
  • Ability to think strategically when faced with an events partnership brief or with our proprietary data on what events work
  • Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work-streams
  • Collaborative and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks
  • Knowledge of promotional tools such as Facebook and Instagram is a plus
  • Strong academic background is a plus

Benefits & Perks:

  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader!
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Home office friendly!
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people
  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee.
  • English and/or Spanish Lessons
  • Gympass membership
  • We have free food, drink and fruit at the office!
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. title: Patient Relations Officer - KSA
description:
We are hiring an experienced Patient Relations Officer for reputed Company in Saudi Arabia

Job Purpose

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for patients and their families.

  • Deliver excellent customer service.

  • Address patient concerns and ensure a positive patient experience.

  • Facilitate communication between patients and healthcare providers.

  • Support high standards of patient care and satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Follow departmental policies, SOPs, and procedures.

  • Perform daily duties in accordance with established standards.

  • Welcome patients and visitors.

  • Assist with patient registration and appointment scheduling.

  • Respond to inquiries and provide general information.

  • Handle patient complaints, concerns, and grievances professionally.

  • Escalate unresolved issues when required.

  • Act as a liaison between patients, families, and medical staff.

  • Communicate patient feedback accurately and diplomatically.

  • Educate patients and visitors about hospital services, policies, and procedures.

  • Maintain accurate records of patient interactions and complaints.

  • Ensure confidentiality and data security.

  • Collect patient feedback through surveys and direct communication.

  • Support continuous service improvement initiatives.

  • Ensure compliance with hospital policies, infection control, and confidentiality regulations.

  • Coordinate with medical, administrative, and support departments.

  • Assist in organizing patient engagement activities and orientation sessions.

  • Comply with safety, health, and environmental procedures.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a hospital or clinical environment.

  • Bachelor's Degree in: Healthcare Administration / Public Relations / Nursing

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer based in Spain.

This role offers the opportunity to build and evolve scalable software solutions that support the future of global workforce management.
You will contribute to a modern technology platform designed to simplify complex international processes and enable businesses to operate without borders.
Working within a remote-first engineering environment, you will solve challenging technical problems while influencing architecture, development practices, and product evolution.

title: Staff AI Product Engineer
description:
Location 📍: Sydney, AU, Hybrid (3 days in office required)

About Us 🚀

At Relevance AI, we’re building the home of the AI workforce.

Our mission is simple: empower every team to delegate meaningful work to AI agents that think, act, and collaborate like experts.

With Relevance AI, anyone can create and manage intelligent agents that handle workflows, decisions, and collaboration - all within one unified platform. Our technology already powers industry leaders such as Canva, Databricks, Confluent, Autodesk, Lightspeed, Rakuten, Aveva, Qualified, and Activision Blizzard, helping them scale excellence across operations, marketing, and sales.

We’re backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Insight Partners, Peak XV, and King River Capital, and raised our Series B in April 2025 to accelerate growth and push the boundaries of agentic automation.

Headquartered in San Francisco and Sydney, we operate on a hybrid model and thrive on curiosity, collaboration, and execution - we move fast, think big, and win together.

In 2025, we were proud to be named LinkedIn’s #1 Startup in Australia.

If you want to define how the world works with AI, join us.

The Role 🥳

The greatest engineers today aren't just writing code faster—they're spending more time solving problems and building products that couldn't have existed a year ago.

Our team works at the frontier of AI-native development where curiosity, product thinking, rapid experimentation and judgement are embedded in our ways of working.

As a Staff Engineer, you'll be one of our core product builders and cross-team technical leader. You’ll set the technical direction behind our most advanced AI capabilities: agents that can act with increasing autonomy on real work. You'll raise the bar for AI engineering and reliability across teams, and take on the hardest, highest-leverage problems in the company, being deployed onto whatever is most critical at the time. This is the most senior IC seat in the company and a chance to define what AI-native engineering means here - and beyond.

You'll have access to the latest frontier models, rethink traditional software patterns and work closely with customer-facing teams to quickly turn ideas into shipped products.

We are willing to sponsor engineers relocating from overseas to Australia.

How We Build ⚒️

We believe that AI is fundamentally changing software and what it means to be an engineer. That means our team works differently:

  • AI engineering (coding agents, loops, eval) is a core part of every engineer's workflow.

  • Engineers own product areas and customer problems end-to-end, not just implementation.

  • We prototype quickly, validate with customers, and iterate relentlessly.

  • We ship continuously, often multiple times a day.

  • We care about product impact as much as technical quality.

If you enjoy experimenting with frontier models, trying new tools, and constantly improving how you build software, you'll fit right in.

Meet The Team 👋

  • Paulwyn, Head of Engineering

  • Peter, Engineering Manager

Your Impact 💥

  • Set technical direction on load-bearing decisions for frontier AI products; unblocking teams and raising the standard of design and review.

  • Deploy onto our hardest problems, ship in days what takes traditional teams months.

  • Raise the bar on AI-native engineering practices; defining the agentic workflows, context engineering, and eval discipline for all of engineering to adopt.

  • Own the challenging parts of making autonomous agents trustworthy in production; turn incident patterns into systemic improvements.

  • Partner closely with product, design and customer teams to decide what we build, kill low-value work and ship outcomes that truly move the needle.

  • Interview, mentor and level up other engineers to multiply their impact.

Who We’re Looking For 🧠

In one-line: a staff AI-native builder; the person a team turns to for their hardest problems - product-minded, deep AI expertise and raising the bar in small fast-moving teams.

You'll likely thrive here if you demonstrate:

  • AI-Native Building: You operate at the frontier of what is possible with coding agents — using AI in novel ways to decompose problems, orchestrate build-run loops, and implement systemic improvements to keep evaluation and review quality high.

  • Product Thinking & Judgement: You think like a product owner and care deeply about the right thing being built to meet customer outcomes, not tickets. You can talk about who used your product and why it mattered.

  • Deep Engineering Craft. You bring technical depth and strong judgement, particularly in backend, APIs, distributed systems and making load-bearing decisions.

  • Cross-Team Leverage. You’ve improved teams beyond your own; unblocking others and setting standards that other people have adopted.

  • Delivery speed and reliability. You ship continuously, balancing pace with quality — and you take evals, on-call, and root-cause fixes seriously.

  • Belief in our mission. You raise the standard for people around you, you're comfortable with ambiguity and pace, and you believe a smaller AI-native team can out-build a larger, traditional one.

Our Tech Stack (so far) 💻

Experience in our exact stack is not required — what matters more is how fast you can pick up a new one, and how deeply you already use AI coding agents as part of your daily workflow.

  • Frontend: React, Vue.js, Typescript

  • Backend: Express.js, Node.js, Typescript, Python

  • Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB

  • Cloud Infrastructure: AWS, Vercel, Terraform, Kubernetes

  • AI Coding Tools: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and more

Why Join Us? 🌟

  • Work at the forefront of AI with a nimble team that is constantly pushing boundaries. We encourage and celebrate ideas that drive our mission forward.

  • We’ve set high standards in our high-trust, low-ego environment. We hire exceptional people to do the best work of their lives. In return, we reward our people with competitive salaries, equity stake, unparalleled professional growth, and career-defining opportunities.

  • Relevance AI is well-funded by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Insights Partners, Peak XV, and King River Capital.

  • As an early team member, you’ll play a key role in shaping our future—including our culture, ways of working, and even the benefits we offer. We’re laying the foundations now, and your ideas can help define what comes next.

Benefits ✨

  • 📈 ESOP – Employee Stock Ownership Plan so you can grow with the company

  • 🤖 AI Productivity Benefit – Get up to $1200 USD/year to spend on AI tools that help you work smarter and grow your skills

  • 👶 Parental Leave – We offer 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all eligible new parents, and an additional 6 weeks for the birthing parent

  • 🎉 Milestone Merch – Celebrate your work anniversaries with customised Relevance AI swag

  • 🍿 Food, Drinks & Community – Stay energised with free breakfasts, healthy snacks, and a fully stocked fridge of drinks. Enjoy team lunches provided every Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, plus Uber Eats dinners and regular catered office meals throughout the week. As the home of the AI workforce, we also host vibrant community events featuring thought leaders, industry partners, and the wider tech community.

  • 🪩 Quarterly Team Events – Build stronger connections through fun, meaningful team bonding experiences every quarter

  • 🏓 Social Clubs – Share your hobbies and interests by joining or starting a club with your teammates. From hiking and chess to board game nights and social committee activities—there’s something for everyone!

  • 🧠 Sonder EAP – Access 24/7 mental health and wellbeing support through Sonder, our Employee Assistance Program

title: Seniorutvikler
description:
Entur er et teknologiselskap med et samfunnsoppdrag: Vi bygger den digitale infrastrukturen som gjør kollektivtransporten enklere å bruke i hele Norge.

Vi samler inn og forvalter data fra tog, buss, ferger og andre transportaktører, men data skaper først verdi når de er enkle å finne, forstå og bruke. Når en analytiker skal svare på et spørsmål, en produkteier skal ta en beslutning eller en partner skal bygge en ny tjeneste, må riktig data være tilgjengelig på en trygg og effektiv måte.

Det er dette Team Dataplattform bygger. Andre team i Entur lager og eier datasettene og dashboardene og vi bygger produktene der de blir funnet, forstått, styrt og delt. Hverdagen din er fullstack produktutvikling der domenet er data, ikke datamodellering og analysespørringer. KI og økende forventninger til selvbetjening endrer samtidig hva slike produkter kan være, og vi utforsker det aktivt.

Hva du vil jobbe med

  • Utvikle produktene våre i en moderne stack med Kotlin, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript og Google Cloud Platform.
  • Designe og bygge API-er, backend-tjenester og frontend-løsninger som sørger for at data ikke stopper i datavarehuset (BigQuery), men blir tilgjengelige gjennom produkter som skaper verdi for brukerne.
  • Løse utfordringer innen autentisering, autorisering, datadeling og tilgangsstyring på tvers av team og organisasjoner.
  • Sette teknisk retning gjennom arkitektur, kodegjennomgang og sparring med resten av teamet.
  • Utforske hvordan KI kan gjøre oss til et bedre produktteam, både gjennom smartere utviklingsprosesser og bedre tjenester.

Hvem er du

Du er en senior fullstack-utvikler som liker å løse problemer, ikke bare implementere spesifikasjoner. Du bygger løsninger som varer, ser helheten i systemene og tar ansvar for at teknologien skaper verdi for brukerne.

Å ta ansvar faller deg naturlig, og du tar initiativ når du ser muligheter for forbedring. Du deler kunnskap, gir konstruktive tilbakemeldinger og bidrar til at teamet rundt deg blir bedre. Samtidig er du pragmatisk og vet når det er riktig å investere i en robust løsning, og når en enklere tilnærming er det beste valget.

Du er nysgjerrig på ny teknologi og er like komfortabel med å diskutere arkitektur som å forklare tekniske valg til kolleger med ulik bakgrunn. Siden vi jobber tett med resten av organisasjonen, er det viktig at du kommuniserer godt på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

Vi tilbyr

  • Du blir med tidlig i et team på seks og får være med å forme hvordan teamet jobber, ikke bare hva det bygger.
  • Et samfunnsoppdrag med produkter som brukes av både Entur og aktører i kollektivsektoren.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø innen data, analyse og utvikling.
  • Tid og budsjett til kurs, konferanser og faglig utvikling.
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn, god pensjonsordning og fleksibel arbeidshverdag med mulighet for hjemmekontor.
  • Kontor i Oslo sentrum (Rådhusgata).

Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser,
fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning.

Som offentlig eid selskap er vi pålagt å ha offentlige søkerlister. Dersom du ønsker å reservere deg fra
oppføring må dette begrunnes. Du vil bli varslet om reservasjon ikke tas til følge.

title: Credit Controller
description:
About Us

inforcer is one of the fastest growing technology organisations in the world and a leading provider of cutting-edge cybersecurity and AI solutions to support to the SMB market. We provide MSPs (Managed Service Providers) with the fundamental technology they need to manage and secure Microsoft 365 at scale and deliver AI services. Our mission is to be inforced in every MSP!

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and motivated Accounts Receivable & Credit Control Lead to join our team. In this role, you will take ownership of our customer billing, payments, collections, and cash management across a high-volume, lower-value customer environment — ensuring efficient, accurate, and scalable processes across the full order-to-cash cycle. If this sound like you, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own and manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process across a growing, high-volume customer portfolio, ensuring accurate and timely invoicing, cash allocation, and account reconciliation.

  • Manage incoming payments across multiple channels — including bank transfers, Stripe, GoCardless, and direct debits — overseeing payment matching and reconciliation across customer accounts, payment platforms, bank accounts, and finance systems.

  • Resolve failed payments, payment exceptions, billing queries, and customer account issues, maintaining strong controls around customer balances and AR reporting.

  • Take ownership of credit control and collections across a high-volume, lower-value SaaS customer base, developing structured, scalable processes that support business growth.

  • Improve cash collection performance and reduce overdue balances, managing aged debt, escalation processes, and customer follow-ups.

  • Monitor and improve key metrics including overdue debt, failed payments, and debtor days (DSO), identifying payment trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Review AR, billing, payment, and collection processes and lead initiatives to simplify, automate, and scale the order-to-cash cycle while reducing manual work.

  • Support the implementation and optimisation of finance systems, billing tools, payment platforms, and reporting solutions, creating clear processes, controls, and documentation to support future growth.

  • Act as the key Finance contact for billing, payments, collections, and customer account queries, building strong relationships across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and Finance.

  • Provide clear reporting and insight to leadership on collections performance, cash risks, and improvement opportunities, and support month-end activities including debtor reporting, reconciliations, and cash reporting.

What We Can Offer You

Steep Learning curve: We believe people leave organisations when learning stops. We promise a steep and continuous learning curve to both challenge and develop our people. You are responsible for your own learning, but you’ll be surrounded by exceptional people and strong enablement, if you choose to lean into it, in an environment where it’s safe to make mistakes, try new things, and improve.

Real impact: We operate in a high-trust and autonomous environment where you can make a real impact and difference in your role and across the company.

Transparency and Honesty: We believe honest and clear communication creates a highly collaborative culture. It gives you the “why” we make decisions and allows you to effectively make your own. We won’t pull the wool over your eyes, we are a fast-growing start-up that comes with its own unique challenges, but we all work hard to solve them, together, as a team.

A+ Global Team: Our people power every part of our business, and we look for individuals who bring genuine passion to their role and operate at their very best. A-players thrive when surrounded by other A-players. Our level of growth and rate of change can be hard work and challenging, but you’ll be surrounded with exceptional people that are always happy to help.

Regular Team Socials: We celebrate our team, our milestones, promotions and achievements with social events every month.

Employee Recognition: Programs to recognise and reward our top contributors for their achievements and efforts. We live our company values every day and reward those people who embody them.

Skills We Need for This Role

  • Strong experience within Accounts Receivable, Credit Control, Billing Operations, or Order-to-Cash roles, ideally managing a high-volume customer or transaction environment.

  • Proven ability to improve collections processes and reduce overdue debt.

  • Experience managing multiple payment methods including Stripe, GoCardless, direct debits, and bank payments, with a strong understanding of payment reconciliation, cash allocation, and AR controls.

  • Track record of implementing process improvements and driving operational change.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and turn insight into action.

  • Confident using finance systems, reporting tools, and Excel.

  • Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager, able to build relationships, influence across teams, and challenge constructively to drive accountability.

  • Highly organised, proactive problem solver with a continuous improvement mindset and strong attention to detail.

  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, scaling environment, taking ownership of processes from start to finish.

  • Desirable: experience within SaaS, subscription, or recurring-revenue businesses, and exposure to finance transformation or billing automation projects.

inforcer is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Bērnu preču nodaļā

Tu zini, kā iedzīvināt IKEA preces gaumīgā interjerā mūsu veikalā, katalogā, tiešsaistē un citur, kur vien tās ir redzamas. Krāsas, tekstūras un priekšmetus tu spēj pārvērst iekārtojumā, kas piesaista skatienus, uzbur sirsnīgu māju sajūtu un pārliecina IKEA pircējus, ka tieši to viņi vēlas arī savā mājoklī. Tavs redzējums un tavas idejas iedvesmo ikvienu radīt skaistu vidi sev apkārt. Parādi, kā tev tas izdodas!

Kādi būs tavi pienākumi

  • Piedāvāt mājokļa labiekārtošanas preces pircējiem, palīdzēt izvēlēties labākos risinājumus un preces, dalīties savā pieredzē un zināšanās par produktiem.

  • Aktīvi piedalīties pārdošanas procesā un ikdienas darbā, lai nodrošinātu veikala efektīvu darbību un klientu apkalpošanu.

  • Rūpēties par kārtību nodaļā, sagatavot zāli nākošajai dienai.

  • Kontrolēt preču izkārtojumu tirdzniecības zonā, rūpēties par to, lai veikals katru dienu izskatītos kā nupat atvērts.

  • Atbalstīt nodaļas vadītāju ikdienā – plānot darba grafiku, prioritizēt veicamos darbus, sekot līdzi pārdošanas rezultātiem un veicināt to pieaugumu.

  • Aizvietot nodaļas vadītāju prombūtnes laikā, uzņemoties pilnu nodaļas darba pārraudzību - koordinēt un motivēt komandu, risināt ikdienas situācijas un izaicinājumus, kā arī nodrošināt efektīvu sadarbību un kvalitatīvu klientu apkalpošanu.

Prasības kandidātiem

  • Vēlama pieredze mazumtirdzniecībā un nelielas komandas vadībā.

  • Izcilas pārdošanas un komunikācijas prasmes.

  • Spēja pielāgoties pārmaiņām mainīgā vidē un izvirzīt prioritātes.

  • Datorprasmes ļoti labā lietotāja līmenī.

  • Interese par mājokļa iekārtošanu un interjera dizainu.

  • Iespēja strādāt maiņu darbu (arī nedēļas nogalēs un brīvdienās atbilstoši darba grafikam, laika posmā 09:00-21:00).

  • Atalgojums 8,30 EUR stundā pirms nodokļu nomaksas.

  • Gada bonuss, kas atkarīgs no uzņēmuma biznesa rezultātiem.

title: Mechanical Maintenance Specialist (RM)
description:
Maintenance Specialist is responsible for the operation of raw materials unloading facilities and implementation of maintenance services for all equipment, machines and systems to ensure the safety, reliability, availability and efficiency of all plant machinery and equipment.

1. Raw Materials Unloading Operations & Maintenance

1a. Supervises raw materials unloading operations ensuring maximum feed rate of discharging machines/equipment used and that unloading time does not exceed existing standards.

1b. Plans and implements repairs and maintenance works of all unloading equipment and machines ensuring that the procedures applied and replacement parts used conform to product specifications and repairs are in accordance with the applicable standards.

1c. Troubleshoots unloading equipment ensuring that these run properly during raw material unloading operations.

1d. Attends vessel shifting during hatch transfer and coordinate with the vessel crew.

1e. Coordinate and collaborate with Silomen and vessel crew during raw materials unloading to ensure efficiency of the operations

1f. Monitors critical spare parts and ensures availability when needed.

1g. Monitors and analyzes equipment condition and implements corrective action to abnormalities encountered.

Machines and Equipment Maintenance

2a. Implements repairs and maintenance works of equipment and machines scheduled by the Maintenance Planner ensuring that the procedures applied and replacement parts used conform to product specifications and repairs are in accordance with the applicable standards.

2b. Regularly performs reviews, recommends and implements a cost-effective maintenance program to ensure effective maintenance of critical and non-critical units, based on the root causes identified from previous problems encountered, condition monitoring and time-based tasks ensuring that identified problems do not recur.

2c. Establishes and implements a maintenance monitoring plan for critical and non critical machines. Checks and analyzes the data of the operating conditions of equipment/machine regularly and recommends to CMD Manager and/ or Maintenance Planner necessary measures to ensure safe and cost-efficient operations.

2d. Evaluates the workmanship of repair, fabrication and reconditioning works of all spare parts ensuring that the parts met the required specifications and standard.

2e. Establishes and maintains an efficient materials/ spare parts requisition system. Monitors the requisitions ensuring that the spare parts requested and received will meet the required specifications and that the inventory is kept lean while supply of materials is available when needed.

3. Other Related Functions

3a. Establishes, maintain, recommends and implements a good housekeeping program for all areas supervised to ensure compliance to food safety standards set by HACCP & GMP.

3b. Implements company policies, procedures and guidelines on safety and accident prevention for manpower and machinery at all times.

3c. Conducts performance appraisal as scheduled and required. Identifies and recommends to CMD Manager developmental training needs of subordinates.

3d. Assures the accuracy and completeness of all drawings, files, engineering records, reports, prints, and tasks of assigned projects.

3e. Performs related work as maybe assigned by the immediate superior.

Education:

  • Graduate of BS Mechanical/Electrical Engineering Technology

Experience:

  • 5 years experience in related work for BSME of BSEE

  • 3 years experience for Mechanical Engineering Technology graduate

title: Studievejleder til fast fuldtidsstilling på Handelsgymnasiet i Roskilde
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe de bedste rammer for unges trivsel, udvikling og uddannelse? Så er du måske den nye studievejleder, vi søger til en fast fuldtidsstilling.

Som studievejleder spiller du en vigtig rolle i at støtte elever gennem deres gymnasietid og bidrage til, at de trives, udvikler sig og gennemfører deres uddannelse. Du bliver en del af et stærkt team på tre studievejledere og en vigtig sparringspartner for elever, forældre, lærere og ledelse.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • støtte og fastholde elever, herunder løbende opfølgning på fravær

  • afholde ad hoc samtaler med elever, der har brug for støtte til faglige, sociale eller personlige udfordringer

  • planlægge og afholde elev- og forældresamtaler i samarbejde med ledelsen med fokus på faglige udfordringer og generel trivsel

  • sikre et tæt samarbejde mellem studievejledning, kontaktlærere, klasseteams og ledelse

  • planlægge og udføre fællesskabsopbyggende aktiviteter for elever/klasser

  • vejlede grundskoleelever og forældre på for eksempel uddannelsesmesser og åbent hus.

Afhængig af din baggrund, kompetencer og interesser kan andre arbejdsopgaver komme i spil.

Du kan blive en del af vores gymnasium, hvis du:

  • brænder for at arbejde med unge og kan skabe stærke relationer

  • kan sætte klare rammer og tydeligt kommunikere konsekvenser ved brud på disse

  • selvstændigt kan strukturere, planlægge og prioritere dine arbejdsopgaver

  • har en positiv indstilling og kan håndtere udfordringer konstruktivt, både individuelt og i samarbejde med kollegaer

  • også trives med de administrative opgaver knyttet til vejlederfunktionen.

Vi er åbne overfor din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund. Det er en fordel, hvis du kender til gymnasiesektoren, men erfaring fra fx andre ungdomsuddannelser eller i vejledning i udskolingen, UU-vejledning og lignende er også relevant.

Tiltrædelse
1. oktober 2026.

Ansøgningsfrist
20. august 2026. Samtaler afholdes i uge 35.

Ansøgning med CV sendes samlet i ét pdf-dokument til studievejleder@rhs.dk.

Alle kvalificerede ansøgere opfordres til at søge - uanset alder, køn, kønsidentitet, seksuel orientering, etnicitet, religion, handicap eller baggrund.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling. Ansættelse og aflønning sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og den pågældende organisation.

Mere information
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte viceuddannelseschef Rikke Lücking Larsen på telefon 8852 3230.

Om skolen
Roskilde Handelsskole rummer merkantile erhvervsuddannelser, Handelsgymnasiet samt efteruddannelse for både kursister og virksomheder. På Handelsgymnasiet har vi 1350 årselever.

Fælles for vores uddannelser er et tydeligt fokus på erhvervsrettet og businessorienteret undervisning, hvor faglig viden kobles tæt til praksis, virkelighed og samfund. Tætte relationer til erhvervslivet er en naturlig del af hverdagen og bidrager til, at undervisningen opleves relevant, aktuel og meningsfuld.

Vi arbejder målrettet med at forberede eleverne til både videre uddannelse og arbejdsliv gennem anvendelsesorienteret undervisning, tydelige faglige forventninger og et stærkt fokus på dannelse, ansvar og samarbejde.

Elevernes trivsel er en central forudsætning for læring. Derfor prioriterer vi et trygt miljø med gode relationer mellem elever og medarbejdere. Trivselsarbejdet er integreret i dagligdagen og sker i tæt samspil mellem lærere, studievejledere og ledelse.

Alle uddannelser er samlet på én adresse på Bakkesvinget 67 i Roskilde, hvor vi har et levende og inkluderende studiemiljø med plads til både faglig fordybelse og fællesskab på tværs af uddannelser, årgange og klasser.
