Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

Roku is seeking a Senior Counsel, Employment and Labor to join its Legal team, providing strategic guidance on a broad range of employment, labor, benefits, and related matters across the UK, EMEA, and global operations. In this role, you will partner closely with People Business Partners, People Shared Services, Compensation & Benefits, and other cross-functional teams to translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable advice. You will draft and negotiate employment agreements, settlement agreements, and other key documents, while managing employment-related claims, litigation, and outside counsel relationships. You will monitor evolving employment legislation and proactively drive compliance strategies and risk mitigation across the organization. This position requires an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, innovative environment, balancing multiple priorities and stakeholders. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in UK employment and labor law, with exposure to additional EMEA or international jurisdictions, and a commitment to practical, business-oriented legal counsel.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, AI agents and AI-enabled tools handle a growing share of first-draft, repetitive, analytical, and execution-heavy work across the company. Our people lead those systems; setting direction, providing context, exercising judgment, and stepping in when work needs correction or deeper thinking. If you are excited about working this way, we want to talk to you.

You can describe specific examples where you used AI tools, agents, or workflow automation to move faster, raise quality, or scale your impact. You frame problems well, guide AI-assisted work, verify results, and ramp quickly in unfamiliar domains. Above all, you bring curiosity, adaptability, good judgment, and a willingness to learn new ways of working. At Roku, we're embracing AI as a powerful tool to amplify human creativity, accelerate innovation, and deliver better results for our customers. Across teams, we're exploring how AI can enhance our work—and we're only looking for people who are curious, adaptable, and excited to grow alongside these technologies.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Advise People Business Partners, People Shared Services, Compensation & Benefits, and other partner teams on employment matters including hiring, performance management, grievances, disciplinary actions, investigations, redundancies, reorganizations, and wage and hour compliance
  • Provide counsel on agency worker and contractor engagement, reasonable accommodations, flexible work requests, leaves of absence, employee privacy, data security, benefits, TUPE transfers, and works councils
  • Support the development and maintenance of a global employment and labor framework, including handbooks, policies, and procedures
  • Research and monitor employment legislation and legal developments, proactively implementing compliance and risk-mitigation strategies
  • Review and advise on contractual agreements with third-party service providers, vendors, and staffing agencies, as well as internal practices for engaging contingent workers
  • Draft and negotiate employment agreements, performance and disciplinary notices, settlement agreements, and other employment-related documentation
  • Advise on complex and sensitive employment matters, facilitating pre-dispute resolution and positioning the organization for potential employment litigation
  • Manage employment-related claims and litigation globally, including overseeing outside counsel, responding to complaints and settlement demands, and negotiating resolutions
  • Assist with preparing, reviewing, and implementing employee training programs
  • Support additional legal projects and initiatives as needed

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • Qualified legal professional with 6 or more years of post-qualification experience advising on employment and labor matters at a law firm or in-house legal department
  • Deep knowledge of UK employment and labor laws, with exposure to additional EMEA jurisdictions or India preferred
  • Prior in-house legal experience strongly preferred
  • Experience advising on employment and labor issues in the technology, entertainment, or content production industries preferred
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and deadlines across stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively across departments and functions
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Proactive approach to identifying and suggesting process improvements
  • Ability to work independently with an entrepreneurial mindset
#LI-ST1

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit .

title: PM4 Stock Shift Operator
description:
Job Description – PM4 Stock Shift Operator

Position: PM4 Stock Shift Operator
Location: Ayodhya
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 6–10 years
Qualification: ITI/Diploma

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced PM4 Stock Shift Operator to lead stock preparation operations and ensure a consistent supply of high-quality stock to the paper machine. The role is responsible for maintaining process stability, optimizing fiber utilization, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure uninterrupted supply of quality stock to the paper machine for smooth production.
  • Monitor and control stock preparation processes to maintain consistency and process stability.
  • Manage fiber preparation, raw material mixing ratios, and furnish quality as per production requirements.
  • Monitor refining operations, freeness, and stock quality parameters to achieve desired paper properties.
  • Control chemical and additive dosing while optimizing consumption and maintaining product quality.
  • Support wet-end process performance, including retention, drainage, formation, and basis weight stability.
  • Monitor process parameters, identify abnormalities, and implement timely corrective actions.
  • Supervise pumps, agitators, screens, chests, and other stock preparation equipment while coordinating preventive maintenance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with safety procedures, LOTO, TPM, 6S, and workplace housekeeping standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, reduce process losses, improve fiber yield, and optimize operating costs.

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of stock preparation operations.
  • Expertise in refining and stock quality control.
  • Knowledge of chemical dosing systems and process additives.
  • Good understanding of wet-end processes and paper machine operations.
  • Equipment monitoring and maintenance coordination.
  • Knowledge of TPM, 6S, CLTI, and workplace safety practices.

title: Timelønnede medarbejdere søges til Nordsjællands Krisecenter
description:
Er du super fleksibel og kan tage vagter på alle tider af døgnet?

Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel, som vikar på et krisecenter?

Er du klar til at yde en indsats for kvinder og børn i en sårbar situation, så kan det være dig vi søger på Nordsjællands Krisecenter. Vi mangler engagerede, fleksible og omsorgsfulde timelønnede medarbejdere til vores faste vikarkorps.

Nordsjællands Krisecenter har plads til 14 kvinder og deres medfølgende børn. Krisecenteret har til formål at drive tilbud efter Servicelovens §109, hvor kvinder over 18 år kan få midlertidigt ophold, hvis de har været udsat for vold, trusler om vold, eller tilsvarende krise i relation til familie- eller samlivsforhold. Der ydes omsorg og støtte i forhold til den enkelte kvindes,- og barns, behov og situation, og der kan iværksættes social, pædagogisk, psykologisk, juridisk og økonomisk støtte og bistand.

Nordsjællands Krisecenter er i en spændende udvikling og flytter ved udgangen af 2026 til nye rammer i Hundested. Indtil flytningen vil arbejdsstedet være i Gilleleje. Vi søger derfor timelønnede medarbejdere, som ønsker at være en del af denne udvikling og er indstillet på at fortsætte ansættelsen i de nye rammer.

Som tilkaldevikar på Nordsjællands Krisecenter skal du være i besiddelse af gode relationelle og menneskelige kompetencer, og kunne arbejde selvstændigt.

Du kommer til at indgå i et eksisterende medarbejderkorps, som varetager vagter, både dag- aften og nat, i weekender og i ferier.

Medarbejderkorpset deltager i møder hver 3. måned sammen med daglig leder og en fast medarbejder.

På Nordsjællands Krisecenter kan vi tilbyde dig følgende:

Et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du bidrager til en vigtig samfundsmæssig opgave.

En arbejdsplads med mulighed for at styrke og udvikle din erfaring inden for socialfagligt arbejde.

Et fleksibelt vikarjob med skiftende arbejdstider, herunder dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.

En hverdag præget af faglighed, engagement og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Mulighed for at præge det daglige arbejde og bidrage med dine faglige og personlige kompetencer.

Grundig introduktion og mulighed for løbende sparring med erfarne kolleger.

Et respektfuldt, støttende og trygt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på både borgere og medarbejdere.

Vi forventer at du:

Møder mennesker med varme, ro og respekt og har evnen til at skabe tryghed i en sårbar livssituation.

Er nærværende og kan være til stede i nuet – både i samtaler og i hverdagens små og store behov.

Har blik for børnenes trivsel og møder dem med forståelse, tålmodighed og omsorg.

Trives med en hverdag, der rummer både relationelt arbejde og praktiske opgaver på en døgninstitution.

Er en god kollega.

Har gode skriftlige evner.

Er fleksibel i forhold til opgaver og kan træde til, hvor der er behov.

Har mulighed for – og lyst til – at byde ind på vagter med kort varsel, og kunne byde ind på 2–4 vagter om måneden.

Er i gang med, eller har en relevant uddannelse, eller på anden måde har interesse for socialfagligt arbejde.

Arbejder ansvarsfuldt og med respekt for tavshedspligt og fælles rammer.

Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i dette stillingsopslag, så send os din ansøgning.

Det er et krav, at du har kørekort til alm. bil og kan fremvise en tilfredsstillende børne- og straffeattest.

Frist for ansøgning d. 08.09.2026.

Der afholdes løbende samtaler.

Om os

Nordsjællands Krisecenter er et sikret døgntilbud jf. SL § 109, som tilbyder midlertidigt beskyttet ophold til kvinder og deres medfølgende børn, som har været udsat for vold, trusler om vold eller tilsvarende krise i nære relationer. Krisecenteret råder over 14 pladser og er beliggende i naturskønne omgivelser.

Under opholdet ydes omsorg og støtte i relation til den enkelte kvindes eller families situation og behov, og der koordineres en helhedsorienteret indsats med interne og eksterne aktører.

Empowerment er som tilgang grundlæggende for vores daglige arbejde, og en vigtig værdi er derfor at respektere kvindernes valg, normer og værdisæt – og lade disse være retningsanvisende for den enkeltes forløb under opholdet. Vi arbejder anerkendende og ressourceorienteret med fokus på at understøtte en udviklende proces, hvor der gennem samtaler, støtte og vejledning styrkes blik for ressourcer, handlefrihed og muligheder.

Nordsjællands Krisecenter er en del af Den Socialfaglige Organisation ApS, som er en landsdækkende virksomhed med mere end 250 ansatte. En organisation, som er specialiseret i at lave tilpassede løsninger af høj kvalitet på det socialfaglige område med mennesket i centrum. Vi vægter et godt arbejdsmiljø, kvalitet og ordentlighed højt i vores måde at drive virksomhed på.

title: Salgsrådgiver til Volkswagen Helsingør - en del af Semler Mobility Joboplysninger | SEMLER
description:
Salgsrådgiver til Volkswagen Helsingør - en del af Semler Mobility
     
                         
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 
         Job ID: 
         

     4544

					 Helsingør, DK, 3000
					 
			 


			
     
                 

             

         

     

    
    
 
        
   
         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
                 
 Har du solid erfaring med salg og er du klar til at fortsætte din karriere i Danmarks største bilkoncern?
 
 Vi søger en salgsrådgiver, der brænder for kunderejsen, stærke relationer og salg af nye og brugte Volkswagen-modeller.
 
 Om jobbet
 Du rådgiver kunder, driver salgsprocessen og sikrer, at hver kunde får en tryg og professionel oplevelse. I dialogen med kunderne løser du deres behov og formidler den rette finansiering og forsikring. 


 Som en del af salgsteamet arbejder du i et miljø, der fokuserer på teamwork og resultater. Du samarbejder samtidigt med værksted og reservedelsafdeling for en stærk samlet kundeoplevelse. 


 
 Om dig
 Vi leder efter en erfaren salgsprofil med minimum 5 års erfaring fra en lignende stilling. Du brænder for god service og kan kommunikere med mennesker på alle niveauer. Du arbejder detaljeorienteret og kvalitetsbevidst med kundehåndteringssystemer, og tal skræmmer dig ikke.  


 Du skal være indstillet på weekendarbejde. Kendskab til vores brands er en fordel.
 
  


 Vi tilbyder 

 

 Løbende relevant uddannelse og produkttræning på nye modeller - så du kan rådgive kunderne bedst muligt 


 Lønpakke med fast løn + bonus 


 Firmabil, frokostordning samt fordelagtige medarbejdergoder
 
  

 

 Hvad kan du forvente af mig som leder 
 Salgschef Christoffer udtaler: "Du kan forvente, at jeg arbejder målrettet for at få det bedste frem i hver enkelt medarbejder og i teamet som helhed. Jeg tror på, at tydelighed skaber tryghed, og derfor vil du altid opleve en klar retning, hvor du ved, hvad der forventes af dig, og hvor vi er på vej hen. Jeg prioriterer åben dialog, tillid og samarbejde, så vi sammen kan udvikle os, tage ansvar og skabe stærke resultater. Samtidig ønsker jeg at skabe et arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til sparring, udvikling og forskelligheder, og hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at lykkes". 


 
 Om os
 Semler Mobility i Helsingør er en del af Semler Gruppen, som er Danmarks største koncern i bilbranchen med over 100 års erfaring inden for import, salg og service af biler. Vi repræsenterer nogle af de stærkeste brands på markedet, bl.a. Volkswagen, Audi, Skoda, SEAT, CUPRA og Porsche samt andre Premium mærker.  
 Vi har et positivt arbejdsmiljø, hvor humor og en målrettet indsats går hånd i hånd. Vi værdsætter samarbejde og imødekommende kommunikation i teamet. Kommer du fra København og tænker, at Helsingør lyder langt væk, så overvej alligevel at søge - turen tager typisk ca. 40 minutter i bil, ofte mod trafikken. 


 
 Lyder det som noget for dig?
 Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Ansøgninger behandles løbende, og tiltrædelse er hurtigst muligt eller efter nærmere aftale. Ansøgningsfrist er den 4. september. 


   


 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Salgschef Christoffer Monberg på telefon 20598346.
 
  

                 
     
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
     
                 

             

         

     


    
 
        
 
         

     

                                         

                                        
 
    
    
 
        
   
         

     

    
 
        
  

     

    
    
 
        
   Din vej. Fælles fremtid  


 Som ny kollega i Semler Gruppen bliver du en del af et stort fællesskab på mere end 3000 kollegaer. Vi er fordelt over hele landet, og arbejder med alt fra landbrugets tungeste maskiner til selvkørende teknologi og delebiler.   



 At være en del af en stor organisation betyder, at der er talrige muligheder for at udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt. Vi har f.eks. en hel uddannelsesafdeling, som tilbyder efteruddannelse og certificeringer i samarbejde med vores producenter. Sidst men ikke mindst kan vi hjælpe dig på vej med vores udviklingsværktøj GROW, som intelligent og systematisk matcher dine kompetencer op imod udviklingsmulighederne i Semler Gruppen.  



 Alle er vi forenet af et sæt fælles værdier, der fungerer som den daglige gps for vores måde at arbejde på.   



 Vi er ordentlige. Vi holder hvad vi lover, også når det kræver en omvej. Sådan er det, når ambitionen er at have de mest tilfredse kunder og leverandører i de brancher vi opererer i.   



 Vi er dedikerede. Vi står distancen og kommer i mål.   



 Vi er nytænkende. Fordi man ikke bliver Danmarks største bilaktør af at køre på autopilot.  



 Vi har glimt i øjet. Med respekt for hinanden og godt humør bliver det rarere at gå på arbejde.

title: Business Analyst
description:
We're searching for an experienced Business analyst who will focus on understanding and analyzing automotive markets, customer forecasts, and Mobileye's commercial portfolio. The core of this role is to gather and interpret data from customers, market databases, and internal systems; challenge assumptions; and provide decision-ready insights to management, alongside Finance, Operations, Strategy, and Business Development at Mobileye.

The ideal candidate thrives on analysis, planning, and self-learning, works confidently with external stakeholders and global internal teams, and is motivated to improve recurring processes through automation, dashboards, and AI-assisted workflows.

What will your job look like:

  • Conduct automotive market intelligence: track industry trends, vehicle production and sales, competitive activity, and other external developments.
  • Analyze business and industry data - customer forecasts, project volumes, financial inputs, and key operational metrics, using Excel, BI tools, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Support Mobileye's forecasting process and provide market and competitive context.
  • Analyze Mobileye's projects and customer data and connect detailed assumptions to the broader company outlook.
  • Communicate with external customers and internal teams to gather information, clarify data, and support ongoing planning cycles.
  • Work with Sales/BizDev, Finance, Operations/Supply Chain, Strategy, and global teams to share data, resolve gaps, and support planning discussions.
  • Prepare clear documentation, presentations, and management-ready summaries that translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Identify opportunities to improve recurring workflows - define business processes, build dashboards, and develop AI agents and automations (e.g., using Cursor, Claude, and similar tools) to make analysis faster, more reliable, and repeatable.

All you need is:

  • At least 4 years of relevant business analyst or analytical experience, ideally in automotive, manufacturing, or commercial analysis
  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Data Science, or a related field (MBA - an advantage)
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with large, imperfect datasets
  • Advanced Excel and solid experience with BI tools (Power BI, Qlik Sense, or similar)
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to improve the day-to-day tasks, build workflows, dashboards, or automations
  • Excellent English - written and spoken; comfortable presenting to management and working with international stakeholders
  • Process-oriented, self-driven, and able to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Familiarity with the automotive OEM/Tier-1 ecosystem and forecasting cycles - Advantage
  • Experience with automotive market databases (e.g., S&P Global Mobility / IHS) - Advantage

title: Jip Medewerker Rotterdam
description:
We zoeken een proactieve mbo-professional die jongeren weet te bereiken, zowel offline als online. Je voelt je net zo thuis in een gesprek op straat of op school als achter je laptop, waar je creatieve content bedenkt om het JIP zichtbaar te maken.

Je hebt gevoel voor social media en weet hoe je jongeren aanspreekt met pakkende beelden, video's en berichten. Je vindt het leuk om mee te denken over campagnes, promotie en de online uitstraling van het JIP. Ervaring met programma's zoals Canva en het maken van content voor Instagram, TikTok of andere socialmediakanalen is daarbij een grote pré.

Over DOCK

In elke wijk zijn verhalen te vinden: van mensen die elkaar helpen, dromen najagen of soms even vastlopen. Bij DOCK staan we middenin de wijk – we kennen de verhalen. Je vindt ons op straat, in het buurthuis, online en op school, en we luisteren naar wat er echt speelt. We verbinden mensen, openen deuren en laten zien wat wél kan. Zo groeien netwerken, ontstaat vertrouwen en worden buurten sterker. We doen dat menselijk, betrokken en deskundig — altijd met optimisme en ambitie voor duurzame impact. Want niemand hoeft er alleen voor te staan. Samen met bewoners en partners bouwen we aan gemeenschappen waar iedereen meetelt en mee kan doen.

Over de functie

We zoeken een proactieve mbo-professional met affiniteit voor online jongerenwerk, social media en het actief vergroten van onze zichtbaarheid onder jongeren en samenwerkingspartners.

Bij het JIP Rotterdam onderdeel van DOCK, kunnen jongeren van 12 t/m 27 jaar anoniem terecht met al hun vragen. Dit kan gaan over geldzaken, huisvesting, onderwijs, werk, seksualiteit, alcohol en/of drugs. Geen vraag is ons te gek!

Vaak spelen er vragen op meerdere leefgebieden tegelijk. Samen met de jongere gaan we hier praktisch mee aan de slag. Dit kan variëren van een enkelvoudige hulpvraag tot complexe vraagstukken. De meeste vragen hebben betrekking op financiële problemen en dak- of thuisloosheid. Affiniteit met financiële dienstverlening is daarom belangrijk.

Het JIP organiseert verschillende spreekuren in Rotterdam, waar jongeren zowel met als zonder afspraak welkom zijn. We ondersteunen jongeren ook digitaal via WhatsApp, videobellen en telefonisch. Daarnaast geven we lessen en cursussen op scholen over verschillende onderwerpen, met een sterke focus op preventie rondom financiën.

Bij het JIP werken we informeel en zonder vooroordelen. We staan naast de jongere en kijken met een frisse blik naar de toekomst. We begeleiden, motiveren en coachen hen op hun weg vooruit. Ook als het even tegenzit, blijven we samen zoeken naar oplossingen.

Onder het JIP valt ook het Geldmattie-project: een peer-to-peer initiatief waarbij jongeren langdurige ondersteuning krijgen bij vragen over geldzaken.

Wat ga je doen

• Je begeleidt en adviseert jongeren bij uiteenlopende hulpvragen, met een duidelijke focus op geldzaken. Motiverende gespreksvoering is hierbij erg belangrijk.
• Je maakt het JIP zichtbaar in de stad: je gaat outreachend te werk en spreekt jongeren actief aan op straat, op scholen en tijdens activiteiten.
• Je promoot het JIP bij jongeren, scholen en samenwerkingspartners en bouwt actief aan een netwerk.
• Je geeft lessen en trainingen aan groepen jongeren, samen met een collega en/of stagiairs. Je staat hierbij met vertrouwen voor de groep.
• Je bedenkt, ontwikkelt en voert social media- en promotieactiviteiten uit om de zichtbaarheid en naamsbekendheid van het JIP te vergroten.
• Je onderhoudt online contact met jongeren en denkt mee over innovatieve manieren om jongeren te bereiken.
• Je denkt creatief mee over online communicatie en promotie

Wie ben jij

• Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding richting sociaal werk (mbo).
• Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden.
• Je hebt oprechte interesse in jongeren en begrijpt hun leefwereld.
• Je hebt kennis van en ervaring met het werken met (risico-) jongeren.
• Je kent de sociale kaart van Rotterdam of bent bereid je deze snel eigen te maken.
• Je hebt kennis van of interesse in financiële hulpverlening.
• Je werkt zelfstandig, maar functioneert ook goed in een team.
• Je voelt je comfortabel om voor groepen jongeren te staan en vindt het leuk om lessen en trainingen te geven.
• Je stapt makkelijk op jongeren af en vindt het leuk om zichtbaar aanwezig te zijn in de wijk en in contact te komen met jongeren.
• Je bent een proactieve netwerker die initiatief neemt om het JIP op de kaart te zetten.
• Je hebt affiniteit met online jongerenwerk, social media en het vergroten van zichtbaarheid en naamsbekendheid.
• Je bent creatief en denkt graag mee over nieuwe ideeën voor content, activiteiten en promotie.

Bij DOCK geloven we in mensenwerk met hart en ziel. Dat betekent werken vanuit veiligheid, respect en integriteit. We verwachten dat je handelt volgens onze gedragscode, professioneel samenwerkt, zorgvuldig omgaat met vertrouwelijke informatie en grenzen bewaakt in contact met bewoners en collega’s.

Een VOG maakt onderdeel uit van de procedure.

Wat bieden wij jou

• Een informele werksfeer waarin je echt het verschil maakt en naast de jongere staat.
• Salaris conform CAO Sociaal Werk: MBO schaal 6 (min €2903,- tot max €4335,- obv 36 uur).
• Een jaarcontract voor 24 uur per week met de ambitie tot verlenging.

• Jouw werkdagen stemmen we samen af tussen dinsdag en vrijdag.

• Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals het Individueel Keuzebudget, Loopbaanbudget, korting op je zorgverzekering en deelname aan het pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn.

Solliciteren

Ben je geïnteresseerd? Solliciteer dan via en upload je cv en motivatie voor 20 augustus 2026.

Voor inhoudelijke vragen over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Shulayka via telefoonnummer 06-59993002.
Voor vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure kun je mailen naar recruitment@dock.nl.

title: Security Operations Engineer (Contractor)
description:
Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer-facing work actually succeed.

Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous Great Place to Work accolades, including Built In's 100 Best Midsize Places to Work in SF 2025, Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025, Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023, #4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™ ,Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list, and Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List.

Read more about Front's expansion into Chile!

Front powers the way teams communicate with their customers — and security is foundational to keeping that trust. We’re looking for a Senior Security Operations Engineer to help protect Front’s customers, employees, and platform by strengthening detection, response, and security operations at scale.

This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, can move quickly from signal to action, and enjoys building durable systems and playbooks — not just fighting fires. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, IT, Legal, and Business leaders to reduce risk, respond to incidents, and continuously raise the security bar across the company.

What will you be doing?

  • Own end-to-end security incident response, including triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident learnings

  • Build and continuously improve detection coverage across cloud, endpoint, identity, and SaaS systems

  • Develop security automation and workflows to reduce manual toil and improve response speed

  • Lead investigations into suspicious activity, account compromise, and potential data exposure events

  • Partner with Engineering and IT to harden systems, improve logging/telemetry, and close recurring control gaps

  • Drive readiness through tabletop exercises, runbooks, metrics, and operational reviews

  • Manage security tooling configuration and tuning (SIEM, EDR, IAM, alerting) to reduce noise and increase fidelity

  • Communicate clearly during high-severity situations, aligning stakeholders on impact, status, and next steps

What skills and experience do you need?

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Operations, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, or similar security roles

  • Strong understanding of attacker techniques and defensive strategies across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network surfaces

  • Hands-on experience with SIEMs, EDR platforms, and investigation workflows (including log querying and alert tuning)

  • Ability to AI tools to streamline security operations and response

  • Experience building incident response processes, playbooks, and operational metrics that scale with company growth

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence Engineering and IT partners without relying on authority

  • Calm, structured decision-making under pressure, with strong written incident communication

  • AI fluency: ability to use AI tools to accelerate investigations (summarization, clustering, query generation) while validating outputs and protecting sensitive data

This role offers the option to work from our Santiago office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays to collaborate with the team and stay connected, though in-office attendance is not required.

What we offer

  • Competitive monthly rate

  • 6-month contract with a possibility of extension

title: IT-Tekniker / Fälttekniker
description:
IT-Tekniker / Fälttekniker

Diversa Solutions AB

Vill du arbeta med modern teknik, hjälpa människor och vara en del av ett växande teknikföretag?

Diversa Solutions AB söker nu engagerade, lösningsorienterade och serviceinriktade IT-tekniker som vill vara med och leverera professionella tekniska tjänster till både privatpersoner och företag runt om i Skåne.

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint teknikintresse, uppskattar kundkontakt och trivs med ett varierande arbete där ingen arbetsdag är den andra lik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas inom flera teknikområden och bli en del av ett företag med höga ambitioner där kvalitet, professionalism och kundservice står i fokus.

Du planerar ditt arbete tillsammans med arbetsledningen och ansvarar för att varje uppdrag genomförs effektivt, säkert och med högsta möjliga kundnöjdhet.

Tjänsten innebär arbete ute hos kunder över hela Skåne och du utgår från planerade kunduppdrag enligt företagets schema.

Arbetsuppgifter

Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat bestå av:

  • Installation och konfigurering av datorer och arbetsstationer.
  • Installation av nätverk, routrar, accesspunkter och WiFi-lösningar.
  • Felsökning och reparation av datorer, mobiltelefoner, TV och annan hemelektronik.
  • Installation av skrivare och övrig kringutrustning.
  • Installation och konfigurering av Smart Home-lösningar.

  • Installation och driftsättning av larmsystem.
  • Installation och felsökning av TV- och medielösningar.
  • Montering och installation av teknisk utrustning hos privatpersoner och företag.
  • Teknisk support på plats hos kund.
  • Underhåll, service och funktionskontroller av installerad utrustning.
  • Dokumentation av utförda arbeten enligt företagets rutiner.
  • Rådgivning till kunder kring tekniska lösningar och framtida förbättringar.
  • Säkerställa att varje uppdrag genomförs med hög kvalitet och god kundnöjdhet.


Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på uppdrag, vilket gör tjänsten både utvecklande, omväxlande och stimulerande.

Vi söker dig som

Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, ansvarstagande och har ett stort intresse för teknik.

Du tycker om att lösa problem, arbetar strukturerat och noggrant samt trivs med att möta människor i olika miljöer. Du är flexibel, självgående och har lätt för att skapa förtroende hos kunder genom ett professionellt bemötande.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Ett stort tekniskt intresse.
  • God problemlösningsförmåga.
  • God samarbetsförmåga.
  • Ett professionellt kundbemötande.
  • Förmåga att arbeta självständigt.
  • God datorvana.
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.
  • Grundläggande kunskaper i engelska.
  • Förmåga att planera, prioritera och organisera ditt arbete.


Krav

  • B-körkort för manuell växellåda.
  • Möjlighet att arbeta runt om i hela Skåne.
  • Ostraffad och lämplig att arbeta ute hos kunder.
  • God fysisk förmåga då vissa installationer kan innebära lyft och praktiskt arbete.

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande områden:

  • IT-support.
  • Nätverk.
  • Fiberinstallation.
  • Elektronikreparation.
  • Smart Home.
  • Kameraövervakning.
  • Larmsystem.
  • Installationsteknik.
  • Telekom.
  • Fältservice.
  • Kundservice.


Tidigare erfarenhet är dock inget krav. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlighet, ansvarstagande, engagemang, servicekänsla och viljan att utvecklas tillsammans med företaget.

Vi erbjuder

Hos Diversa Solutions AB får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som befinner sig i en spännande utvecklingsfas där kvalitet, innovation och kundservice står i centrum.

Vi erbjuder bland annat:

  • Ett varierande och utvecklande arbete.
  • Intern utbildning inom våra tjänster, arbetsmetoder och tekniska lösningar.
  • Möjlighet att utvecklas inom flera teknikområden.
  • Ett självständigt arbete med stort eget ansvar.
  • Ett engagerat team med korta beslutsvägar.
  • Moderna arbetsmetoder och tydliga rutiner.
  • Möjlighet att växa tillsammans med företaget och på sikt ta större ansvar.


Anställningsform

Tjänsten inleds som en behovsanställning (timanställning) tills vidare, där arbetspassen planeras utifrån verksamhetens behov och aktuella kunduppdrag. Detta ger dig möjlighet att successivt komma in i arbetet, utveckla dina kunskaper och bli en viktig del av vårt team.

Vi tror på att investera långsiktigt i våra medarbetare. För dig som visar ett stort engagemang, levererar arbete av hög kvalitet, tar ansvar och bidrar till företagets utveckling finns mycket goda möjligheter att växa inom organisationen.

Efter sex månaders anställning kan du, beroende på verksamhetens behov samt din prestation och lämplighet, erbjudas en heltidsanställning med fast månadslön. Vår ambition är att skapa långsiktiga anställningar för medarbetare som delar våra värderingar och vill utvecklas tillsammans med Diversa Solutions AB.

title: Fysioterapeut till geriatrisk slutenvård Bromma
description:

Vården bedrivs i multiprofessionella team i nära samarbete mellan personal, patient och närstående och tillsammans utvecklar vi ambitiösa, kvalitativa och hållbara rehabiliteringsinsatser med individen i fokus. Som fysioterapeut hos oss erbjuds du ett varierat arbete i en stimulerande miljö där du träffar patienter med olika diagnoser. Vi arbetar teambaserat och tätt ihop med andra kollegor i teamet så som arbetsterapeuter, dietister, kuratorer och logopeder. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår bland annat:

  • Bedömning och kartläggning av aktivitets- och mobilitetsförmåga
  • Individuell träning och uppföljning
  • Utprovning och förskrivning av hjälpmedel

Vi arbetar med journalsystemet TakeCare.

Hos oss får du

  • En gedigen introduktion
  • En familjär, positiv och inkluderande arbetsplats där vi lär av varandra
  • Kompetensutveckling med tillgång till interna och externa utbildningar
  • En närvarande, lyhörd och engagerad chef
  • Ett grymt-roligt och professionellt team!

Är du vår nya kollega?

Vi söker dig som;

  • Är legitimerad fysioterapeut
  • Har god datorvana
  • Behärskar svenska språket obehindrat i tal och skrift

Erfarenhet från sjukhusvård är meriterande.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och för att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har god initiativ- och omställningsförmåga samt en positiv inställning till ditt arbete. Du är kommunikativ, arbetar strukturerat och håller en hög servicenivå i mötet med patienter. Med ett prestigelöst förhållningssätt och ett gott bemötande bidrar du även till ett positivt arbetsklimat. Du trivs med variation i arbetet och uppskattar möjligheten att växla mellan ett teamorienterat och individuellt arbetssätt, och därmed bidra med dina perspektiv och kompetens i ett större sammanhang.

Mer information

Tjänsten är heltid, tillsvidare med helgtjänstgöring var 9:e lördag, start enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och provanställning.

Har du ytterligare frågor om tjänsten så besvaras dem av enhetschef Annica Blix 08-122 830 16. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi arbetar för en trygg och säker hälso- och sjukvård. Därför genomför vi bakgrundskontroller som en del i vår rekryteringsprocess och innan anställning. Kontrollerna kan variera beroende på roll. På vår informationssida kan du läsa mer om vilka kontroller som ingår.

Stockholms Sjukhem arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens för att främja att vi är en arbetsplats för alla. Vi har tagit ställning till annonsering, vilket gör att vi inte önskar säljsamtal för ytterligare frågor kring annonsering, rekrytering eller bemanning.

title: Principal ML Scientist – Predictive Toxicology
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal ML Scientist – Predictive Toxicology based in Spain.

This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of machine learning applications in life sciences and drug discovery.
You will lead the scientific strategy behind predictive toxicology and quantitative biology initiatives, transforming complex biological data into impactful AI-driven solutions.
Working at the intersection of machine learning, computational biology, and pharmaceutical research, you will help develop models that improve therapeutic discovery and decision-making.
The position combines scientific leadership with hands-on technical contribution, allowing you to influence both product direction and customer outcomes.
You will collaborate with industry partners, researchers, and technical teams to integrate advanced modelling approaches into real-world workflows.
This is a high-impact opportunity for a scientist who wants autonomy, ownership, and the chance to advance AI-powered innovation in healthcare.

Accountabilities:

The Principal ML Scientist will own the expansion of predictive toxicology and quantitative biology capabilities, defining scientific direction and delivering machine learning solutions that create value for life sciences partners.

  • Lead the development and execution of the scientific strategy for predictive toxicology, quantitative biology, and related drug discovery workflows.
  • Define modelling approaches, biological endpoints, and data strategies that support better safety and efficacy decisions in pharmaceutical research.
  • Build and optimize machine learning models using advanced molecular AI techniques, including approaches such as graph neural networks, message-passing architectures, and transformer-based models.
  • Apply federated learning approaches to enable collaborative model development across multiple organizations while maintaining data privacy and ownership.
  • Integrate scientific workflows involving areas such as multi-omics, image-based screening, high-throughput screening, and compound prioritization into scalable solutions.
  • Collaborate directly with customers and scientific partners, leading discussions around evaluation, adoption, delivery, and roadmap development.
  • Translate complex scientific challenges into practical AI solutions that can be incorporated into real drug discovery programs.
  • Mentor other scientists and contribute to building future scientific capabilities within the organization.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in machine learning applied to life sciences with strong scientific leadership and the ability to work independently across technical and customer-facing environments.

    • PhD or equivalent experience in computational biology, cheminformatics, toxicology, machine learning, or a related scientific discipline.
    • 6+ years of experience applying machine learning techniques to drug discovery, computational biology, or life science challenges.
    • Strong understanding of deep learning methods for molecular AI and predictive modelling.
    • Proven experience developing predictive toxicity models and supporting their adoption within pharmaceutical or industrial research environments.
    • Knowledge of toxicity assessment workflows, including areas such as DILI, cytotoxicity, genotoxicity, or related safety endpoints.
    • Experience working with biological datasets such as RNA-seq, toxicity screening data, image-based screening, or high-throughput screening workflows.
    • Ability to define scientific vision, lead technical discussions, and communicate effectively with customers, partners, and internal teams.
    • Strong hands-on modelling skills combined with the ability to guide scientific strategy and mentor others.
    • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
    • Professional working proficiency in English.

      • Nice-to-have qualifications:

      • Experience with federated learning, privacy-preserving machine learning, or distributed AI systems.
      • Experience validating predictive toxicity models prospectively and influencing compound design or prioritization decisions.
      • Experience deploying production-grade ML solutions in regulated, enterprise, pharmaceutical, or biotech environments.
      • Publication record in computational biology, toxicology, or machine learning research.
      • Knowledge of multi-omics, high-content imaging, cell painting, or mechanistic biological frameworks.
      • Familiarity with public toxicology and bioactivity datasets such as Tox21, ToxCast, or LINCS/L1000.

        • Fully remote-first working model with flexibility to work from the location that suits you best.

title: Enterprise Sales Engineer
description:
About Rimes

Rimes provides the Intelligence Fabric for Capital Markets, a trusted data network and intelligence architecture that transforms fragmented data, operations and workflows into decision-grade intelligence. The world’s leading institutional investors, asset managers, and service providers rely on Rimes to help them make better investment decisions that power more than US$ 75 trillion in AUM annually.

Role Overview

The Enterprise Sales Engineer is a senior pre‑sales and solution‑design role, partnering closely with Enterprise Sales and Account Management to articulate and demonstrate the value of Rimes’ investment data managed services and investment intelligence platform.

  • Own the end‑to‑end technical sales process for complex enterprise engagements involving Rimes’ managed data solutions & investment intelligence & analytics platform
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to CIOs, COOs, Heads of Investment Data & Technology, Risk, Performance and Operations
  • Lead discovery with clients that goes beyond requirements gathering to expose structural data, governance, and operating‑model weaknesses
  • Lead engagements across Asia-Pacific region, with concentration of clients in ASEAN and Australia
  • Reporting to the Head of Enterprise Solutions, the Enterprise Sales Engineer plays a critical role in shaping client engagements, from early discovery through to solution design, demonstrations, proof‑of‑value, and transition to delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Client Discovery

  • Partner with the sales and account management teams by leading technical and functional discovery sessions with prospective clients to understand data, governance, technology and operating‑model challenges across their investment lifecycle
  • Design end‑to‑end Rimes solutions that support enterprise data management, portfolio oversight, rebalancing, data quality, operational resilience, and regulatory obligations

Solution Architecture

  • Design and articulate enterprise‑grade investment data architectures leveraging Rimes’ capabilities across:
    • Multi‑asset investment data management
    • Benchmarks, indices, reference data, pricing, ESG and research
    • Performance, risk, attribution, and regulatory reporting workflows
    • Data platform delivery and integration, including data lakehouse architectures (Databricks, Delta Lake), cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Azure Synapse) etc.
  • Translate highly nuanced client challenges (e.g. private markets data, custodian transitions, operating model evolution, regulatory compliance, internal vs outsourced models) into a coherent solution architecture

Pre‑Sales Execution

  • Own the technical pre‑sales engagement for Rimes solutions
    • Investment Data Managed Services, including benchmarks, indices, ref data, pricing, research, ESG, corporate actions
    • Investment Intelligence platform supporting Total Portfolio View (TPV), rebalancing under Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) and the transition to Total Portfolio Approach (TPA)
  • Deliver scenario‑driven and compelling product demonstrations that mirror real client operating models rather than generic functionality walkthroughs
  • Lead high‑stakes proof‑of‑concepts, balancing depth, speed, and commercial impact
  • Articulate measurable business outcomes, not just technical success

Commercial & Proposal Support

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to position Rimes strategically against incumbent vendors and internal build options
  • Own the technical narrative across RFPs, RFIs and executive presentations - not just answering questions, but shaping evaluation criteria
  • Capture detailed client requirements into Statements of Work and support accurate scoping of implementation and managed services

Internal Collaboration

  • Ensure a seamless handover of pre‑sales engagements to Professional Services and implementation teams by providing context on solution intent, client priorities, and success criteria to support efficient implementation
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams
  • Contribute to internal enablement through knowledge sharing, solution artefacts, and best‑practice frameworks

Product & Market Feedback

  • Act as a conduit between clients, Sales, Product, and Engineering by qualifying product enhancement requirements and sharing market intelligence to help evolve Rimes’ go-to-market strategies.

Skills & Experience

Required

  • Strong experience in financial services, investment management, or capital markets
  • Deep understanding of investment data domains and operational workflows (pricing, benchmarks, corporate actions, reference data, analytics)
  • Proven experience in pre‑sales, solutions engineering, or consulting roles within enterprise technology or data platforms
  • Ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders
  • Experience of Asia-Pacific clients unique challenges including exposure to large asset owners, Sovereign Wealth Funds and Australian Superannuation industry.
  • Familiarity with modern data platform technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, or cloud-native data warehouses; ability to articulate Rimes’ data delivery within clients’ existing data lakehouse and cloud architectures.

Core Capabilities

  • Consultative, outcome‑oriented client engagement style
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including executive‑level presentations
  • Ability to work autonomously while thriving in a collaborative, high‑performance team environment
  • Commercial awareness and comfort supporting solution scoping and deal strategy
  • Ability to leverage AI-tools effectively to drive operational efficiency

You Will Thrive in This Role If You:

  • Are energized by complex client investment data and technology challenges
  • Can articulate with authority enterprise investment data flows from source data to regulatory disclosure
  • Are intellectually curious to understand the development of investment data & technology eco-system and evolving business models
  • Are equally credible speaking to:
  • Investment professionals
  • Data engineers
  • Risk & compliance leaders
  • Technology executives
  • View pre‑sales not as support, but as strategic enterprise enabler

Why Rimes

  • Work with some of the world’s largest and most sophisticated asset owners and managers
  • Be part of a firm shaping the future of investment data management and operational resilience
  • Influence product direction, solution design, and client success at enterprise scale
  • Operate in a collaborative, intellectually demanding, and growth‑focused environment

Only selected candidates will be contacted for interviews. We appreciate your understanding. Thank you for considering a career with us.

Rimes is committed to promote the values of diversity and inclusion throughout the business. Whether it’s through recruitment, retention, career progression or training and development, we are committed to improving opportunities for people regardless of their background or circumstances.

Visit our Careers page to see our complete listings.

title: Innovation and Education Programme - Intern
description:
About UN University (UNU)

The United Nations University (UNU) is a global think tank and postgraduate teaching organization within the United Nations System. UNU engages in policy-relevant research, capacity development, and knowledge dissemination in furtherance of the purposes and principles of the United Nations. The work of UNU contributes to solving pressing global problems that are the concern of the United Nations and its Member States.

For the past five decades, UNU has been a source of impartial research on sustainability, human security, and economic development. With hundreds of researchers working at institutes in 12 countries, UNU's expertise spans the full breadth of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, generating policy-relevant knowledge to effect positive global change. UNU collaborates closely with other UN entities and leading research institutions across the globe. For more information, please visit http://unu.edu

About Office/Institute

United Nations University, Institute for the Advanced Study of Sustainability (UNU-IAS) is one of 13 research and training Institutes that comprise the think tanks in the UNU system. UNU-IAS is a UNU institute based at UNU Headquarters in Tokyo. The mission of UNU-IAS is to serve the international community through policy-relevant research and capacity development focused on sustainability, including its social, economic and environmental dimensions. Through its postgraduate education programmes UNU-IAS develops future international leaders with interdisciplinary understanding and skills needed to advance creative solutions to problems of sustainability. UNU-IAS builds on a strong tradition of UNU research and capacity development in Japan, undertaken in collaboration with a global network of professionals and scholars, particularly in Africa and Asia. For more information, please visit

IVE Programme

The Innovation and Education (IVE) Programme aims to promote research and practices on innovative and inclusive education and lifelong learning for sustainable development at all ages. It reinforces evidence-based policy advice to translate global goals into local actions through education in a close alignment with UN’s Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) for 2030 Roadmap and Greening Education Partnership.

About the project

The project provides support to the newly established UN HESI Action Group, “Futures of Higher Education and AI.” The Action Group, comprising AI experts from higher education institutions across all regions, seeks to advance a shared knowledge base on the role of AI in accelerating progress toward sustainable development. Its work will focus on four core domains: (i) AI in research and development; (ii) AI in teaching and learning; (iii) AI in university management and administration; and (iv) AI ethics, safety, and inclusivity. The project is also designed to enhance synergies with two other UNU-IAS led higher education networks operating at regional, and national levels: a regional Asia-Pacific higher education network promoting sustainability in postgraduate education (), and a national higher education platform in Japan advancing the SDGs through education (SDG-UP). The Action Group will generate a suite of knowledge products across these domains, including podcast episodes, webinar sessions, publications, capacity building activities, and dialogues at key United Nations events. All activities will emphasize the nexus between AI, sustainable development, and higher education, with particular attention to human centred approaches to AI, leveraging perspectives from the Global South and pioneering women in AI innovation and building activities and dialogues at key United Nations events.

This is a full-time internship (35 hours per week), primarily based on site at UNU-IAS in Tokyo.

Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Academic Programme Officer of the Innovation and Education Programme, the Intern shall provide overall assistance to the project, with particular focus on coordination, communication, knowledge product development, and reporting, including the following:

1. Support the inter-network taskforce for three major networks of higher education: Higher Education Sustainability Initiative (HESI), Promotion of Sustainability in Postgraduate Education and Research Network (), and SDG-University Platform (SDG-UP)

  • Support the coordination of activities, including scheduling and attending regular meetings, recording meeting minutes and following up on the discussed matters, and facilitating and monitoring internal communication

  • Assist in the organization of various events (such as webinars, workshops and conferences), including preparation of materials, participant coordination, and drafting the activity reports.

2. Support the production of knowledge products from the project

  • Contribute to the production of podcast episodes and webinars on the topics of AI, sustainability and higher education, including identifying/communicating with speakers, promoting, recording, editing and disseminating

  • Support to ensure the participation of the three networks in the development of the project’s knowledge products.

3. Support reporting and project documentation

  • Assist in drafting the project reports capturing key activities, outputs, and achievements;

  • Archive and maintain the project records and documentation in a well-organized filing system

4. Performing other duties assigned by the supervisor.

Competencies

Values:

  • Inclusion — take action to create an environment of dignity and respect for all, regardless of age, culture, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, geography, grade, language, nationality, racial identity, religion, sex, sex characteristics, sexual orientation, social origin or any other aspect of identity

  • Integrity — act ethically, demonstrating the standards of conduct of the United Nations and taking prompt action in case of witnessing unprofessional or unethical behaviour, or any other breach of UN standards

  • Humility — demonstrate self-awareness and willingness to learn from others

  • Humanity — act according to the purposes of the United Nations: peace, dignity and equality on a healthy planet

Behaviours:

  • Connect and collaborate — build positive relationships with others to advance the work of the United Nations and work coherently as One UN

  • Analyse and plan — seek out and use data from a wide range of sources to understand problems, inform decision-making, propose evidence-based solutions and plan action

  • Deliver results with positive impact — hold oneself and others accountable for delivering results and making a positive difference to the people and causes that the United Nations serves

  • Learn and develop — pursue own learning and development and contribute to the learning and development of others

  • Adapt and innovate — demonstrate flexibility, agility and the ability to think and act in novel ways

1) Education and certification

  • University studies in one of the following disciplines: artificial intelligence, information technology, education, sustainable development, and international development, or a related field.

  • Be in their final year of undergraduate study or enrolled in a graduate degree programme or is within the two-year post-graduation (maximum) from either a bachelors’, masters’ or PhD degree programme.

2) Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Excellent research, writing, and analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize information clearly and accurately for different audiences.

  • Organizational and coordination skills, including the ability to support in-person and online meetings, events, communication processes, and multi-stakeholder engagement in an international setting.

  • Experience in drafting communication materials such as newsletters, event summaries, social media content, and other outreach documents.

  • Familiarity with digital tools for design and content-creation tools such as Canva, Adobe Suite tools, or similar platforms.

3) Language

  • Excellent communication skills (written and oral) in English are required;

  • Working knowledge of another UN language, including Japanese, is an advantage.

Duration

15 September 2026 – 15 March 2027 (tentative).

Stipend

Interns who are not in receipt of financial support from other sources such as universities or other institutions will receive a stipend from UNU to partially subsidize their basic living costs for the duration of the internship.

The monthly amount of the stipend will be determined for each duty station based on the stipend rates in effect. The stipend will be paid on a monthly basis including online internship and part-time internship arrangements are prorated accordingly.

Expected start date.

September 2026 (tentative)

How to Apply

To apply to UNU, you will not need an account. Instead, we ask that you:

  • Apply via the apply link;

  • fill out the UNU P11 Form (please avoid using similar forms provided by other United Nations organisations);

  • provide a motivation statement (in the P11 form);

  • answer a few questions that are tailored to the position.

You may wish to refer to the UN Values and Behaviours Framework for more information.

*Candidates invited for an interview must submit the following documents prior to the interview:

  • Document(s) confirming your education status (e.g. transcript or proof of enrollment).

Application Deadline

7 September 2026 (JST 11.59pm)

Assessment

Evaluation of qualified candidates may include a desk review and/or a competency-based interview, background checks and references.

Special notice

UNU does not sponsor a working visa for this position. Interns do not hold international civil servant status, nor are they considered a “staff member” as defined in the United Nations Staff Rules and Regulations. UNU is committed to diversity and inclusion within its workforce, and encourages all candidates, irrespective of gender, nationality, religious and ethnic backgrounds, including persons living with disabilities to apply. Applications from developing countries, and from women are strongly encouraged. UNU has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNU, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. If you have supervisory function you need to have awareness on gender related issues.

Information about UNU rosters

UNU reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNU.


Scam warning

UNU does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. Therefore, you are advised to apply particular care when submitting personal information on the web.

Ready to build the future of compliance?

If you’re ready to kickstart your career at the intersection of law and AI, apply today. We hire for potential, not just experience, so if this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

At Haast, we believe bold ideas come from diverse perspectives. We’re committed to building a team that reflects the world we work in; across gender, background, orientation, ability, and experience. Even if you don’t tick every box, let's chat!

title: Sjuksköterska till vårdavdelning hematologiska kliniken
description:
Vill du arbeta på en högspecialiserad vårdavdelning med fokus på kvalitet och patientsäkerhet samt medarbetaredrivna utveckling? Vi söker sjuksköterska till vårt engagerade team.

Hematologiska kliniken vid Universitetssjukhuset i Linköping bedriver högspecialiserad vård inom hematologi och har en stark forskningsinriktning. Vi finns i O-huset på Universitetssjukhuset.

Vårt erbjudande

Vi på hematologen lägger stor vikt vid våra medarbetares utveckling och engagemang. Vi strävar efter att skapa en god och hållbar arbetsmiljö där samarbete, delaktighet och trivsel står i centrum. Allt vi gör har ett tydligt fokus på patientnytta och kvalité i vården, där varje medarbetares kompetens och insats är en viktig del av helheten.

I början: personlig utveckling och cirka sex veckor lång strukturerad introduktion, med en handledare under hela introduktionen samt en långsiktig individuell utvecklingsplan. Under introduktionen sker utbildning inom säker läkemedel- och cytostatika hantering, teoretiska inläsnings dagar och auskultation på andra sektioner på kliniken som mottagning/dagvård, forsknings sjuksköterskor sektionen och cellterapienheten.

Senare:

  • karriärutvecklingsprogram inom Centrum för kirurgi, ortopedi och cancervård (CKOC) med möjlighet att specialisera dig inom något av våra kärnområden.
  • Fördjupad utbildning inom cytostatika hantering (cytostatikakörkort) och hematologiutbildning både internt och externt.
  • Fortutbildning intern utbildningstid regelbundet
  • Vidareutbildning som specialistsjuksköterska inom medicin eller onkologi med betald lön. Så småningom kan det erbjudas utökat uppdrag med fördjupat ansvarsområde för att främja medarbetare drivna utveckling.
  • Rotationsmöjlighet inom kliniken, till exempel mellan öppenvård/dagvård och avdelning finns.

I övrigt

  • Individuell schemaplanering i Tessa - möjlighet att arbeta två av sex helger i stället för varannan eller två av fem helger, tack vare systematiska bemanning med rotation mellan sektioner. Det ger bättre förutsägbarhet, jämnare arbetsbelastning och hållbar balans mellan arbete och fritid, samtidigt som vi optimerar klinikens bemanning och arbetsmiljö.
  • Möjlighet att arbeta med vidareutveckling av ett eget ansvarsområde inom omvårdnad erbjudas. Vi erbjuder möjlighet att schemalägga läs/administrations/ansvarsområde dag.
  • Ett närvarande ledarskap av vårdenhetschefer och samarbete med klinikens specialist- sjuksköterska och erfarna kollegor i det dagliga arbetet.

Läs gärna vår karriärstege för sjuksköterskor och även om dina förmåner hos oss.

Arbetsbeskrivning

På vårdavdelningen vårdas patienter med tumör- och bristsjukdomar inom det blodbildande systemet så som anemi, leukemi, lymfom och myelom. Det är arbetsuppgifter inom allmän och specifik medicinsk-hematologisk vård och omvårdnad, högspecialiserad vård inom cellterapi och stamcellstransplantation samt andra avancerade behandlingar.

Vi jobbar aktivt med kvalitetsarbete, är en ackrediterad stamcellstrans-plantations verksamhet enligt JAICE. Vi är även ackrediterade inom cancer och är en del av Linköping Comprehensive Cancer Center (LCCC). Det finns dagvård/mottagning, cellterapienhet och klinisk provningsenhet på kliniken. Vi utför senaste behandlingarna inom cellterapi så kallad CAR-T cellsbehandling (Chimeric Antigen Receptor) och BiTe-behandling.

Inom ramen för vårdverksamhetens strävan att erbjuda patientcentrerad och resurseffektiv vård har vi under det senaste året intensifierat arbetet med att utveckla och implementera polikliniska behandlingsformer och egenvård. Du som medarbetare får vara en del av ett innovativt team som ligger i framkant när det gäller att skapa trygg, säker och patientnära vård. Medicinsk omvårdnad är stor del av dagliga arbetet för sjuksköterskor.

Arbetsgrupp

Vi är en sjukskötersketät avdelning, har nära samarbete med undersköterskor, läkare och paramedicinare på kliniken (apotekare, dietist, fysioterapeut och kurator).

Om dig

Vi söker dig som ser helheten och beaktar både det större perspektivet och verksamhetens bästa i dina beslut och har ett genuint intresse för omvårdnad, särskilt inom cancervård och vill bidra till att utveckla omvårdnaden för våra patienter.

Krav:

  • Legitimerad sjuksköterska.
  • Svenskkunskaper motsvarande minst nivå C1 (goda kunskaper i svenska språket, både i tal och skrift).

Meriterande:

  • Över 1 års yrkeserfarenhet som sjuksköterska.
  • Erfarenhet av arbete inom hematologi inom slutenvård eller öppenvård eller både.
  • Erfarenhet eller intresse för rotationstjänst mellan öppenvård och slutenvård.
  • Specialistsjuksköterska.

Vi värdesätter dina personliga egenskaper. Vi tror att du är en person som är flexibel och kan anpassa dig utifrån rådande situation genom att växla mellan det planerade och det oförutsedda som händer. Att arbeta i team och ha en god kommunikation behövs för att lyckas lösa de uppgifter vi möter tillsammans.

Ansökan och anställning

Vill du veta mer är du välkommen att höra av dig eller varför inte, kom till oss några timmar och hospitera. Missa inte chansen att söka till oss! Se kontaktuppgifter nedan.

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Inför anställning i ett patientnära arbete inom Region Östergötland kommer du att få fylla i en hälsodeklaration.

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan! Om du behöver hjälp med att registrera i systemet, kontakta kundtjänst Stöd och service, 010-103 60 00, under kontorstid.

Till bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra externa aktörer och försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Region Östergötland har upphandlade avtal.

title: Software Engineer – AI-Assisted Full-Stack Developement
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer – AI-Assisted Full-Stack Development based in Portugal.

This role offers the opportunity to build modern software solutions while leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering workflows.
You will contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of scalable full-stack applications.
The position combines backend engineering, frontend development, cloud technologies, automation, and AI-powered coding practices.
You will work in a remote, agile environment alongside engineers, product teams, QA specialists, and data professionals.
By combining strong engineering principles with emerging AI capabilities, you will help deliver reliable and maintainable digital solutions.
This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced engineers and talented developers looking to grow in a forward-thinking technology environment.

Accountabilities

The Software Engineer – AI-Assisted Full-Stack Development will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining reliable software solutions while using AI-assisted tools to improve productivity, quality, and engineering efficiency.

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable web applications using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js.
  • Build and maintain REST or GraphQL APIs, including authentication, authorization, validation, schemas, resolvers, and error handling.
  • Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code or similar tools to accelerate development while ensuring code quality, security, maintainability, and test coverage.
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases, including data modeling, migrations, query optimization, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Implement asynchronous processing solutions using message queues such as RabbitMQ.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues, complex bugs, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation covering APIs, system behavior, and implementation decisions.
  • Develop and maintain automated tests, including unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.
  • Validate AI-generated code through testing, security reviews, performance analysis, and engineering best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to consistent quality standards across development processes.
  • Support CI/CD workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions or similar platforms.
  • Contribute to application deployment and maintenance within cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or DigitalOcean.
  • Work with infrastructure concepts including containers, environment configuration, secrets management, networking, and deployment pipelines.
  • Monitor applications using logging, observability, error tracking, and performance tools such as Grafana and Sentry.
  • Collaborate within Agile Scrum teams, participating in planning, refinement sessions, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a software engineer with strong full-stack development foundations, curiosity for AI-assisted engineering, and the ability to deliver reliable solutions in a remote environment.

    • Practical software development experience gained through professional work, internships, academic projects, open-source contributions, or strong technical portfolios.
    • Experience using AI coding assistants or similar AI development tools to build, debug, test, or maintain software.
    • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with FastAPI or similar Python web frameworks.
    • Experience developing frontend applications using React and JavaScript or TypeScript.
    • Experience building backend services using Python, Node.js, or both.
    • Understanding of REST or GraphQL API design principles.
    • Experience writing unit and integration tests and applying testing practices throughout development cycles.
    • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
    • Familiarity with Git, GitHub, pull requests, and code review workflows.
    • Understanding of software engineering principles including modularity, maintainability, security, and separation of concerns.
    • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and communication skills.
    • Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote environment.
    • Professional working proficiency in English.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred, though equivalent practical experience and strong portfolios are also considered.

      • Nice-to-have skills:

      • Experience designing GraphQL schemas, queries, mutations, subscriptions, and resolvers.
      • Familiarity with GraphQL libraries such as Strawberry, Graphene, Ariadne, Apollo, or similar technologies.
      • Experience with Playwright or other end-to-end testing frameworks.
      • Knowledge of CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
      • Experience deploying applications on cloud platforms such as DigitalOcean, AWS, Azure, or GCP.
      • Familiarity with Docker and container-based deployments.
      • Experience with observability and production support tools.
      • Experience with message queues such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Redis.
      • Experience integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into production applications.
      • Knowledge of authentication, role-based access control, API security, secrets management, and data protection practices.
      • Experience working in Agile Scrum product development environments.

        • Benefits

        • Fully remote work opportunity within the United Kingdom or compatible EU time zones.
        • Flexible remote-first working environment.
        • Opportunity to work with modern AI-assisted development practices.
        • Exposure to full software development lifecycle activities, from design to production support.
        • Collaboration with international engineering and product teams.
        • Opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies and scalable architectures.
