Ansøgninger behandles løbende, stillingen kan derfor være besat inden udløb.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig
Er du interesseret i at søge stillingen, bedes du sende en ansøgning, CV samt relevante bilag via "Søg stillingen" nedenfor. Grundet persondataforordningen modtager vi ikke CV og ansøgning på mail.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler, og jobbet kan derfor være besat inden fristens udløb.

title: Capaciteitsplanner - Stiens
description:
Met jouw talent voor plannen en overstijgend adviseren help je leidinggevenden vooruit, zodat medewerkers hun werk soepel kunnen doen en onze bewoners de zorg krijgen die ze verdienen. Heb jij hart voor de zorg en de ambitie om het verschil te maken met jouw advies? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Waar ga je werken?
Je komt te werken bij het capaciteitsbureau, onderdeel van de afdeling HR, waar het planbureau, recruitment en de flexpool samenwerken. Ons capaciteitsteam zorgt ervoor dat de juiste medewerkers op het juiste moment beschikbaar zijn en plannen op zo’n manier dat medewerkers ruimte en eigen regie ervaren, continuïteit gewaarborgd blijft en de kwaliteit van zorg optimaal is. Kortom, een uitdagende werkplek waar geen dag hetzelfde is!

Wat ga je doen?
Als ervaren capaciteitsplanner zorg je voor overzicht en balans in de roosters. Je vertaalt beleid naar planningen en werkt binnen de geldende afspraken en wet- en regelgeving. Daarbij signaleer je trends en knelpunten, adviseer je leidinggevenden en ondersteun je bij jaarplanning en capaciteitsvraagstukken. Hoewel je veel zelfstandig werkt, heb je dagelijks contact met collega’s en leidinggevenden.

Wie ben jij?
Met jouw verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en oog voor detail zorg je voor overzicht en balans. Je hebt accurate kennis van cao’s en wet- en regelgeving en weet dit praktisch toe te passen in jouw werk. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking met leidinggevenden, schakelt snel en neemt initiatief om processen soepel te laten verlopen. Naast deze eigenschappen beschik je over:

  • Meerdere jaren ervaring met personeelsplanning, bij voorkeur in de gehandicaptenzorg

  • Een afgeronde mbo-opleiding niveau 4 en kennis van planningssystemen

  • Ervaring met ONS is een pré.

Goed om te weten: je kunt in je werk te maken krijgen met verbale confrontaties. Daarom is het belangrijk dat je stevig in je schoenen staat en ook in uitdagende situaties rustig en professioneel blijft.

Wat krijg je van ons?
We hebben veel aandacht voor jouw persoonlijke en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Daarom kun je o.a. gebruik maken van de online leeromgeving van GoodHabitz, waarin je ruime keuze hebt uit diverse online trainingen. Daarnaast ontvang je:

  • Een goed salaris van max. € 3.902,00 bruto per maand o.b.v. 36 uur. De inschaling is afhankelijk van ervaring (FWG 40 conform cao GHZ)

  • Direct een vast contract voor 28-32 uur bij Alliade

  • Een passende reiskostenvergoeding, reizen met het ov wordt volledig vergoed

  • De mogelijkheid om een deel vanuit huis te werken

  • En nog meer aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een pensioenregeling en bedrijfsfitness.

Meer weten? We leren je graag kennen!
Ben je enthousiast geworden? Je kunt reageren tot en met woensdag 12 augustus 2026. Omdat we persoonlijk contact belangrijk vinden, nemen we snel contact met je op over je sollicitatie.

De sollicitatiegesprekken staan gepland op: maandag 17 augustus 2026.

Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je bellen met Judith Krol, coördinator capaciteitsmanagement, telefoonnummer 06-21660444. Heb je vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem dan contact op met Josefien Dam, corporate recruiter via 06-25407396 (ook via WhatsApp bereikbaar) of mail naar recruitment@alliade.nl.

Een geldige Verklaring omtrent Gedrag is verplicht en een voorwaarde voor benoeming: deze wordt door ons aangevraagd en betaald.

title: Software / Backend Engineer Apprentice
description:
About us

💙 Implicity is a digital MedTech, that brings outstanding innovations to cardiologists, thanks to Big Data and Artificial Intelligence.

Thanks to our leading cardiac remote monitoring platform, it’s way easier to manage data and predict patient issues, so that cardiologists can bring the best care at the best time.

To put it simply, when you join Implicity, you’ll contribute to save lives with us 💓🩺

Dr Arnaud Rosier (cardiologist and AI researcher) & David Perlmutter (engineer and entrepreneur), co-founded Implicity in 2016.

  • 10+ years later, a French Start-Up / Scale-Up 🐓 is a real game changer in the healthcare market, literally shaping the future of cardiology.

  • 250+ hospitals / medical centers are already using our solutions, covering 100 000+ patients.

👩🏻👨🏿👱🏻 At Implicity, you will find the greatest experts in data science, engineering, clinical, regulatory, IT, sales, customers success, etc. working together.

This amazing team already managed to make Implicity a clear European leader, and we will very soon do the same in the US market.

In a nutshell, thanks to Implicity:

🏆 Patients get a far better care

🏆 Doctors’ life is far easier, they can have a far better focus on prevention/treatment, and not admin/data burden

🏆 Healthcare payers (Social Security in France) eventually pays a far lower price (preventing/monitoring instead of treating/hospitalizing)

It can start as soon as you can!

Job and recruitment context

⭐️ Opening line ⭐️

We're growing our Tech team and looking for a Software / Backend Engineer Apprentice to help us build and maintain the data pipelines that feed our remote monitoring platform, working hand-in-hand with our Tech Lead on real production features from day one.

🤝 Reporting Structure

Direct Report: Tech Lead.

Collaboration: You'll work closely with the Ingestion team, taking on tasks alongside other squad members and being guided day-to-day by your Tech Lead.

🧠 Your missions

As a Software / Backend Engineer Apprentice, your core mission will be to help build and operate the data collection and processing pipelines that power our remote monitoring platform.

You will:

  • Data collection: Create data collection tasks from various external providers, through web scraping and API communication.

  • Data pipelines: Build pipelines that ingest, transform, and store collected data properly in our databases.

  • Agile delivery: Work on a 2-week sprint basis, taking part in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

  • Team collaboration: Take on tasks alongside other squad members, guided and supported by your Tech Lead.

At Implicity, you will have a weekly meeting with your manager, to help you succeed in your mission, and continuously improve your skills.

Each team works with quarterly OKR, to be crystal clear, fair and honest with your targets.

The annual appraisal is a shared exchange moment, focused on your development.

🧁 Our Technical Environment

  • Methodology: Agile (Scrum) with 2-week sprints, followed by production releases

  • Cloud Infrastructure: AWS

  • Architecture: Microservices, Event-Driven patterns (e.g., RabbitMQ, etc)

  • Primary Languages/Frameworks: TypeScript (Node.js, NestJS for Backend)

  • Front-end : Angular

  • Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes

  • CI/CD: GitLab CI

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog

  • Databases: MongoDB, MariaDB, PostgreSQL

  • Big Data tools: Glue, DBT, Iceberg, Looker Studio

This list is for your information, it's fine if you aren't familiar with the full stack.

🥇 Your Profile and Mindset

Experience Profile

  • Seniority & Experience: Apprentice, mid-to-end of studies in an Engineering / IT / Dev school

  • Sector Experience (Bonus): Strong interest in the innovation and health ecosystem

  • Education: Engineering / IT / Dev school

Mindset and Soft Skills

  • Autonomous & hard-working: Comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask for guidance.

  • Strong desire to learn: Motivated to grow technically and take on new challenges.

  • Work ethic & integrity: Acts daily with honesty, fairness, and integrity.

  • Team player: Thoughtful collaborator who looks to make colleagues successful, with good communication and documentation skills, comfortable working in both French and English.

🥈 Key Responsibilities

  1. Data collection: Build data collection tasks from external providers using web scraping and API communication.

  2. Data pipelines: Create pipelines that ingest, transform, and properly store collected data in our databases.

  3. Agile collaboration: Participate fully in the squad's 2-week sprint cycle (planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives), taking on tasks alongside teammates under the Tech Lead's guidance.

A Note on Applying: We are looking for a motivated Software Engineer Apprentice, but we know the perfect candidate doesn't exist. If you believe you possess the core required experience and strongly align with this mindset, we highly encourage you to apply.

Recruitment process

  1. Technical Speed Dating with Maxime Technical Product Manager – 30 min - G-Meet

  2. Technical Test with 2 members of the Ingestion Squad – 2 hours - On-site

  3. HR & Fit Interview with Hiring Team - 30 min - G-Meet

Depending on your availability, the recruitment process should last less than 1-2 weeks.

General information

💰 Salary

  • Depending on the official salary grids and your experience, will be discuss during the HR Interview.

👍 Benefits

  • Luncheon voucher: 9€ (50% employer)

  • Transport: 50% of your pass OR sustainable mobility pass

📍 Remote work & Location

  • 3 days per week (progressively)

  • Location: 29 rue du Louvre, 75002, PARIS

title: Kokki, Rosso Porvpp / Kock, Rosso Borgå
description:
Primary location:
PORVOO

KOKKI PORVOON ROSSOON, 30 H/ VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme kokkia Porvoon Rossoon vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Rosson monipuoliselta ruokalistalta löytyy herkullisia á la carte -annoksia, pastaruokia sekä suosittuja pizzoja, joten toivomme sinulla olevan jo kokemusta näiden valmistuksesta. Lisäksi työpäivään kuuluu esivalmisteluja, astiahuoltoa sekä varastojen hallintaa. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy vauhdikkaassa ympäristössä ja on halukas työskentelemään silloin kuin meillä parhaiten viihdytään, eli iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.

Työskentelet pääasiassa Porvoon Rossossa, mutta pääset tarvittaessa tekemään vuoroja myös Porvoon Amarillossa. Amarillon monipuoliselta ruokalistalta löytyy herkullisia meksikolaisia annoksia, kuten tacoja ja burritoja sekä meheviä hampurilaisia.

Tervetuloa ihan tavallisiin töihin - harvinaisen maukkaiden tehtävien pariin.Tavallisuus ei toki tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä jotenkin tylsää tai tylsää porukkaa töissä-päinvastoin!

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
- Kohtaat sekä asiakkaat että työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Kokemusta kokin työstä sekä à la carte -annosten ja pizzojen valmistuksesta.
- Reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta: osaat tarttua tehtäviin ja pidät huolta työpisteestäsi.
- Työssä kävellään ja kannetaan paljon, joten hyvä fyysinen kunto on eduksi.
- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä osana tiimiä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa, sillä työskentelemme suomeksi.

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikan, johon kiva tulla ja myös kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossakaveria ei jätetäja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista eli esimerkiksi ruoasta, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- MaRa:ntyöehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta, joka on kokemusvuosista riippuen 13,32 €/h - 14,62 €/h + työaikalisät
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Koko henkilökunnan yhteistä tulospalkkiota, jopa 1,70 € / tehty työtunti yrityksentuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittarienperusteella.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.

Jätä siis hakemuksesi, jos tykkäät ihan tavallisesta arjesta, vauhdikkaasta tekemisestä, hyvästä ruoasta ja poikkeuksellisen hyvistä työkavereista.

Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään tiistaina 18.8.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat sähköpostitse osoitteesta vbo.rekry@sok.fi. Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

***

KOCK TILL ROSSO I BORGÅ, 30 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en kock till Rosso i Borgå för en fast anställning. På Rossos mångsidiga meny hittar du läckra á la carte-rätter, pastarätter och populära pizzor, så vi önskar att du redan har erfarenhet av att tillreda dessa. Dessutom hör förberedelser, diskunderhåll och lagerhantering till din arbetsdag. Jobbet passar dig som trivs i en fartfylld miljö och vill arbeta när vi har som mest liv och rörelse, alltså kvällar och helger.

Du arbetar huvudsakligen på Rosso i Borgå, men vid behov kan du också ta arbetspass på Amarillo i Borgå. På Amarillos mångsidiga meny finns läckra mexikanska rätter såsom tacos och burritos samt saftiga hamburgare.

Välkommen till ett helt vanligt jobb - med ovanligt välsmakande uppgifter.Vanlighet betyder förstås inte att vi skulle ha det tråkigt eller att vi skulle vara ett tråkigt gäng - tvärtom!

Vad önskar vi av dig?
- Du möter både kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe. <3
- Erfarenhet av arbete som kock och tillredning av á la carte-rätter och pizza
- Du har ett raskt och självgående arbetssätt: du tar tag i uppgifter och håller ordning på din arbetsstation.
Arbetet innebär mycket gående och bärande, så god fysisk kondition är en fördel.
- Du har vilja att lära dig nytt och utvecklas som en del av teamet.
- Kunskaper i finska, eftersom finska är vårt arbetsspråk.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
- Lön i enlighet med kollektivavtalet för restaurangtjänster, vilket betyder mellan 13,32 och 14,62 euro/timme + arbetstidstillägg.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på åtminstone finska och svenska.
- En gemensam resultatpremie för hela personalen, upp till 1,70 € per arbetad timme beroende på företagets resultat och branschspecifika mätare.
- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån.

Så lämna in din ansökan om du gillar en vanlig vardag, fartfyllt arbete, god mat och exceptionellt trevliga kollegor.

Vi går vidare med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast tisdagen den 18.8.2026. Mer information om uppgiften får du per e-post på adressen vbo.rekry@sok.fi. Anställningen börjar enligt avtal.

title: Freelance Full-Stack Web App Developer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Freelance Full-Stack Web App Developer based in Canada.

Join a forward-thinking technology environment where you will build interactive, real-world web applications that combine modern frontend experiences with robust backend systems.
This freelance opportunity is designed for experienced full-stack developers who enjoy owning projects from concept to deployment.
You will contribute to innovative AI and technology initiatives by creating functional applications used across diverse scenarios.
The role offers the flexibility of remote work while allowing you to apply your expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, APIs, databases, and cloud technologies.
You will collaborate with a global network of specialists and help shape high-quality digital products through hands-on engineering.
If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, building scalable solutions, and working independently, this opportunity provides meaningful impact and flexibility.

Accountabilities:

As a Full-Stack Web App Developer, you will design, develop, and optimize browser-based applications and supporting tools while ensuring high-quality user experiences and reliable technical performance. You will work independently across frontend, backend, databases, and integrations to deliver complete solutions.

  • Build interactive web applications using modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar technologies, combined with backend APIs built with Python or Node.js.
  • Design and implement application architecture, including data models, schemas, persistence layers, and database integrations using SQL or NoSQL solutions.
  • Develop secure application features including authentication, sessions, role-based access controls, and user input validation.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and AI/LLM services into applications to enhance functionality and user experiences.
  • Create standalone Python tools, scripts, and backend utilities for data processing and application support when required.
  • Debug, optimize, refactor, and improve existing applications to enhance performance, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Write clean, testable, and well-structured code while troubleshooting issues across frontend, backend, and database layers.
  • Independently manage assigned development tasks, from architecture decisions through implementation and delivery.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced full-stack developer with strong technical foundations, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to independently deliver complete web applications. You should be comfortable working across multiple technologies and building production-ready solutions.

    • At least 3 years of professional experience in full-stack web development or building interactive web applications.
    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field is a plus.

title: Working Student - Category Management (m/f/x)
description:
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media. and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.


Our team of 500 comes from all corners of the world; we drive things forward collaboratively, take personal responsibility, value positive critical thinking, and persistently serve our customers and planet.

The Role

We’re looking for a motivated and analytical Working Student to join our dynamic Consumer Electronics team. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in Category Management, where your passion for numbers and problem-solving will directly impact our success. If you’re ready to immerse yourself in an open-minded environment and contribute meaningfully to the team, we encourage you to apply and grow with us. You’ll play a pivotal role in helping us meet our objectives, while gaining invaluable professional experience.

As a Category Management Working Student, you will work closely with our Category Managers to support key operational activities within the Consumer Electronics team. On top of that, you will be responsible for several processes in international markets management. This role offers exposure to a wide range of tasks that influence market strategy, campaigns and pricing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze sales data across international markets to uncover trends, monitor KPIs, and report on performance at both the team and company level

  • Manage the day-to-day administrative tasks required for international market maintenance

  • Identify opportunities for market expansion or performance improvement and propose actionable changes to drive growth in specific markets

  • Prepare reports and data insights to support decision-making processes

  • Support category management functions including sales and purchases tracking, data analysis, inventory management, and pricing optimization

  • Identify opportunities to automate routine tasks and leverage AI tools to streamline daily workflows.

Requirements:

  • Must be a student (Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Finance or similar) based in Berlin

  • Basic knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets required

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Very good English speaking and writing skills, another European language fluency (especially Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch) would be a strong plus

  • Ease of use with everyday AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) to enhance personal productivity and automate basic tasks

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, can work autonomously

  • Passionate about sustainability and reducing electronic waste

Location:

  • Berlin (We expect the working student to be in the office at least 2 days in a week).

  • Hybrid model


Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:

  • Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.

  • Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.

  • Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.

  • Enjoy our centrally located office in Berlin (Erkelenzdamm 11 - 13, 10999 Berlin).

  • Benefit from our family-friendly, flexible environment and paid child sick leave.

  • Bring your dog to the office: we love animals and want to cuddle yours, too!

  • Use employee discounts on , sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office.

  • Have fun at our legendary team and company events.

  • Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Nilo.

  • Take care of your work-life balance with 20 vacation days.

  • Stay active with our own gym located directly in the building, making it easy to fit workouts into your daily routine.

  • Benefit from an on-site daycare in the building, supporting a truly family friendly and flexible working environment.

*At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.

title: Secretary General
description:
Athens Technology Center (ATC) is hiring a Secretary General

About us

ATC is an Information Technology Company offering innovative solutions in the Private and Public sectors since 1987, having a strong presence in the European and World markets. Today we focus on R&D in AI/ML as well as commercial products and projects for specific market sectors.

As a full-service software development company, we apply modern design principles, along with the latest data science, machine learning, cloud, mobile and desktop technologies. We strive to deliver quality software solutions for top clients and global leaders in the sectors mentioned above, while at the same time being at the forefront of research and innovation

The position

ATC is looking for a Secretary General to join our Office Administration team. You will play an integral role being responsible for maintaining and organizing office tasks, implementing procedures and carrying out additional administrative duties of our organization.

The role includes a strong cooperation with all the business units of the company as well as with external partners and collaborators. This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of a forward-thinking organization that is dedicated to innovation in technology and research.

Key responsibilities

  • Front-desk related tasks (greeting visitors, manage call center and directing inquiries to the appropriate individuals or departments)
  • Organize, coordinate and supervise corporate travel of the organization
  • Distribute incoming and outgoing mail and packages
  • Maintain appointment schedules, calendars and meeting room availability
  • Manage office supplies
  • Supervise the proper operation of building facilities
  • Manage the office related budget
  • Perform other clerical receptionist duties such as filing, photocopying, collating, faxing etc.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Business Administration or a related field will be considered as an asset
  • Proven experience in a secretarial or administrative role
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
  • Adept in using office software (e.g., MS Office Suite, project management tools)
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, and fluently both in Greek and English
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse teams
  • Experience in managing schedules and coordinating events
  • Dependable, punctual, and able to maintain confidentiality
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Private health coverage
  • Tailored training programme and access to cut-edge skills
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
  • Friendly, pleasant and creative working environment

title: Program Technical Coordinator (RBS & Sustainability)
description:
Bring structure, momentum and exceptional service to a diverse portfolio of auditing and sustainability programs with SGS. Coordinate complex workflows, connect clients and auditors, and help deliver high-quality outcomes across recognised supply chain and environmental schemes.

About the role

Reporting to the Client Services Manager, you will coordinate auditing services across Supply Chain Services and Sustainability programs. You will keep schedules, reporting, corrective actions and stakeholder communication on track while supporting operational and commercial teams.

What you will be doing

  • Coordinate second-party audit programs, schedules, reports and corrective action close-outs.
  • Partner with auditors, clients, program owners, key accounts and internal teams.
  • Monitor program performance, deadlines, KPIs and business targets.
  • Maintain accurate client databases, audit records, reports and electronic files.
  • Coordinate audit approvals and reporting across relevant systems and stakeholders.
  • Respond promptly to customer, technical and complaint enquiries.
  • Support sales and account teams with information that helps grow the audit business.
  • Manage retailer and key stakeholder expectations with clarity and professionalism.
  • Follow SGS quality, safety, HR, integrity and professional conduct requirements.

What we are looking for

  • Experience or a sound understanding of auditing, certification or a related environment.
  • Strong organisational skills and confidence managing multifaceted schedules.
  • Proficiency with office systems, client databases and scheduling platforms.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with strong stakeholder management skills.
  • A customer-focused, solutions-oriented approach and the ability to negotiate effectively.
  • Willingness to complete program training for file review and certification decisions.

Why join SGS?

  • Build your career with a stable and respected global organisation.
  • Work in a collaborative, supportive and values-led environment.
  • Develop broad expertise across auditing and sustainability programs.
  • Contribute to services that help create a safer, more sustainable world.

Ready to make an impact?

If you are an organised coordinator who enjoys connecting people, processes and outcomes, we would love to hear from you. We welcome applications from candidates based across Australia and New Zealand. Apply now and be part of the SGS mission to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

Working at SGS means joining an innovative, Global company. Here are some of the benefits to working for SGS.

• As a company, we have embraced the shift to flexible work
• Sustainability is embedded in our culture and the way we do business
• Paid parental leave
• Paid time for volunteering day and blood donations
• Corporate health & wellbeing offers
• Ongoing learning & development
• Career development opportunities (Nationally and Globally)
• SGS Rewards: Our employee benefits platform with access to retail and online discounts and cashback

COME TO WORK AND BE 100% YOU
SGS Australia supports a diverse workforce, we encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities, and cultures – including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, the LGBTQI+ community and people living with disability. Providing employment opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people is an important part of our SGS Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP). We truly believe the diversity among us will continue to foster a strong, innovative, and forward-thinking workplace.

SGS Australia acknowledges and pays respect to the past, present and future Traditional Custodians and Elders of this nation and the continuation of cultural, spiritual, and educational practices of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.

title: Carrier Specialist
description:
As a Carrier Specialist within the Transport Control Tower of DHL Supply Chain in Eindhoven, you play a key role in managing and optimising the performance of our transport carriers. By analysing performance data, monitoring KPIs and building strong relationships with our carriers, you directly contribute to the quality of our transport services and help our customers achieve and improve their desired service levels. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, and driving continuous improvement within transport operations.

What can you expect from DHL?
  • A full-time position (40 hours) with a high level of responsibility and ownership
  • A competitive salary ranging from €3,468.57 to €4,689.12, with growth potential up to €5,727.27 depending on your experience and expertise
  • Excellent career opportunities within DHL Supply Chain, for example towards Carrier Manager or other specialist or management positions
  • Flexible working hours within a daytime schedule
  • 8% holiday allowance
  • 25 vacation days based on full-time employment
  • Travel allowance
  • Secondary employment benefits such as the CAO à la Carte: a personal budget that can be used for additional vacation hours (up to 6 days per year), monthly gross payout, study costs or a vitality budget
  • You will join a growing and energetic Control Tower team of approximately 25 colleagues, working in an open, supportive and collaborative environment
  • You will become part of the world's largest logistics service provider, offering plenty of opportunities for personal growth and development
  • You will work in a multicultural organisation that embraces diversity and promotes an inclusive working environment

Your responsibilities as a Carrier Specialist
As Carrier Specialist, you are responsible for monitoring, evaluating and improving carrier performance. You ensure that our transport partners deliver according to the agreed service levels while building strong relationships focused on continuous improvement.


Your responsibilities include:
  • Monitor carrier performance using Transport Management System data and agreed KPIs such as delivery performance, transit times and vehicle availability
  • Analyse performance trends and discuss results with carriers to identify and implement improvement actions
  • Prepare Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) for customers and carriers based on operational performance data
  • Act as the first escalation point for structural carrier-related issues and coordinate effective resolutions
  • Support the implementation and onboarding of new customers and transport providers
  • Identify improvement opportunities within transport processes and proactively drive optimisation initiatives
  • Coordinate with carriers during peak volumes to ensure agreed service levels are maintained
  • Collaborate closely with Front Office, Operations, Customer Service, customers and carriers to ensure operational excellence

What makes this role interesting?
In this position, you will have a direct impact on the quality of our transport network and contribute to the continuous improvement of our Control Tower organisation.

You will:
  • Play a key role between customers, carriers and internal DHL stakeholders
  • Build long-term partnerships with transport providers while driving performance improvements
  • Work independently with a high degree of ownership and responsibility
  • Have the freedom to optimise processes and introduce improvements
  • Gain broad exposure across transport operations and strategic customer management
  • Create a strong foundation for future career opportunities within Transport, Operations, Continuous Improvement or Carrier Management


What do you bring?
We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, performance data and operational improvements. You know how to build relationships while remaining result-oriented and decisive when needed.

You stand out because of your:

  • MBO+ or Bachelor's level of working and thinking, gained through education or experience
  • Experience within transport, logistics or supply chain is an advantage, but not a strict requirement
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into concrete improvement actions
  • Assertive personality; you are not afraid to challenge carriers and address performance issues
  • Organisational skills and the ability to prioritise in a dynamic environment
  • Ownership, proactivity and a continuous improvement mindset
  • You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a strong asset, but not a requirement.


Team & DHL Supply Chain
At DHL Supply Chain, we believe in smart logistics solutions, continuous improvement and empowered teams. You will become part of a close-knit Control Tower team where collaboration, openness and personal development are key.

You will receive a thorough onboarding programme and all the support you need to become successful in your role. Within DHL Supply Chain, there are numerous opportunities to further develop your career, both within the Control Tower organisation and across our international business.



Interested? Apply now!
Are you excited about this opportunity, and does your profile match the requirements above? Then you might be exactly the person we are looking for!

Please submit your CV by clicking the Apply button. Do you have any questions first? Feel free to contact Mirthe van de Sande (Corporate Recruiter) via mirthe.van_de_sande@dhl.com.

Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

Disclaimer: Inclusion & Diversity
At DHL, equal opportunities are at the heart of everything we do. We assess you based on who you are and what you can contribute—regardless of your background, origin, or personal preferences. If you do not meet every requirement but believe you are a good fit for this role, we encourage you to contact the recruiter mentioned above.

title: Rakennusapulainen, Värväämö Group Oy

Myös englannin kielen taitoa edellytetään.

title: Senior Business Analyst (UI/UX & Financial Services)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Business Analyst (UI/UX & Financial Services) based in Mexico.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Business Analyst to drive digital transformation initiatives within the financial services industry. In this role, you will bridge business strategy and technology by translating complex requirements into intuitive, user-focused solutions. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will shape business processes, define future-state solutions, and contribute to the design of modern digital experiences.     Security Officer - Security Check Passenger
    
                        
                

            

        

    

    

        

            

                

        Område: 
        

    Security
    
                

            

        

    

    

        

            

                

        Lokation: 
        

    
			


					Københavns Lufthavn
					
			


			
    
                

            

        

    

    

        

            

                

        Jobtype: 
        

    Fuldtid
    
                

            

        

    

    

        

            

                

        Opslagsdato: 
        

    3. aug. 2026
    
                

            

        

    

    

        

            

                


    
                



 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 


 

 


 


I Københavns Lufthavnes (CPH) centrale sikkerhedskontrol møder du et pulserende og internationalt miljø, hvor tempoet er højt, og samarbejde er nøglen til en god passageroplevelse. Vi arbejder med avanceret teknologi, og netop nu er den nye generation af scannere til håndbagage kommet i drift. Som Security Officer i Security Check Passenger (SCP) er du en del af en lufthavn, der konstant udvikler sig og med til at skabe tryg start på rejsen for vores passagerer. 


  


Din nye rolle


 


Vi holder til ved den centrale sikkerhedskontrol, hvor passagerer og håndbagage sikkerhedstjekkes. Her spiller du en central rolle i at sikre, at rejsen kan begynde trygt, effektivt og professionelt. Hver dag møder du mennesker med forskellig baggrund, nationalitet og kultur, som alle skal have en god oplevelse gennem Security.


 


Vi ser frem til, at du bidrager med:


 



Sikkerhedscheck af passagerer og deres håndbagage


At følge retningslinjer og procedurer nøje


Vejlede passagerer og sikre en tryg og professionel oplevelse


At lede opad, så vi sammen bidrager til det gode samarbejde og spiller hinanden gode



 


Som fuldtidsmedarbejder i Security bliver du en del af en turnusordning med vagter fordelt på hele døgnet, 365 dage om året med varierende mødetider og weekendarbejde. En CPH-turnus er af 6 måneders varighed, hvor du arbejder hver anden weekend. Vagtlængderne er 8-10 timer pr. vagt.


 


Aflønning sker i henhold til virksomhedsoverenskomsten, hvor grundlønnen pt. ligger på 196,10 kr./time. Dertil kommer pension, feriefridage samt en række variable- og ulempetillæg, eksempelvis weekendtillæg på 56,37 kr./time (lørdage mellem kl. 14-24 og søndage mellem 00-24).


 


Din nye afdeling


 


I Security Services & Crisis Response er sikkerhed fundamentet for alt, hvad vi gør. Vi har ansvaret for sikkerheden i hele lufthavnen og for det samlede beredskab - fra daglig kontrol og forebyggelse til håndtering af akutte hændelser.


 


SCP er en del af Security Services & Crisis Response og har ansvaret for at sikkerhedstjekke lufthavnens mere end 32 mio. årlige passagerer og deres håndbagage. Vi er kendte for at være en mangfoldig afdeling med kolleger i alle aldre og med forskellig baggrund, køn, kultur og religion. Vi vægter det gode arbejdsmiljø højt og bakker altid hinanden op.


 


Om dig


 


Du trives i et omskifteligt arbejdsmiljø, hvor du både kan arbejde koncentreret og fokuseret med en specifik opgave og samtidig bevare overblikket i et til tider hektisk miljø med mange mennesker og højt tempo.


 


Du er omstillingsparat og en naturlig myndighed, der er bevidst om det ansvar, du varetager på vores checksteder. Du kan arbejde i et selvkørende team og går til opgaverne med engagement, disciplin og en skarp sans for detaljer. Og så er du en god kollega - dem får vi nemlig aldrig for mange af i SCP. 


 


For at komme i betragtning til jobbet forventer vi, at du:


 



Taler, skriver og læser flydende dansk, og du har et godt mundtligt engelsk svarende til et niveau, hvor du kan hjælpe og vejlede vores kunder. Taler du andre sprog, kan det også være en fordel


Har erfaring med direkte kundekontakt fra tidligere jobs


Motiveres af kundekontakt og mødet med forskellige kulturer


Har kendskab til IT på brugerniveau


Har normalt farvesyn, hvilket du vil blive testet for i ansøgningsprocessen



 


Hvad vi tilbyder


 


I CPH gør vi os umage for at skabe gode rammer om din hverdag. 


 


Du får adgang til medarbejdergoder, der både gør arbejdslivet lettere og giver balance i hverdagen. Det gælder blandt andet attraktive barselsvilkår (uanset køn), sundhedsforsikring for dig og din familie, pensionsordning, gratis parkering, gode transportmuligheder, samt træningsfaciliteter og adgang til sundhedscenter. 


 


Samtidig bliver du en del af et mangfoldigt og aktivt fællesskab med mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling, sport, kultur og sociale aktiviteter. 


 


Yderligere information


 


Eventuelle spørgsmål om stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen kan sendes til jobisecurity@cph.dk.


 


Vi modtager kun ansøgninger via vores rekrutteringssystem.


 


Vi benytter screeningsspørgsmål, som besvares, før du uploader din ansøgning. Dine svar vil enten kvalificere dig til at ansøge, eller du vil modtage et afslag. Et afslag vil udelukkende gælde denne stilling og har ingen betydning for fremtidige stillinger i CPH. 


 


Rekrutteringsprocessen forløber, som følger: 


 


Er du blandt de udvalgte kandidater, inviteres du til et videointerview via mail. 


 


Kandidater, som går videre efter videointerviewet, bliver kontaktet direkte og skal gennemføre en synstest.


 


Vi afholder herefter rekrutteringsdage, der forudsætter fysisk tilstedeværelse. Rekrutteringsdagene vil blive afholdt d. 17., 22., 23. og 24. SEP 2026. Det er et krav, at du deltager i én af rekrutteringsdagene for at komme i betragtning til jobbet i SCP.


 


Grundet travlhed hos myndighederne, som varetager sikkerhedsgodkendelsen, kan rekrutteringsprocessen strække sig over en længere periode.


 


Ansøgningsfrist


 


Vi ser frem til at læse din ansøgning, så send den gerne snarest muligt og senest d. 16. AUG 2026.


 


 


Vi skaber forbindelse til verden 


 


CPH har i mere end 100 år forbundet mennesker og kulturer. Vi sender passagerer ud i verden og byder verden velkommen til Danmark.


 


På tværs af CPH og i samarbejde med vores partnere udvikler vi fremtidens lufthavne. Sammen skaber vi ansvarlig vækst gennem sikker og stabil drift, digitalisering og gode passageroplevelser. 


 


Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan blive politigodkendt og opretholde godkendelsen gennem hele din ansættelse.


 


Læs mere om hvordan det er at være medarbejder hos os på cph.dk/job.

CPH ejer, driver og udvikler Roskilde Lufthavn og Københavns Lufthavn. CPH er som arbejdsplads med garanti ’one of a kind’ - et lille samfund, som skaber fremtidens lufthavn.

Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge uanset alder, kønsidentitet, seksuel orientering, religion, etnicitet, handicap og neurodivergens.

title: System Engineer – Vehicle Energy Management
description:
As a System Engineer – Vehicle Energy Management, you will contribute to the development of innovative energy management concepts for next-generation battery electric (BEV) and fuel cell electric (FCEV) vehicles. Working closely with international engineering teams, you will develop simulation models, evaluate vehicle concepts, and support the optimization of energy efficiency and driving range through advanced system engineering methods.

Your tasks:

► Developing and evaluating innovative vehicle energy management concepts to improve energy efficiency and driving range in zero-emission vehicles

► Developing and maintaining modular 0D/1D vehicle simulation models for powertrain and thermal management systems, including batteries, electric drives, HVAC and cooling circuits

► Ensuring compatibility and integration of vehicle simulation models with component and subsystem models from other Bosch business units

► Continuously improving simulation, evaluation and optimization toolchains to increase efficiency and accuracy

► Supporting technology assessments, optimization studies and customer projects by analyzing and presenting simulation results

► Deriving component requirements and loads from vehicle-level use cases to support product development and project acquisitions

► Collaborating closely with international development teams and contributing to cross-functional engineering activities

► BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a related field

► Solid understanding of automotive powertrain and/or thermal management systems for battery electric (BEV) and fuel cell electric (FCEV) vehicles

► Several years of experience with 0D/1D simulation tools and methodologies, preferably in automotive powertrain or thermal management simulation

► Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or similar simulation environments

► Experience with Design for Reliability (DfR) methodologies, including component load and lifetime analysis

► Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills

► Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in international, cross-functional teams

► Willingness to travel occasionally to Germany

► Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken

What gives you further advantages:

► German language skills

► Experience in vehicle system simulation and optimization

► Knowledge of thermal management technologies and energy efficiency strategies for electric vehicles

Get to know our #LikeABosch benefits.

We would like to help you GROW, so we offer you:

  • Financial security & recognition: We review and increase your competitive base salary annually, offer performance-, loyalty-, and referral bonus.

  • Trainings and professional development: We believe in a Life-Long Learning approach, so you can take advantage of several technical and soft skill trainings and language courses.

  • Career development: We have a wide range of programs to choose from, even if its leadership, expert or project development you are aiming for. We also offer mentoring and coaching opportunities, we have PhD program and we offer international assignment possibilities.

We would like you to ENJOY the benefits of balancing your life and your work, so we pay attention to:

  • Your work life-balance: You can work from our activity based offices designed for creativity and efficiency or from home while enjoying flexible working hours. We offer childcare possibilities and sabbatical option.

  • Your health and well-being: We provide free professional consultants for any personal, legal, financial or health related issues. You can benefit from our developing onsite medical center and organized regular health checkups.

  • We also offer you several perks and benefits: You can use your annual cafeteria allowance flexibly for family support (e.g. tax-free kindergarten and nursery allowances), health care, mobility (car sharing services) and recreation. You can enjoy our onsite canteen, we support when you work from home and if you live far, we cover your commute costs. We also appreciate your loyalty with jubilee gift and extra jubilee holiday.

You could join an INSPIRING community worth to belong:

  • We are true to our values: We are committed to sustainability, we value that everyone is different and that diversity makes us truly successful. We also take social responsibility seriously and regularly organize charity actions, blood donations and support worthy causes.

  • Team building activities and community events are also part of our everydays. We like to come together for a good summer party or family day.

Are you ready to work #LikeABosch?

Please apply with your English CV!

If you require any further information, please feel free to contact us on the following number: +36 80 18 08 01. Our colleagues can help you with answers during the weekdays between 08:00 a.m. till 11:00 a.m.

title: Handicaphjælper vikar - døgnvagter
description:
Har du et arbejdsliv som giver mulighed for, at du periodevis arbejder 1-2 dage pr uge i 24-timers døgnvagter på de tidspunkter af året hvor andre holder ferie?

Så har jeg jobbet som passer til dig.

Jeg søger 1-2 vikarer, der kan træde til når en af mine 5 faste handicaphjælpere har ferie. Hos mig er mødetiden kl. 10.00.

Jeg forestiller mig, at du har et arbejdsliv med stor fleksibilitet, for eksempel med webshop, selvstændig virksomhed hvor produktionen kan vente en dag eller er vikar hos et bureau. Du kunne også være studerende.

På grund af min allergi er det en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du ikke ryger og ikke bruger parfume eller vaskemiddel med parfume. Det er nødvendigt, at du altid møder duft neutral på arbejde.

Jobbet omfatter hjælp til de praktiske opgaver, som jeg ikke selv kan, f.eks. almindelige huslige opgaver samt håndsrækninger til mine aktiviteter. Derudover skal du hjælpe med forflytninger med loftlift og personlig pleje. Når jeg ikke har brug for hjælp, er du på hjælperværelset.

Du vil blive ansat af DUOS og jeg er din arbejdsleder.

Jeg er en kvinde på 64 år og kørestolsbruger pga. rygmarvsskade. Jeg har et positivt livssyn og jeg holder af hverdagen. Hvis du trives med hverdagsaktiviteter som rengøring og madlavning, struktur og ordentlighed samt en klar opgavefordeling, så er jobbet som vikar hos mig, måske noget for dig.

Jeg forventer, at du har forståelse for at arbejde i et privat hjem og respektere min måde at gøre tingene på.

Som vikar er det vigtigt, at du er:

· ansvarsbevidst, ordensmenneske og serviceorienteret

· god til at omsætte mundtlig instruktion til praktisk handling

· i stand til at kommunikere problemfrit på dansk

· ikke ryger og ikke bruger vaske- og plejeprodukter med parfume i hverdagen

· kvinde

Ansøgning:

Send en ansøgning, hvor du fortæller, hvorfor du vil være vikar og indsæt gerne CV. Husk at oplyse navn, adresse og . Ansøgningsfrist er d. 01.09.2026. Jeg glæder mig til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: Backend Engineer - Transfers Gateway
description:
At SumUp, the Global Bank tribe builds the core infrastructure and services that give merchants a digital business account, helping small businesses manage their banking needs easily and reliably.

The Transfers Gateway squad connects SumUp’s internal systems to external financial networks across the EU and the UK. We build and run the services that move money through payment schemes every day. The team owns end‑to‑end scheme integrations and operates production services that process real money at scale. You’ll help modernise existing systems while balancing reliability, correctness, and change, making architectural decisions that directly affect uptime and merchant experience across multiple markets.

Our tech stack includes Go, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes, supported by a strong observability toolchain with Prometheus, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We also actively use AI‑assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others.

SumUp’s engineering culture is built around ownership. We follow a “build it, run it, improve it” model, with strong observability and a focus on learning. Engineers have clear scope and autonomy, with decisions documented, reviewed, and made collaboratively.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain production money movement backend services, contributing to their delivery, observability, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Own and deliver end to end features, and contribute to larger projects within the team’s domain.
  • Contribute to technical design and implementation, following established architectural patterns and best practices.
  • Improve service reliability and quality by writing tests, enhancing monitoring, and following established delivery pipelines.
  • Support the operation of the systems you work on by participating in on‑call rotations, incident response, and learning from post‑incident reviews.
  • Apply a backend and systems perspective during refinement, raising questions about risks, dependencies, and edge cases.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and other engineers to deliver end‑to‑end transfer and banking capabilities.

You’ll be great for this role if you

  • Have experience building backend services in a modern environment and supporting them in production.
  • You are proficient in Golang and and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed
  • Are comfortable working with cloud‑based systems, containerized workloads, and automated delivery pipelines.
  • Raise well-scoped pull requests, conduct thorough code reviews, and help maintain high standards of code quality and test coverage across the team
  • Understand the fundamentals of system architecture, data modelling, and API design, and are eager to deepen this knowledge.
  • Are curious about how your work fits into the broader system and product experience.
  • Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.

Any of the following would be considered a plus

  • Exposure to banking, payments, or financial systems, especially in regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting systems with production traffic, including participating in incident response.
  • Use of AI‑assisted tools to improve development speed, learning, or code quality.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 We’re a truly global team of 3200+ skilled professionals from 92+ countries, spread across 4 continents. Join the team from our Vilnius office.
  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
  • 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success
  • 🏖️ Time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus special holidays
  • 🏥 Peace of mind: health insurance through Gjensidige and life & accidental coverage from Ergo
  • 💪 Stay active: gym membership allowance to help you keep fit on your terms
  • 📚Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship programs, SumUp University cohort and a yearly learning budget (2,000 EUR)
  • 💡We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.
  • 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
  • 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

Compensation: From midlevel level 3,493 to 4,657 Euro p/m + 2000 EUR annual learning budget + Virtual Stock Options. Ranges may vary based on skills and experience.

About SumUp

At SumUp, we’re on a mission to empower small businesses around the world with simple, affordable tools to help them start, run, and grow. More than 4 million merchants across 37 markets trust us as their financial partner — and we’re just getting started.

title: Freelance Full-Stack Web App Developer
description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Full-Stack Web App Developers (JavaScript/TypeScript + Python or Node) to join the Tendem project () and build interactive browser-based applications for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your full-stack engineering expertise to design, build, and maintain functional, robust, and user-friendly web applications. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in modern frontend frameworks, backend APIs, databases, and shipping interactive web products end-to-end.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Full-Stack Web App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine browser-based applications with real logic, state, persistence, and user input — from habit trackers and budgeting tools to internal dashboards, mini-SaaS tools, and AI-powered apps. You may also work on standalone Python applications and data-processing scripts that sit alongside or behind these products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build interactive web applications with frontend (React, Next.js, Vue, or similar) and a backend API (Python/FastAPI/Flask or Node/Express).
  • Design and implement data models, schemas, and persistence layers using SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite) or NoSQL stores.
  • Implement authentication, sessions, and basic role-based access where needed.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and AI/LLM services (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into product features.
  • Handle state management, user input validation, error states, and loading states cleanly.
  • Build standalone Python tools and scripts where required by the task (data processing, API clients, lightweight backend utilities).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor full-stack applications to improve correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Write clear, testable code and debug end-to-end issues across frontend, backend, and database.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in full-stack web development or shipping interactive web applications (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in full-stack web development, modern frontend frameworks, backend architecture, and building interactive browser-based applications end-to-end. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work across frontend, backend, databases, and APIs, design robust application logic, and build production-ready web applications. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently architect and ship complete features are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar).
  • Solid backend experience in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/or Node.js (Express, NestJS).
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and basic schema design.
  • Experience implementing REST APIs, request validation, error handling, and authentication flows.
  • Familiarity with deployment platforms (Vercel, Netlify, Render, , Railway, or similar).
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or other AI services into product features is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable with version control (Git) and basic testing practices.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to building working, robust products — not demos.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to architect, build, and ship features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped web applications (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

title: Didactics and Learning Activities Specialist
description:
We are looking for a ​Didactics and Learning Activities​ to complete our consultants Workforce Management Service to support the ​STEM Learning & Inspiration Programme​ of the European Space Agency (ESA) at their location in Libin, Belgium​. The purpose of this role is to ​support the Learn with Space activity with coordination, production and delivery of didactics activities such as teaching and learning resources and teacher & educator training events. Additionally, the role provides support to the design, coordination and delivery of project-based learning activities​.

Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at the interview stage).

ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, handicap or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment.

The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to:

Didactics and international teacher engagement

  • Design, produce (or coordinate the production of), test, deliver/show case and evaluate innovative pilot didactics concepts (teaching / learning resources) for both formal (school) and non-formal environments;

  • Implement the design, planning, production (or coordination of the production) and delivery of initiatives aimed at the international engagement of teachers and educators - either at ESA facilities or at facilities indicated by ESA – consisting of:

    • Teacher training and workshops;

    • E-learning courses;

    • Other forms of teachers’ engagement such as an online platform for a community of practice or similar;

    • Management of the dedicated shared inbox.

  • For each of the training activities described above, design an evaluation survey for completion by the training participants; use the results of these surveys to prepare concise evaluation reports (PowerPoint presentation) that include lessons learned, recommendations and opportunities for the improvement for the STEM Learning and Inspiration Programme concerning training and didactics.

    International project-based learning activities

  • Support the international management, implementation and evolution of the ongoing ESAESERO project-based learning activities, including the annual interdisciplinary school projects (CanSat, Astro Pi, Mission X, Climate Detectives, Moon Camp) by:

    • generating and/or updating the general project guidelines, calendar and classroom resources – including in e-learning format - for each project on an annual basis;

    • maintaining and keeping the content of the central ESA online platforms dedicated to each of the projects listed above up to date;

    • ensuring the availability of, and access to, the basic set of tools (e.g. software) required to run the projects and provide inputs for the evolution of such tools (in terms of usability and user-friendliness for educational purposes), by liaising with the experts and/or providers indicated by ESA;

    • communicating and interacting with participating project teams, their educators and with the project partners to ensure the smooth implementation of each project;

    • providing inputs for the definition of requirements (SOW) that can be used by ESA for the procurement of additional supporting services to such project-based learning activities;

    • providing training to educators and project partners requested by ESEROs on each of the projects and on the tools and resources used;

    • organizing events (in presence and online) during key-project phases from the logistics and content point of view;

    • providing inputs to the definition and updates of the visual identity/branding assets associated with each of the projects and monitor their consistent implementation by the project partners (such as the ESEROs).

    Provide inputs to the design of new project-based learning activities including concept, subject knowledge, didactics expertise, planning and organization. If such activities are adopted by ESA, support their implementation as described above.

Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements. If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection.

  • Master’s degree in Education, Instructional Design, STEM Education, Science Communication, Educational Sciences, Pedagogy, or another relevant discipline;

  • Minimum 4 years of professional experience in the design, development, coordination, delivery and evaluation of educational, training or STEM learning activities;

  • Experience teaching in schools is a plus;

  • Proven experience in developing didactic resources, training materials and learning activities for formal and/or non-formal education environments;

  • Proven experience in planning, organising and delivering teacher and educator training activities, workshops, conferences or professional development programmes;

  • Experience in project coordination involving multiple stakeholders, including educational institutions, public organisations, international partners or networks;

  • Previous experience working for ESA, ESERO, EU institutions, international organisations, or within a comparable multinational environment is a plus;

  • Familiarity with ESA Education programmes, Learn with Space initiatives, ESERO activities, and project-based learning programmes such as CanSat, Astro Pi, Mission X, Climate Detectives or Moon Camp is a plus;

  • Knowledge of current trends and best practices in STEM education, instructional design, digital learning and teacher professional development is a plus;

  • Experience supporting outreach, science communication and educational engagement initiatives related to space, science and technology is a plus;

  • Experience working in multicultural and international educational projects is a plus;

  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially PowerPoint, Excel and Word), collaboration platforms, online meeting tools, and electronic communication systems;

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with institutional stakeholders, educators, experts, project partners and international communities;

  • Ability to prepare evaluation surveys, analyse feedback and participation data, and produce concise reports containing lessons learned and recommendations;

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, work autonomously and maintain high quality standards under demanding workloads;

  • Strong organisational skills, reliability, attention to detail and commitment to delivering activities according to established procedures and deadlines;

  • Demonstrated team spirit, proactive attitude, flexibility and problem-solving capability;

  • Candidates must be eligible to work and live in the EU;

  • Fluency in English both written and spoken.

Please submit your application in English via the apply button below. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.

title: Rakennnusaputyöntekijä
description:
Kiinnostaako joustava työ rakennusalalla? Oletko työuraasi aloitteleva tekijä, vai kenties jo kokeneempi rakennusalan ammattilainen? Lisäpalvelulta löytyy vaihtelevia hommia monen tasoisille osaajille.

Etsimme nyt Rakennusaputyöntekijöitä erilaisiin kohteisiin Kouvolan alueelle.

Millainen työ on kyseessä?

Rakennusaputyöntekijänä työtehtäväsi ovat rakennustyömaan monipuoliset avustavat tehtävät. Työpäiväsi voi sisältää esim. tavaroiden kantamista, rakenteiden purkamista, siisteydestä huolehtimisesta tai työmaalogistiikan tehtävistä. Työt katsotaan osaamisesi mukaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Pärjäät tehtävässä mainiosti, jos sinulla on:

* Hyvä fyysinen kunto
* Reipas ja oma-aloitteinen ote työntekoon
* Halu oppia uutta
* Sujuva suomen kielen taito
* Ajokortti ja oma auto käytettävissä

Plussaa on, jos sinulla on lisäksi:

* Koulutus rakennusalalta tai kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä
* Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti (tarvittaessa autamme kortin hankinnassa)

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

* Palkkauksen, joka on vähintään alan työehtosopimuksen mukainen (neuvotellaan tarkemmin osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan).
* Työssä tarvittavat varusteet
* Luotettavan työpaikan, jossa kaikki työsuhteeseen liittyvät asiat hoituvat oppikirjan mukaan

Tässä vielä muutama syy, miksi sinun kannattaa valita Lisäpalvelu:

1. Meillä saat työnhakijana ja -tekijänä aidosti henkilökohtaista palvelua. Tapaat meidät kasvotusten jo työnhakuvaiheessa.
2. Rakennusalan asiakaskuntamme on todella monipuolinen. Siksi pystymme tarjoamaan laajan kattauksen erilaisia tehtäviä, joista löytyy jokaiselle jotakin.
3. Pidämme kiinni sovituista asioista ja teemme sen, mitä lupaamme. Sinä voit keskittyä työntekoon, koska me hoidamme puolestasi ylimääräisen byrokratian.

Kuulostaako hyvältä? Hienoa, haluamme kuulla sinusta pian!

Jos saimme sinut kiinnostumaan ja haluaisit liittyä Lisäpalvelun porukkaan, laita meille hakemus tulemaan mahdollisimman pian!

Jäikö sinulle kysyttävää? Suvi kertoo sinulle mielellään lisää. Hänet tavoitat ma-pe klo 10-14 numerosta 0400 437 336, tai sähköpostilla osoitteesta suvi.fihlman@lisapalvelu.net.



Lisäpalvelu on vuonna 2002 perustettu valtakunnallisesti toimiva joustavia henkilöstöratkaisuja tarjoava kotimainen yritys. Lisäpalvelu-konserni on tunnettu luotettavuudesta ja pitkäaikaisista asiakassuhteista niin työnantajien kuin -tekijöiden keskuudessa. Työllistämme vuosittain yli 3 000 työntekijää, ja olemme vahva toimija monella alalla: tarjoamme töitä mm. ravintola-, rakennus-, teollisuus-, kunnossapito-, logistiikka-, toimisto-, siivous- ja kaupan aloilla. Olemme Suomen kymmenen suurimman henkilöstöpalvelualan yrityksen joukossa, ja kuulumme Henkilöstöpalveluyritysten liittoon (HPL).



Haluamme tehdä töihin menon sinulle helpoksi: kauttamme voit työllistyä parhaimmillaan jo seuraavana päivänä. Tarjoamme jatkuvasti töitä erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin, ja kauttamme tehty vuokratyö on ollut monelle työntekijällemme reitti vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.



Hae meille, niin etsitään yhdessä juuri sinulle mielekäs työ!

title: Säljare vid behov på Kappahl Västervik
description:
Är du en social och utåtriktad person med stor passion för mode? Drivs du av att dela den passionen med andra och guida dem för att känna sig som bäst? Kanske är du personen vi söker till tjänsten som säljare i Kappahl Västervik!

På Kappahl jobbar vi utifrån vårt kundlöfte “Fashion fit for life”. Vi tycker att mode ska passa in på livet och för alla människors olika sätt att ta sig an vardagen. Ett mode gjort för att leva i, helt enkelt!

Som säljare i en av våra butiker ser du till att ett besök hos oss känns välkomnande, tryggt och inspirerande. En plats dit man gärna kommer tillbaka igen. Med ett varmt bemötande och god initiativförmåga guidar du kunden till långlivade köp och erbjuder en unik kundupplevelse. Målet är att lyssna, känna in och hjälpa dem hitta det där nya favoritplagget som kan användas om och om igen.

Kanske har du tidigare jobbat inom service, eller har ett stort intresse av mode och kläder. Du trivs med att jobba i team med härliga kollegor och att stötta andra för att tillsammans nå uppsatta försäljningsmål.

Tjänsten är vikariat på 6 h/veckan och på 6 månader med start Enligt överenskommelse.

Mycket har hänt sedan vi började sälja kappor i en källare för snart 70 år sedan. I dag har vi närmare 360 butiker och är en av Nordens ledande modekedjor. Men en sak är sig lik - vårt brinnande intresse för våra kunder.

För att kunna kunna följa med på vår utvecklingsresa söker vi dig som är flexibel, lätt kan ändra fokus och prioritera om. Du har lätt för att känna igen dig i Kappahls värdeord – Inclusive, Courageous och Joyful. Ingen dag är den andra lik, och älskar du liksom vi utmaningar och att arbeta i ett högt tempo är det dig vi söker!

Vem är du?

  • Social, utåtriktad och älskar mötet med människor.
  • Brinner för sälj och service och vill ge kunden den bästa shoppingupplevelsen.
  • Älskar att jobba i team och samarbeta med andra för att nå mål.
  • Har stor initiativförmåga och tar ansvar i ditt arbete.
  • Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
  • Tidigare erfarenhet inom detaljhandeln eller service.
  • Du är 18 år eller äldre.

title: Product Manager, Self Managed Service
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager, Self Managed Service based in Canada.

Join a high-impact product organization focused on delivering enterprise-grade platform experiences for customers managing their own software environments. This role is ideal for a product leader who enjoys defining strategy, shaping roadmaps, and solving complex deployment challenges across cloud and on-premises infrastructures. Working closely with engineering, customer-facing teams, and technical stakeholders, you will improve product adoption, simplify enterprise deployments, and influence the future of self-managed platform capabilities. You'll have the opportunity to balance customer needs, market trends, and technical innovation while driving meaningful business outcomes in a collaborative, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities

  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for self-managed platform services, ensuring alignment with customer needs and business objectives.
  • Own the customer experience for deployment and operation across Kubernetes, Helm, container platforms, on-premises, bare-metal, and air-gapped environments.
  • Gather, evaluate, and prioritize feedback from customers, partners, internal stakeholders, and the community to guide product improvements and innovation.
  • Manage and prioritize feature requests, product backlogs, and strategic initiatives to maximize customer value and product adoption.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Documentation, Pre-Sales, and Solution Architecture teams to deliver enterprise-ready solutions.
  • Monitor market trends, customer demand, and the competitive landscape to identify new opportunities and inform product direction.
  • Ensure development teams remain focused on the highest-priority initiatives while continuously improving deployment simplicity, scalability, and operational excellence.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience as a Product Manager working with enterprise software or platform products.
    • Experience managing products available in both SaaS and self-managed/on-premises deployment models.
    • Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies, including Kubernetes, containerized environments, and modern deployment practices.
    • Ability and willingness to work hands-on with technical products and understand customer deployment challenges.
    • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle.
    • Strong analytical, prioritization, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
    • Knowledge of enterprise customer requirements, including security, scalability, governance, and operational reliability.
    • Experience working with banking, financial services, or insurance technology platforms is considered an asset.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive salary ranging from CAD $152,700 to CAD $251,200, based on experience, skills, and location.
      • Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP), where applicable.
      • Fully remote and flexible work environment with home office budget, coworking support, and flexible paid time off.
      • Annual company kickoffs, team offsites, local meetups, and connection budgets to foster collaboration.
      • Comprehensive healthcare and wellbeing benefits, including mental health support and lifestyle spending allowance.
      • Retirement and pension plans, plus life and disability insurance where applicable.
      • Annual professional development budget of up to $1,000 for courses, certifications, books, and learning resources.
      • Inclusive, global workplace committed to diversity, collaboration, and continuous career growth.

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja teollisuuteen
description:
Haluatko työn, jossa jokainen päivä on erilainen ja osaamisellasi on oikeasti merkitystä? Etsimme asiakkaallemme kunnossapitoasentajaa vakituiseen ja pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tässä työssä vastaat tuotannon koneiden ja laitteiden kunnossapidosta. Päiväsi koostuvat vikojen paikantamisesta, korjauksista sekä ennakkohuolloista. Kun tuotanto pysyy käynnissä ja laitteet toimivat luotettavasti, tiedät onnistuneesi.

Toivomme sinulta kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, mekaanisista asennuksista tai muista vastaavista tehtävistä. Työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti, mutta saat tarvittaessa tukea osaavilta kollegoilta. Huolellinen työote, ongelmanratkaisukyky ja kiinnostus tekniikkaan auttavat sinua menestymään tehtävässä.

Sähköalan koulutus tai kokemus sähkö- ja automaatiokunnossapidosta on tehtävässä selkeä etu, mutta vahva mekaaninen osaaminen antaa myös hyvän pohjan onnistua.

Työtä tehdään aamu- ja iltavuoroissa, joten odotamme valmiutta vuorotyöhön.

Mitä tarjoamme?

  • pitkäaikaisen työpaikan vakaassa toimintaympäristössä

  • monipuoliset työtehtävät, joissa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi

  • osaamistasi vastaavan palkkauksen

  • ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön, jossa et jää yksin

Työt alkavat syyskuussa sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana.

Staffgate Oy on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin.Lue lisää sivustoltamme Staffgate.fi
