title: Undersköterska/boendeassistent
description:
På Gotland finns tio särskilda boenden på sex orter där vi tillsammans arbetar för att ge äldre en trygg och meningsfull vardag dygnet runt. I team med undersköterskor, boendeassistenter och sjuksköterskor sätter vi alltid brukaren i centrum och arbetar utifrån vår värdegrund: förtroende, omtanke och delaktighet.

Roma äldreboende ligger på mellersta Gotland, cirka två mil från Visby. Här finns 50 lägenheter, varav 10 med demensinriktning, i en modern och trivsam miljö. Vi är omkring 60 engagerade medarbetare som tillsammans skapar en arbetsplats fylld av kunskap, värme och arbetsglädje.

Nu söker vi nya kollegor, både till vår Silviacertifierade demensavdelning och till våra somatiska avdelningar, som vill vara med och göra skillnad! Hos oss får du möjlighet till kompetensutveckling, friskvård och ett meningsfullt arbete varje dag.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

I rollen arbetar du med omvårdnads- och serviceinsatser utifrån arbetssättet Individens behov i centrum (IBIC). Vårt fokus är att skapa trygghet och en meningsfull vardag för varje boende, med respekt för individuella behov, förutsättningar och önskemål.

Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat personlig omvårdnad, delegerade HSL-insatser, kontakt med anhöriga, hushållssysslor och att planera och genomföra aktiviteter utifrån den enskildes behov.

I uppdraget ingår även kontaktmannaskap, arbete med genomförandeplaner, dokumentation samt viss administration. Du arbetar i team och har ett nära samarbete med enhetschef, sjuksköterska och rehabpersonal.

Tjänsten innebär arbete enligt grundschema med dag- och kvällspass samt arbete varannan helg.

För tjänsten som undersköterska inom särskilt boende är ingångslöneintervallet 29 000–34 000 kronor per månad. För befattningen boendeassistent inom särskilt boende är ingångslöneintervallet 24 000–30 000 kronor per månad. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Slutlig lön fastställs utifrån utbildning, relevant erfarenhet, kompetens och ansvar i rollen samt med hänsyn till gällande kollektivavtal.

Vem är du?

Vi söker främst dig som är utbildad undersköterska, gärna med erfarenhet av arbete inom äldreomsorgen. För att anställas som undersköterska krävs att du har rätt att använda den skyddade yrkestiteln enligt gällande regler.

Söker du som boendeassistent är det meriterande med någon form av utbildning med inriktning mot vård och omsorg, exempelvis vårdbiträde. Du ska ha arbetat inom omvårdnadsyrket och/eller äldreomsorgen tidigare.

Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team, tar initiativ och omsätter idéer i praktiken. Som person är du serviceinriktad, strukturerad och trygg i din yrkesroll.

Du behärskar svenska väl i tal och skrift, eftersom både kommunikation och dokumentation sker på svenska. Du är lyhörd, anpassar din kommunikation efter mottagaren och har en stark empatisk förmåga. Hos oss står alltid de boendes behov i centrum.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet enligt beskrivna kompetenser.

Intervjuer sker löpande så varmt välkommen med din ansök redan idag!

Varför välja Region Gotland?

Vi är öns största arbetsgivare – med över 200 olika yrken och 7000 medarbetare i Sveriges enda kombinerade region och kommun. Tillsammans utvecklar vi ett hållbart, tryggt och välmående Gotland för alla som bor på och besöker ön.

På Gotland finns ett rikt kulturliv, storslagen natur och en kreativ entreprenörsanda. Över 61 000 personer har valt att kalla Gotland för sitt hem, året runt. Är du inte en av oss än, men nyfiken på att bli? Läs mer om livet på ön på www.gotland.com/flytta-hit

Vi värnar om våra medarbetare och är stolta över våra förmåner. Läs gärna mer på www.gotland.se/formaner

På Instagramkontot @viarregiongotland kan du följa våra medarbetare och se bredden i våra olika verksamheter.

Så rekryterar vi

Vi arbetar enligt kompetensbaserad rekryteringsmetod och lägger därför stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet i enlighet med de kompetenser som beskrivs i annonsen. På så vis jobbar vi även aktivt för att motverka diskriminering.

Vi är måna om säkerhet och kvalité i våra rekryteringar och du kan därför komma att omfattas av kontroller inför anställning. Om det är aktuellt får du mer information av rekryterare. ID-handling och personbevis behöver alltid uppvisas.

Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver erbjudas medarbetare med företrädesrätt.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Dev Platform)
description:
Iterable is the leading AI-powered customer engagement platform that helps leading brands like Redfin, SeatGeek, Priceline, Calm, and Box create dynamic, individualized experiences at scale. Our platform empowers organizations to activate customer data, design seamless cross-channel interactions, and optimize engagement—all with enterprise-grade security and compliance. Today, nearly 1,200 brands across 50+ countries rely on Iterable to drive growth, deepen customer relationships, and deliver joyful customer experiences.

Our success is powered by extraordinary people who bring our core values—Be an Owner, Growth Mindset, Run as One, Transparency —to life. We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and inclusion, where ideas are valued and individuals are empowered to do their best work. That’s why we’ve been recognized as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces and Fastest Growing Companies, and were recognized on Forbes’ list of America’s Best Startup Employers in 2022. Notably, Iterable has also been listed on Wealthfront’s Career Launching Companies List and has held a top 10 ranking on the Top 25 Companies Where Women Want to Work.

With a global presence—including offices in San Francisco, Denver, London, Sydney, and Lisbon, plus remote employees worldwide—we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. Learn more about our story and mission on our Culture and About Us pages. Let’s shape the future of customer engagement together!

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Developer Platform Team, you will improve the platform foundations that Iterable engineers rely on to build, test, deploy, and operate services safely at scale. Your work will span the developer workflow end-to-end: from Scala, Bazel, and CI systems, through deployment workflows and self-service platforms, down to the Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure that make those experiences reliable in practice.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who is equally comfortable improving the inner loop for developers and owning the production platform systems behind it. You will lead high-leverage projects across build, test, deployment, and runtime infrastructure; drive work that reduces developer friction while improving reliability and cost efficiency; and partner closely with product engineering, infrastructure, security, and SRE to turn platform pain points into durable solutions.

  • Own the developer delivery path end to end: Improve the systems engineers' use to build, test, package, deploy, and validate changes with confidence across local development, CI, and production rollout workflows.
  • Lead shared engineering foundations: Evolve common libraries, build patterns, service templates, internal platform capabilities, and paved-path workflows that many teams depend on.
  • Improve CI performance, capacity, and reliability: Drive improvements to build and test feedback loops, runner health, workload placement, and failure isolation so engineers get faster, more predictable results.
  • Strengthen deployment and release infrastructure: Own and improve the control-plane systems that underpin delivery, including GitOps workflows, rollout orchestration, self-service deployment tooling, and the operational paths used to debug and recover production changes.
  • Take ownership of platform runtime infrastructure: Help operate and improve the Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure that underpins the engineering workflow, including cluster behavior, node-pool strategy, workload scheduling, access patterns, and reliability guardrails.
  • Turn recurring friction into durable leverage: Diagnose repeated failure modes across build, CI, deploy, and runtime systems, then solve them through automation, better defaults, observability, documentation, and platform product improvements.
  • Use AI to accelerate platform engineering safely: Apply tools like Cursor, Claude, and agentic workflows to codebase migrations, CI triage, platform automation, and internal tooling development with strong verification and guardrails.
  • Partner across engineering with senior ownership: Work closely with service teams and technical leaders to guide adoption, explain trade-offs, lead migrations, and make the paved path easier to use over time.

What We're Looking For

We prioritize strong software engineering fundamentals, systems thinking, and the ability to own ambiguous, cross-cutting platform problems from diagnosis through rollout. You do not need to have used our exact stack, but you should be comfortable learning deeply, operating in shared production systems, and building tools and infrastructure that other engineers depend on every day.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in Scala, Java, Kotlin, or another production language; able to read, modify, test, and review service code in a large shared codebase.
  • Experience owning a developer platform or infrastructure systems, such as build platforms, CI/CD, deployment tooling, internal developer portals, Kubernetes platforms, or cloud runtime infrastructure.
  • Strong working knowledge of build systems and delivery workflows; familiarity with Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Backstage, Bazel, EngFlow
  • Ability to debug complex failures that cross boundaries between application code, build tooling, CI runners, deployment systems, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience leading migrations or foundational platform changes with a meaningful blast radius, including rollout planning, risk management, communication, and follow-through on adoption.
  • Product-minded approach to internal platform engineering; you care about usability, feedback loops, self-service, operational clarity, and whether platform investments make engineers faster and more confident.
  • Comfort using AI tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar systems for real engineering work, including codebase exploration, migration support, test generation, CI triage, and agent orchestration.
  • Good judgment about AI-assisted automation: able to break complex tasks into plans, prompts, verification steps, and review loops with appropriate human oversight and safety guardrails.
  • Clear communicator who can work across product engineering, infrastructure, and security teams, explain trade-offs, keep stakeholders informed, and make steady progress in ambiguous technical areas.

What we offer

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Community Days (days for us to give back to the community)
  • Paid Annual Leave (22 days)

title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Balance Management
description:
At SumUp, the Global Bank team builds the core infrastructure and services that give merchants a digital bank account, helping small businesses manage their money easily and reliably.

The Balance Management Squad sits at the core of the Global Bank Platform. Right now, our team is completing a major milestone: consolidating and modernizing our balance management system in Europe. The next big step is creating a global transaction history service; a single, shared platform used by all regions to give merchants consistent and transparent views of their financial activity.

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll help modernize existing systems while balancing innovation with stability, collaborate with teams across regions, and build reliable services that manage diverse markets with different regulations.

If you enjoy solving complex problems on high-load systems, are curious about banking, and are looking for a team that tackles challenges head-on, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and evolve the SumUp’s core banking services that powers ledger operations and transactions, transforming our regional systems into a unified, scalable global platform.
  • Tackle complex distributed systems challenges, ensuring resilient services that continue to perform under high transaction volumes.
  • Support modernization initiatives by improving observability, adding test coverage, refactoring code for long-term maintainability, and gradually introducing new architectural patterns without disrupting live banking operations.
  • Contribute to key architectural decisions - build ledger and transaction history systems from the ground up, ensuring a globally scalable banking solution for our clients.
  • Collaborate with teams across Risk, Treasury, Finance, and Infrastructure to ensure smooth, compliant, and reliable global operations
  • Take ownership from design to production, running the services you build, monitoring their performance, and continuously improving how we deliver high-quality software at scale.

You’ll be great for this role if

  • You have solid backend experience building reliable, high-volume services and you think carefully about system design, APIs, data modeling, and how services interact.
  • You are proficient in Golang and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed, e.g. Kotlin or Elixir.
  • You write maintainable, well-tested code, follow CI/CD best practices, and take responsibility for the software you build from development to production.
  • You’re comfortable building, deploying, and running services in cloud environments like AWS using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • You’re eager to learn about relational databases that perform well under load and maintain data consistency.
  • You are a collaborator who enjoys working across regions, communicating clearly, exchanging feedback effectively, and making thoughtful technical decisions together.
  • You have a curiosity for building reliable financial services and banking domain

It’s a plus if you have

  • Knowledge of Elixir - some of our legacy services are written in Elixir, and while it's not essential, it would be useful if you've worked with it before
  • Deeper PostgreSQL experience - we rely heavily on Postgres, so if you've done performance tuning, complex queries, or schema design, that's a plus
  • Experience with event streaming platforms (Kafka preferred) and modern observability stacks (Grafana, Honeycomb, etc.)

Why you should join SumUp

  • Be part of a company that values diversity and celebrates unique perspectives.
  • Work with a global team of skilled professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration, learning, and growth.
  • Be part of a global tribe building a banking solution from the ground up and delivering impactful solutions to the real-life problems of millions of SumUp merchants all over the world
  • Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship programs, SumUp University leadership cohort and a yearly learning budget (2,000 EUR)
  • Sabbatical program for tenured SumUppers
  • Join a global team where you belong: Check out our D&I Initiatives and Employee Resource Groups such as Pride Club, SumAfro, Neurodiversity, Grupos Mais, Women in Tech, and more
  • Health & wellness benefits: in-house fitness classes, gym in the office, subsidized Urban Sports Club and available psychotherapy sessions
  • A lot of other benefits such as Subsidized Public Transport Card, Kita placement assistance, Pension Scheme, Language Learning platform/courses etc.
  • Enrollment onto our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing a vast set of simple and affordable business tools to help them start, run, and grow their businesses. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster an inclusivity and continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. title: Sjuksköterska sökes till Dialysmottagning i Arvika, dagtid
description:
Vill du ha ett meningsfullt dagtidsjobb med trygg anställning? Vi på Dialysmottagningen i Arvika söker nu en engagerad sjuksköterska för tillsvidareanställning, som vill bli en del av vårt sammansvetsade team. Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Din arbetsplats

Välkommen till njurmedicinkliniken och vår fina dialysmottagning på sjukhuset i Arvika. Verksamheten ingår i område medicinska specialiteter. Vi är ett härligt gäng som letar efter en ny kollega. Hos oss arbetar du i en trivsam arbetsmiljö med stimulerande arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling.

På dialysmottagningen finns totalt 12 patientplatser dit patienter kommer för att få sin njurersättande behandling (hemodialys). Våra arbetstider är måndag-fredag (07.00-15.30), lördag (07.00-15.00).

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som sjuksköterska kommer du att leda och ansvara för hemodialysbehandlingar, planera och organisera den dagliga driften samt vara huvudansvarig för patienter gällande bland annat ronder och provtagning. Sjuksköterskor och undersköterskor jobbar i team kring patienterna där man har ett bra stöd av varandra.

Dialysmottagningen har planerad verksamhet. Majoriteten av patienterna har kronisk njursvikt och behöver hemodialysbehandling flera gånger i veckan, som medarbetare här får du därför en nära kontakt med patienterna.

Inskolningen är individuellt anpassad under 10-12 veckor och du får två huvudhandledare.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning.

Dina kunskaper och kompetenser

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska, erfarenhet är meriterande men inget krav.

Som person har du en god samarbetsförmåga och tycker om att arbeta tillsammans med andra såväl som självständigt. Vi ser att du är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten samtidigt som du tar hänsyn till det större perspektivet och hela verksamhetens bästa i ditt sätt att agera och ta beslut.

Om Region Värmland

Vi är till för att alla som bor här ska må bra och för att vår region ska vara attraktiv och konkurrenskraftig. Vi gör skillnad inom hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och kultur och bildning. Vi möter människor i livets största stunder och i alla de där vardagsögonblicken där emellan. Vår vision är livskvalitet i världsklass. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss och våra förmåner och följ oss på sociala medier.

Vill du också jobba för alla i Värmland? Välkommen med din ansökan.

Övrigt

Från 7 juni 2026 gäller EU:s lönetransparensdirektiv - för ökad öppenhet och rättvisa löner. Information om kollektivavtal finns på SKR:s webbplats, Kollektivavtal -SKR

I samband med eventuell anställning kan vi komma att be dig som sökande att lämna ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister. Inför anställning inom psykiatrisk vård, vård av funktionshindrade, vård av barn eller ungdomar gör arbetsgivaren en kontroll i polisens misstanke och belastningsregister. Ett utslag i detta register kan komma att påverka din möjlighet till anställning.

Har du skyddad identitet och vill göra en ansökan ber vi dig att kontakta Kompetensförsörjningsenhet HR via Regionens växel 010-831 50 00. Då får du hjälp att lämna in din ansökan utan att den hanteras i Varbi. Tänk på att endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Region Värmland tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

title: 06. Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
About PayPay India

PayPay, a fintech company providing a service enjoyed by 70 million users (as of July 2025) merely 7 years since its launch in 2018 in Japan. The company is now home to a very diverse team of members from more than 50 countries. We grew to a team of several thousand employees in Japan but are far from over. We are still in the Day 1. Every day, new members join us from all over the world to create new value and deliver it to society.

Why India ?

To build our Payment services, we got technical cooperation from Paytm (A large payment service company in India). And based on their customer-first technologies , we created and expanded the smartphone payment service in Japan. Therefore, we have decided to establish a development base in India, because it is a major IT country with many talented engineers, as evidenced by the fact that cutting-edge mobile payments can continue to be generated.

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realise a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined.

AI-First Culture at PayPay

At PayPay, we believe the future of software development is AI-augmented engineering. Every engineer is expected to actively leverage AI tools for code reviews, testing, documentation, debugging, and productivity improvements. AI is not optional — it is a mandatory part of our daily engineering workflow. Candidates must demonstrate both hands-on experience and the right mindset to integrate AI effectively into their workflow, while maintaining the engineering rigor, ownership, and problem-solving skills that only humans can provide

Job Description

This role is based in PayPay India and focuses on Senior Technical Program Management across PayPay's product and platform portfolio. You will drive programs spanning payment processing, regulatory compliance, and platform integrations. The role requires close collaboration with India-based engineering teams and stakeholders across PayPay's headquarters in Japan.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Program Execution & Delivery

  • Independently drive technical programs of varying complexity, from well-defined projects to programs with multiple dependencies and cross-functional impact.
  • Establish and maintain program governance: risk registers, dependency maps, milestone tracking, and status reporting aligned to PayPay KPI framework (Predictability, Governance, Technical Health, Architecture).
  • Monitor program health across progress, risks, blockers, and timelines. Communicate transparently with stakeholders and escalate proactively.
  • Make program-level decisions on scope, schedule, and trade-offs with increasing autonomy.

Technical & Product Engagement

  • Contribute to and influence technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and TDD (Technical Design Document) reviews with focus on security, compliance, and payment integrity.
  • Engage with AI/ML applications in FinTech (fraud detection, risk scoring, recommendation engines) as they relate to program scope.
  • Ensure completion of non-functional requirements (Security, Performance, Compliance, Regulatory Requirements) prior to release milestones.
  • Partner with Engineering Managers and Product Managers to translate business goals into actionable execution plans aligned with financial services standards.

Agile & Process Leadership

  • Champion Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) within assigned teams, fostering transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Tailor PayPay SDLC practices to team context while maintaining alignment with organizational standards.
  • Facilitate planning, retrospectives, and cross-team coordination meetings as needed.
  • Leverage generative AI tools appropriately to enhance productivity in documentation, analysis, and communication tasks.
  • Identify and drive process improvements that benefit program delivery and team effectiveness.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Manage stakeholder alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, QA, and business partners.
  • Build strong working relationships across teams and geographies (India, Japan headquarters).
  • Represent programs in leadership forums and cross-functional planning sessions.

Mentorship & Collaboration

  • Mentor junior TPMs and new team members on program management fundamentals, PayPay processes, and best practices.
  • Contribute to the TPM community knowledge base and process documentation.
  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment within programs and teams.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
  • 10+ years professional experience, including 5–7 years in technical program management
  • Experience in FinTech, payments, banking, or financial services with exposure to payment processing or regulated product development
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, payment systems, and SDLC
  • Proven experience managing complex technical programs with multiple dependencies and cross-functional teams
  • Understanding of security and compliance requirements in financial services
  • Practical use of generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) for program management productivity
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

    • Deep knowledge of security and compliance frameworks in financial services (e.g., data protection, transaction security, regulatory standards)
    • Experience managing third-party integrations (payment gateways, banking systems, settlement platforms)
    • Experience managing AI/ML-driven programs in FinTech (fraud detection, risk models, transaction monitoring) with ability to identify AI-specific risks (data quality, model drift, bias, explainability)
    • Technical depth: working knowledge of programming languages, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines
    • Business-level English fluency for global collaboration
    • Experience mentoring TPMs or leading process improvement initiatives
    • Leverage AI/LLM-based tools in daily workflows (e.g., code development, reviews, testing, debugging, documentation), while ensuring human oversight, judgment, and accountability drive the final product.

Remarks

＊Please note that you cannot apply for PayPay (Japan-based jobs) or other positions in parallel or in duplicate.

PayPay 5 senses

  • Please refer PayPay 5 senses to learn what we value at work.

title: Kainuun vastaanottokeskuksen sosiaalityöntekijä
description:
Oletko sosiaalityön ammattilainen? Haluatko tehdä ihmisläheistä ja merkityksellistä työtä moniammatillisessa työyhteisössä?

Babandon Kainuun aikuisten ja perheiden vastaanottokeskukseen haetaan sosiaalityöntekijää toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Babando on vuonna 2017 perustettu kotimainen sosiaali- ja terveysalan valtakunnallinen toimija, joka tuottaa ensiluokkaisia vastaanottokeskuspalveluita turvapaikkaa hakeneille ja tilapäistä suojelua saaville aikuisille, nuorille ja perheille. Nykyiset yksikkömme sijaitsevat Kainuussa ja Rovaniemellä. Palveluidemme piirissä on päivittäin yli 700 henkilöä.

Sosiaalityöntekijän työnkuva

Sosiaalityöntekijänä vastaat asiakkaille järjestettävistä lakisääteisistä sosiaalihuollon palveluista. Tehtäväsi on edistää ja tukea asiakkaiden sosiaalista turvallisuutta ja toimintakykyä sosiaalityön keinoin.

Työnkuvaasi kuuluu muun muassa turvapaikanhakijoiden ja tilapäistä suojelua saavien neuvontaa ja ohjausta, hyvinvoinnin seuraamista ja edistämistä, palvelun ja tuen tarpeen arviointia, lausuntojen laatimista ja tarvittavan avun tarjoamista ilmenneissä ongelma- ja kriisitilanteissa. Työskentelet moniammatillisessa tiimissä ja tarvittaessa tiiviissä yhteistyössä eri viranomaisten, muun muassa hyvinvointialueen sosiaalityöntekijän kanssa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Edellytämme sinulta sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (817/2015) mukaista pätevyyttä ja oikeutta käyttää sosiaalityöntekijän ammattinimikettä. Huomioimme myös sijaispätevät hakijat muodollisesti pätevien hakijoiden puuttuessa. Vastaanottopalveluista ja sosiaalihuollosta säädetyn lain perusteellinen tuntemus on työssä tärkeää.

Katsomme eduksi aiemman kokemuksen työskentelystä vastaanottokeskuksessa, maahanmuuttajien parissa moniammatillisessa työyhteisössä sekä kokemuksen työskentelystä tulkin kanssa. Ajokortti, hyvä IT-osaaminen sekä hyvä suomen kielen taito ovat välttämättömiä työssä. Lisäksi arvostamme laajempaa kielitaitoa.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos koet työn vastaanottokeskuksessa merkitykselliseksi, ja sinulla on aito halu olla vaikuttamassa positiivisesti ja ennaltaehkäisevästi apua tarvitsevien elämäntilanteeseen. Odotamme sinulta kykyä ottaa vastuuta ja työskennellä myös itsenäisesti ratkaisukeskeisellä ja määrätietoisella otteella nopeasti muuttuvassa ympäristössä. Hyvät kommunikointi- ja yhteistyötaidot ovat työssä ensiarvoisen tärkeitä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä moniammatillisissa työyhteisöissä, joissa tukenasi on koko muu tiimi, mukaan lukien sosiaaliohjaaja, sairaanhoitajat, ohjaajat, etuuskäsittelijä ja johtaja. Tarjoamme sinulle myös kilpailukykyisen palkan.Perehdytämme sinut tehtäviisi ja käytössäsi on puhelintulkkaus. Tarjoamme työsi tueksi säännöllisen työnohjauksen, Babandon yksiköiden sosiaalityön tiimin, kouluttautumismahdollisuuksia, työterveyden palvelut sekä kulttuuri- ja liikuntaedun!

Työsuhde solmitaan Babando Oy:n kanssa. Työsuhteen alussa noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.

Koetko, että sinulla olisi edellytykset menestyä tässä työtehtävässä? Lähetä hakemus ja muistahan liittää mukaan CV:si sekä palkkatoiveesi:https://babando.teamtailor.com/jobs/8172056-kainuun-vastaanottokeskuksen-sosiaalityontekija?promotion=2131552-trackable-share-link-tyomarrkinatori

Haku päättyy 19.8.2026. Haethan pian, etenemme prosessissa jo hakuaikana, kun sopiva hakija löytyy.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa 10.8.2026 alkaen Kainuun vastaanottokeskuksen johtaja Emma Juntunen emma.juntunen@babando.fi tai 044 710 1448.

title: Commercialization Project Manager
description:
Mavericks Wanted

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on

In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.

Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.

About BridgeBio

BridgeBio is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing, and delivering transformative medicines for patients living with genetic diseases and genetically defined cancers. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a diverse portfolio of more than 20 drug development programs, ranging from early discovery to late-stage clinical trials, across multiple therapeutic areas including precision oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, neurology, and renal disease. We have already achieved regulatory approval for three therapies and continue to advance promising science from academia into meaningful treatments for patients worldwide.

Who We Are

BridgeBio is a global biotechnology company with our Global Headquarters located in San Francisco, USA, and our International HQ located in Zug, Switzerland. Since establishing our European presence in 2021, we’ve been building empowered, high-performing teams across countries — experienced colleagues who move quickly, take ownership, and are fueling the company’s international growth.

At BridgeBio, you’ll find an energetic and collaborative culture where pragmatism meets bold decision-making. We embrace uncertainty with confidence, guided by our commitment to making a meaningful impact for patients. Our people are trusted and empowered, united by urgency, purpose, and the drive to advance science for patients around the world.

What You’ll Do

The Commercialization Project Manager will report directly to the Head of International Supply Chain and will work remotely from the Netherlands. This role is responsible for driving the successful execution of product commercialization activities within Supply Chain. This role acts as the primary link between the Packaging and Regulatory departments, ensuring flawless execution of Artwork milestones to support a timely product launch. In addition, this role will own the Supply Chain Change Control strategy, support the implementation of a Product Variation Management process, and provide flexible project support across the broader Supply Chain portfolio.

Responsibilities:

Change Control Management

  • Initiate, assess, and manage change controls related to commercialization activities
  • Coordinate cross-functional impact assessments with Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Packaging/Artwork and other teams as required
  • Track change control progress against timelines, escalating risks and delays proactively
  • Ensure change controls are documented in compliance with Good Documentation Practices and other GxP requirements

Variation Management

  • Support the creation and continuous improvement of the product Variation Management process
  • Coordinate post-approval variations related to product changes (CMC / Labeling) and aligns with internal stakeholders on the approval and implementation windows
  • Maintain variation trackers and ensure traceability between variations, change controls, manufacturing and artwork updates

  • Fluent in written and spoken English
  • Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills

As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location. We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The Role

We're looking for a Lead Technical Business Analyst to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of change delivery across the FT's Product & Technology organisation.

Reporting into the Portfolio & Programmes team, you'll lead the assessment, discovery and technical analysis of new initiatives entering our change portfolio. Working closely with stakeholders across Product, Technology, Data and the wider business, you'll ensure ideas are well understood, appropriately scoped and assessed for feasibility, complexity and delivery readiness before they progress into prioritisation and planning.

As the lead business analyst within the portfolio function, you'll establish best practice for business analysis, mentor other analysts and act as a trusted advisor, helping teams make informed investment and delivery decisions that support the FT's strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the assessment and triage of new change initiatives entering the Product & Technology portfolio.
  • Facilitate discovery workshops to understand business needs, define outcomes and clarify requirements.
  • Produce high-quality business, functional and non-functional requirements that support successful solution design.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers and Delivery teams to assess solution options, technical feasibility and delivery complexity.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, assumptions and implementation constraints early in the change lifecycle.
  • Support business case development, investment decisions and portfolio prioritisation with clear analysis and recommendations.
  • Contribute to portfolio planning by providing insights into delivery effort, resource requirements and roadmap sequencing.
  • Build trusted relationships across Product, Technology, Editorial, Commercial, Data and Corporate teams.
  • Define and champion business analysis standards, tools and best practices across the organisation.
  • Coach and mentor other Business Analysts while driving continuous improvement across portfolio intake and discovery processes.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Significant experience as a Senior or Lead Business Analyst within technology, digital product or transformation environments.
  • Extensive experience leading discovery, requirements gathering and solution assessment activities.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex business and technical challenges into clear, actionable requirements.
  • Experience working closely with engineering, architecture, product and delivery teams throughout the change lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, systems integration and modern technology platforms.
  • Experience supporting business cases, investment decisions and portfolio planning.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels.

Desirable

  • Experience within media, publishing, digital subscription or technology-led organisations.
  • Experience supporting portfolio management, governance or demand management functions.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Lean delivery approaches and modern product operating models.
  • Exposure to enterprise architecture, cloud technologies or data platforms.

What's in it for You?

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments or personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements, or have any questions, please send an email to talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further Information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

Interested in the FT but don’t see the right role yet? Join our Talent Community to receive exclusive updates, featured jobs, and insights into working at the FT.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Site Reliability Engineer at Alpaca, you'll help keep our brokerage platform reliable, observable, and operable as we grow - working across our cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platform, observability stack, messaging layer, and data layer. We're especially interested in candidates with strong PostgreSQL fundamentals who'd like to grow into deeper ownership of our database reliability posture: PostgreSQL sits on the trading-critical path, and we want this person to spend a meaningful share of their time leveling it up while still being a well-rounded SRE the rest of the week.

Things You Get To Do

  • Operate production day-to-day - oncall, incident response, postmortems, and the follow-ups that actually close the loop.
  • Own reliability practice - define and refine SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, and help product teams live within them.
  • Strengthen our observability across metrics, logs, traces, and alerting.
  • Ship infrastructure through code in a GitOps workflow - cloud resources and Kubernetes workloads alike.
  • Look after PostgreSQL: performance tuning, schema and migration review, online migrations on large tables, HA/DR, and CDC pipelines.
  • Mentor engineers on reliability and database fundamentals through code review, design review, and pairing.

Who You Are (must-haves)

  • 4+ years in SRE, DevOps, Platform/Infrastructure, or backend engineering with significant production operations ownership.
  • Hands-on experience operating production services on Kubernetes, and shipping infrastructure as code in a GitOps workflow.
  • Solid working knowledge of PostgreSQL in production — query plans, pg_stat_*, indexing and schema trade-offs, and what a safe online migration looks like on a non-trivial table.
  • Cloud networking fundamentals (VPCs, routing, L4/L7 load balancing, DNS, TLS) and comfort debugging cross-service connectivity.
  • Comfortable with a modern observability stack and proficient with Linux at the operator level.
  • Practiced in incident response - calm under pressure, structured debugging, postmortems that drive change.
  • At least working proficiency in Go or Python, plus strong written and verbal communication.
  • Genuine interest in databases and in growing your PostgreSQL/DBA expertise.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Deeper PostgreSQL experience: large clusters at OLTP load, online migrations on big tables, HA/DR ownership, connection pooling at scale, or change-data-capture pipelines.
  • Experience with typed SQL access layers in Go (e.g. pgx, gorm, sqlc).
  • Production experience with messaging systems at scale (e.g. RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redpanda).
  • Security & compliance experience in a regulated environment (SOC 2, secrets management, audit logging).
  • Familiarity with trading, brokerage, or other regulated fintech domains.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

title: Kassa-myyjiä, Tammisaari (vakituinen 30h/vko)
description:
Hei!

Nyt on maailman paras ostaja hankkinut hyllyt täyteen laatutuotteita ja meillä on tarjolla työpaikkoja asiakaspalveluhenkisille ja vauhdikkaasta työstä nauttiville työkavereille! Haluatko sinä mukaan ystävälliseen porukkaamme?

Kassa-myyjänä pääset yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa varmistamaan asiakkaillemme mukavan ja mutkattoman asiointikokemuksen Tokmannin myymälässä.

Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myymälässämme asioivien asiakkaidemme auttaminen erilaisissa kysymyksissä, ja aina autamme myös toisiamme, kun tiimissä tarvitaan apua.

Kattavan valikoimamme ansiosta pääset laittamaan esille esimerkiksi pukeutumiseen, vapaa-aikaan sekä kodin arkeen ja kunnostamiseen liittyviä tuotteita ja opastamaan asiakkaitamme monenlaisissa kysymyksissä.

Haemme kolmea uutta kassa-myyjää. Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja työaika on 30h/vko. Sinulla on meillä työskennellessäsi myös mahdollisuus tehdä osa sopimuksesi tunneista tai lisätunteja työskentelemällä lähimyymälöissäsi. Täytämme tehtävän heti, kun löydämme sopivan työkaverin joukkoomme, joten toimithan pian!

Voit olla etsimämme työkaveri, jos olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on:

  • Iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne
  • Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää
  • Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä
  • Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli
  • Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin
  • Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen

Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.

Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.

title: Opzichter warmte
description:
Onze warmtenetten groeien snel. Daarom zoeken we een opzichter die niet alleen meedenkt, maar ook meedoet. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen de technische voorbereiding binnen en de uitvoering buiten. Als Opzichter Warmte ben jij de ogen en oren van het project op locatie en zorg je ervoor dat de aanleg, uitbreiding en aanpassing van onze warmtenetten soepel, veilig en volgens plan verloopt. Zo draag jij concreet bij aan de energietransitie. Je begeleidt zowel grote als kleinere projecten – van de aanleg van nieuwe warmteleidingen tot reconstructies van bestaande netten en de bouw van onderstations of andere technische onderdelen van het systeem. Je werkt nauw samen met projectleiders, engineers en aannemers en schakelt met gemeenten, netbeheerders en bewoners.


Dit ga je doen
• Je begeleidt de werkzaamheden van onze aannemers en ziet toe op kwaliteit, veiligheid en planning.
• Je ondersteunt bij ontwerp, aanbesteding en de uitvoeringsfase van projecten.
• Je bewaakt de technische uitvoering en grijpt in bij afwijkingen of knelpunten.
• Je controleert naleving van de VGM-richtlijnen (Veiligheid, Gezondheid en Milieu) op de werkplaats.
• Je registreert afwijkingen, stelt verbetervoorstellen op en zorgt voor een goede administratieve afronding.
• Je draait mee in de storingsdienst en stuurt externe storingsmedewerkers aan indien nodig.


Over het team
Je komt terecht in een betrokken en deskundig team dat samenwerkt aan innovatieve warmteprojecten. De sfeer is open en informeel: we helpen elkaar, delen kennis en hebben oog voor kwaliteit én veiligheid. Humor en samenwerking maken ons sterk.

"Het mooiste vind ik als iemand vraagt: ‘heb je daar wel aan gedacht?’ en het al geregeld is."

Arjan Lont - werkvoorbereider

• Je beschikt over een technische mbo-opleiding op niveau 3 of 4.
• Je hebt 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in installatietechniek, warmtenetten of civiele techniek.
• Je hebt ervaring binnen de bouw.
• Je hebt kennis van VEWA, VGM-voorschriften en actuele technische normen.
• Je werkt gestructureerd, communiceert helder en denkt in oplossingen.
• Je weet hoe je samen met anderen doelen bereikt en houdt oog voor kwaliteit en veiligheid en je beheerst de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift, minimaal C1 niveau.

title: Työnjohtaja vauriokorjaamolle, K-Auto Lahti
description:
K Auto Lahti etsii nyt määräaikaista työnjohtajaa vauriokorjaamolle aikavälille 1.9. - 31.12.2026. Määräaikaisuuden perusteena on perhevapaan sijaisuus.

Vauriokorjaamon työnjohtajana tärkein tehtäväsi on varmistaa asiakkaallemme sujuva huoltokokemus aina ensimmäisestä yhteydenotosta alkaen.

Työnjohtajan tehtävät koostuvat erityisesti asiakaspalvelusta – asiakkaiden vastaanotosta, vauriokorjaustarpeen selvittämisestä sekä lisäpalveluiden myymisestä. Lisäksi työnjohtajan tehtäviin kuuluvat erilaiset takuuprosessiin liittyvät työvaiheet, ajanvarauskalenterien hallinta sekä tuotannonsuunnittelu.

Tehtävässä menestyäksesi olet aidosti innostunut alasta ja asiakaspalvelusta. Olet nopea oppimaan ja käytät sujuvasti digitaalisia välineitä asiakaspalvelussa.

Aiempi kokemus korjaamon työtehtävistä, Cabas- sekä Automaster -järjestelmän tuntemus katsotaan eduksi, samoin K-Auton edustamien brändien huolto-ohjelmien sekä takuukäytäntöjen tuntemus. Voit kuitenkin olla myös uraasi aloitteleva tulevaisuuden ammattilainen, jolla on asenne kohdallaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Digitalisaatioon kannustavasti suhtautuvan työympäristön
  • Inspiroivan ja ammattimaisen työyhteisön tuen
  • Monipuoliset urapolkuvaihtoehdot kansainvälisessä porukassa
  • Konsernin laajan tuen ja työsuhde-edut

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Positiivista asiakaspalveluasennetta
  • Cabas/ Automaster ohjelmien käyttökokemusta
  • Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa
  • Paineensietokykyä
  • Ajokorttia
  • Soveltuvaa alan koulutusta, esim. AMK insinööri tai työnjohdon erikoisammattitutkinto
  • Englannin kielitaitoa

K-ryhmä on uudistuva, vahva ja vastuullinen toimija kahdeksassa maassa. Tarjoamme sinulle joka päivä yhä mielenkiintoisempaa tekemistä sekä uusia näköaloja. Pidämme myös visusti huolta toisistamme, asiakkaista, yhteiskunnasta ja ympäristöstä.

Autokaupan ala on jatkuvassa murroksessa ja tarjoaa siten mielenkiintoisen työympäristön sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää jokaisen yksilöllisiä vahvuuksia.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa korjaamopäällikkö Joni Järvinen, sähköpostitse joni.jarvinen@k-auto.fi.

Lähetä hakemuksesi 30.8.2026 mennessä oheisen linkin kautta. Huom! Palkkaamme heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

title: Head of Forward Deployed Engineering EMEA
description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians have flexibility in where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, as part of being a distributed-first company.

Your future team

As a Head of Forward Deployed Engineering EMEA at Atlassian, you’ll be at the forefront of applied AI, working directly with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, AI-powered solutions. The FDE team partners with top organizations across industries, helping them leverage Atlassian’s AI capabilities to solve complex, real-world problems. You’ll collaborate with product, engineering, and design, rapidly growing your technical and domain expertise while making a tangible impact on business outcomes. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for those who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are passionate about shaping the future of AI-powered teamwork.

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

As a Head of Forward Deployed Engineering EMEA, you will:

  • Hire, onboard, and retain top talent for your team and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.

  • Mentor and coach your forward-deployed engineering team on best practices in AI/ML solution design, code quality, scalable architecture, testing, debugging, and documentation—ensuring rapid, high-quality delivery of customer-focused, production-ready solutions.

  • Drive data-driven solution development by analyzing complex datasets to extract insights and inform product direction.

  • Champion the adoption of AI-augmented workflow automation within customer environments, maximizing business value and operational efficiency.

  • Oversee the end-to-end deployment of AI solutions into production, ensuring continuous evaluation, monitoring, and improvement.

  • Navigate risk and compliance requirements, including AI risk assessment, data privacy (GDPR), and regulatory frameworks.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, creating concise artifacts for peers, partners, and leadership.

  • Align technical solutions with business objectives, setting a clear vision for technological progress and measurable results.

Qualifications

Your background

On the first day, we'll expect you to have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of experience managing software engineering teams at scale.

  • Experience delivering impactful AI/ML solutions in production environments, including experience as a founding or forward-deployed engineer in 0-to-1 product development.

  • Deep expertise in applied AI/ML, including generative AI, LLMs, and agent-based frameworks.

  • Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, and experience with APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration.

  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems and thrive in rapidly changing environments.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority.

  • Experience with AI risk assessment, data privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR).

  • Strategic and innovative thinking, with a track record of aligning technical solutions to business goals.

It's great, but not required, if you have:

  • Experience with Atlassian Intelligence, Rovo AI, or AI-powered Atlassian features.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare).

  • Experience deploying AI solutions to complex production systems at scale.

  • Prior experience mentoring or leading engineering teams.

Our perks & benefits

Atlassian offers a variety of perks and benefits to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health coverage, paid volunteer days, wellness resources, and so much more. Visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits to learn more.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
description:
The Continuous Improvement Specialist is responsible for driving manufacturing excellence through the deployment of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, problem-solving methodologies, and digital solutions. This role partners with plant leadership and functional teams to identify opportunities, eliminate operational losses, improve productivity, and deliver sustainable cost savings while building a high-performance continuous improvement culture.

The incumbent will lead strategic improvement initiatives, facilitate capability development, utilize business intelligence tools to drive data-based decisions, and support the achievement of key business objectives in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People engagement. The role requires strong analytical skills, project leadership capabilities, and a passion for operational excellence and transformation.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Lead and facilitate Continuous Improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, SMED, RCA, 5S, and Problem-Solving methodologies.

  • Identify productivity losses, process inefficiencies, and operational bottlenecks through data analysis and shopfloor engagement.

  • Drive loss elimination programs to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), productivity, quality, and operational performance.

  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

  • Facilitate Kaizen events, workshops, and improvement projects across manufacturing operations.

  • Support implementation and sustainability of Manufacturing Operating Systems (MOS) and operational excellence programs.

Process Optimization & Performance Improvement

  • Analyze manufacturing processes, line performance, capacity utilization, labor productivity, and resource efficiency.

  • Develop and implement initiatives that improve throughput, reduce waste, optimize workflows, and lower operational costs.

  • Partner with Production, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and SHE teams to deliver improvement objectives.

  • Monitor key operational KPIs and develop action plans to close performance gaps.

  • Support annual productivity, savings, and cost optimization targets.

Digitalization & Data Analytics

  • Develop and maintain performance dashboards, reports, and analytics tools using Power BI or equivalent platforms.

  • Drive data-driven decision-making across manufacturing teams.

  • Identify opportunities for automation, workflow optimization, and digital transformation.

  • Support implementation of Industry 4.0 initiatives and digital manufacturing solutions.

  • Translate operational data into actionable insights that drive business performance.

Project Management

  • Lead cross-functional improvement projects from opportunity identification through implementation and sustainment.

  • Manage project timelines, stakeholder engagement, risk assessment, and business benefits realization.

  • Ensure project governance, documentation, and reporting standards are maintained.

  • Present improvement outcomes and recommendations to plant leadership teams.

Capability Building & Culture Development

  • Promote a strong Continuous Improvement culture throughout the organization.

  • Deliver training and coaching in Lean Manufacturing, Problem Solving, Root Cause Analysis, and CI tools.

  • Support competency development and employee capability-building initiatives.

  • Encourage idea generation and employee involvement in improvement programs.

  • Act as a change agent to foster innovation, teamwork, and operational excellence.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Engineering, IT, Data Analytics, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or related fields
  • Fluent in the local language with strong English proficiency (written and spoken)
  • 3–5 years of experience in manufacturing, digital transformation, continuous improvement, business intelligence, or related areas

Good to have:

  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills across shopfloor and management levels
  • Solid experience in capability development, training coordination, and competency frameworks
  • Hands-on knowledge of manufacturing operations and Continuous Improvement methodologies (Lean, Kaizen, 5S, RCA, Autonomous Maintenance)
  • Proficient in data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Grafana, Azure Data Explorer, and Microsoft Power Platform
  • Experience driving digital solutions, automation, and data-driven improvement initiatives
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate business needs into practical solutions
  • Understanding of manufacturing data, systems, and performance management concepts
  • Proven ability in project management, cross-functional collaboration, and developing training materials/SOPs
  • Passion for continuous learning, digitalization, and operational excellence

title: Head of Projects
description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The Role

As Head of Projects, you will lead the Project Management function across Product & Technology, ensuring the successful delivery of strategic change initiatives and complex product development programmes.

Reporting to the Vice President, Portfolio and Programmes, you will provide leadership across project delivery, resource management and governance, enabling teams to deliver predictable, high-quality outcomes in a hybrid Agile environment. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Programme Leaders and business stakeholders, you'll ensure delivery commitments are realistic, risks are proactively managed and portfolio priorities are translated into achievable plans.

This is a highly visible leadership role, responsible for developing a high-performing team of Project Managers while continuously improving delivery capability, governance and operational excellence across Product & Technology.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the Project Management function across Product & Technology, driving consistent, high-quality delivery across a portfolio of strategic initiatives.
  • Provide leadership, coaching and performance management for Project Managers, fostering a collaborative and high-performing delivery culture.
  • Oversee delivery planning, governance, risks, dependencies and milestone management across multiple programmes and projects.
  • Own resource management and workforce planning, ensuring delivery capacity aligns with business priorities.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Portfolio Governance and business leaders to improve delivery predictability and execution.
  • Champion delivery practices that balance Agile ways of working with effective governance and organisational commitments.
  • Develop and maintain delivery metrics, reporting and performance indicators to support informed decision-making.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for delivery risks, resource conflicts and organisational blockers.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management standards, methodologies and delivery capability across the organisation.
  • Build strong relationships across Product, Technology, Editorial, Commercial, Data and Corporate functions to enable successful delivery outcomes.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Significant experience leading project delivery teams within complex technology, digital product or transformation environments.
  • Proven experience managing Project Managers or multidisciplinary delivery teams.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile, hybrid and project-based delivery methodologies.
  • Demonstrated success delivering complex business and technology change initiatives.
  • Experience in resource management, workforce planning and delivery capacity forecasting.
  • Strong understanding of project, programme and portfolio management disciplines.
  • Experience establishing delivery governance frameworks, planning processes and performance management approaches.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.
  • Experience working within complex matrix organisations.
  • Professional project management certification (such as APM, PRINCE2, AgilePM, CSM or equivalent).

Desirable

  • Experience within media, publishing, digital subscription or technology-led organisations.
  • Experience working within portfolio management environments.
  • Knowledge of Lean delivery approaches, product operating models and modern delivery practices.

What's in it for You?

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments or personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, please email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further Information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact talent@ft.com.

Interested in the FT but don’t see the right role yet? Join our Talent Community to receive exclusive updates, featured jobs, and insights into working at the FT.

title: Työntekijöitä teollisuuden avustaviin tehtäviin, Raahe
description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme keikkatöistä kiinnostunutta työntekijää Raahen alueelle.

Työtehtävät painottuvat teollisuuden avustaviin tehtäviin. Keikkojen kesto vaihtelee tyypillisesti yhdestä päivästä noin kahteen viikkoon. Työturvallisuuskortti ja tulityökortti katsotaan eduksi.

Huom! Tarjotut keikat eivät ole sitovia, vaan voit valita tarjotuista töistä ne, jotka sopivat omaan aikatauluusi.

Odotamme sinulta:

- Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää
- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa
- Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia
- Joustavaa asennetta

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä vaihtelevissa kohteissa
- Joustavat työajat, joihin pääset vaikuttamaan itse
- Työterveyden Terveystalolla

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemus linkin<http://tepjo.likeit.fi/apply/11458369> kautta niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä mahdollisimman pian.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan tekijän löydyttyä.

title: Professional Services Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Professional Services Consultant based in Canada.

This role offers the opportunity to help organizations transform their workplace learning strategies through innovative technology and expert consulting.
You will work directly with customers to deliver impactful learning platform implementations, technical configurations, and integrations.
The position combines project management, technical problem-solving, and client advisory skills in a collaborative SaaS environment.
You will partner with HR, IT, and Learning & Development teams to design solutions that improve employee learning experiences.
With exposure to diverse customer challenges, you will manage complex projects while driving measurable business outcomes.
This is an ideal opportunity for a consultant who enjoys ownership, continuous learning, and creating long-term customer value.

Accountabilities:

As a Professional Services Consultant, you will lead customer engagements from discovery through delivery, ensuring successful implementations and strong client relationships. You will combine technical expertise, project management capabilities, and consulting skills to configure solutions, manage expectations, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

  • Scope, plan, and deliver paid consulting engagements focused on platform administration, configuration, and technical solutions.
  • Lead discovery sessions with stakeholders and translate business needs into clear project plans, statements of work, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage projects across HR, IT, Learning & Development, and compliance teams, ensuring alignment, progress, and successful completion.
  • Configure learning management system environments, including user structures, workflows, branding, enrollment rules, and e-commerce settings.
  • Support technical integrations involving data migration, single sign-on solutions, APIs, and scheduled data feeds.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects while tracking timelines, budgets, risks, and deliverables.
  • Create and maintain project documentation, including configuration records, decision logs, and transition materials.
  • Provide internal consulting support on platform administration, reporting, and data-related questions.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings a combination of SaaS consulting experience, technical knowledge, and strong stakeholder management skills. You should be comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and translating technical concepts into business solutions.

    • 3+ years of experience delivering client-facing projects in professional services, consulting, SaaS implementation, or learning management administration.
    • Hands-on experience administering a commercial learning management system or similar enterprise platform.
    • Proven ability to manage multiple projects with different timelines, budgets, stakeholders, and delivery requirements.
    • Working knowledge of single sign-on technologies such as SAML 2.0 and OIDC, REST APIs, and flat-file data integrations.
    • Experience working with data reporting, validation, imports, and communicating insights to non-technical audiences.
    • Familiarity with e-learning standards such as SCORM, xAPI, or AICC, as well as HRIS/HCM integrations, is an advantage.
    • Experience with project management methodologies or certifications such as PMP or CAPM is a plus.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
    • Strong communication, problem-solving, organization, and client relationship management skills.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote-first work environment with flexible working arrangements.
      • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical and dental coverage depending on location.
      • Retirement savings programs and eligibility for bonus plans.

      • New hire equipment allowance and monthly flexibility allowance.
      • Opportunities for career growth, professional development, and internal mobility.
      • Employee-led diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.
      • Collaborative culture focused on innovation, continuous learning, and teamwork.
