title: Senior Software Engineer - Build - NYC
description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and powers data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 800 of the world's leading enterprises, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit .

About this role

Apache Airflow is one of the most popular open-source data platform tools. It powers the data platforms at nearly every large company and fast-growing startups: Airbnb, Uber, OpenAI, Anthropic, Nike, Capital One, Disney all use Airflow extensively. At Astronomer, we’re the largest contributors to the project and are building commercial products around Airflow to make it easier to use, run, and scale.

We’re in a unique position: as the company behind Apache Airflow, we see data as it moves across entire organizations—from raw ingestion to production dashboards, machine learning models, and AI products. Leveraging this vantage point, our R&D team is developing a global context layer for data—an intelligence layer that powers search and discovery, code generation for data and analytics, and automated root cause analysis. LLMs are already quite good at writing Python and SQL code against data platforms; we think this context layer will give them the metadata necessary for data practitioners everywhere to use LLMs effectively.

As a Software Engineer on this team, you’ll help design and build this foundation and the applications around it. You’ll work on some of the hardest and most exciting challenges in data—search, information retrieval, and AI for data pracitioners—while collaborating with a small, highly skilled team that values velocity, creativity, and impact. This role sits at the intersection of applied research, software engineering, and product: we think it takes someone who can work across the stack to build, release, and scale products successfully in this space.

Hybrid Work Model: For this role, you will embrace a flexible hybrid work model with at least 3 days per week in our New York City office.


What you get to do:

  • Shape the future of AI for data engineering - build intelligent systems that understand, reason about, and optimize the flow of data across entire organizations.

  • Design and engineer the brain of Astronomer’s context layer, crafting components that power data modeling, semantic search, retrieval, and code generation.

  • Push the boundaries of applied AI - experiment with LLMs, embeddings, and cutting-edge retrieval techniques to create developer tools that deliver insights to you and our customers.

  • Turn research into reality - work side by side with R&D and product teams to bring early AI concepts to life in the product experience.

  • Solve high-impact information retrieval and search challenges at a global scale, leveraging Astronomer’s unparalleled visibility into data pipelines across industries.

  • Influence the technical vision and architecture for the next generation of AI-driven data products.

  • Represent Astronomer in the community - through open-source contributions, technical talks, and publications that showcase our leadership in AI and data innovation.

What you bring to the role:

  • 5-8 years of software engineering experience with Python or Go

  • Empathy for users, and a deep interest in improving the workflows of data professionals.

  • Familiarity with early-stage product development; comfortable working with ambiguity in a fast-changing field.

  • Experience with LLMs, vector databases, embeddings, or other applied AI areas—or a strong desire to dive in.

  • A creative, experimental mindset: you enjoy exploring uncharted areas, validating hypotheses, and learning through iteration.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills—you can explain complex systems clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A collaborative approach and comfort working in an evolving, research-driven environment where ideas move quickly.

Bonus points if you have:

  • A passion for AI systems for data, developer tools, or machine learning infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with Apache Airflow or other orchestration tools.

  • Demonstrated contributions to open source projects.

  • Experience in search, IR, or large-scale data infrastructure.

  • Exposure to early-stage startups or R&D organizations where ambiguity is the norm.

  • Experience building out agentic systems on top of frontier models.

The estimated total compensation for this role ranges from $210,000 - $250,000 based on leveling and geography, along with an equity component and a comprehensive benefits package. This range is merely an estimate; actual compensation may deviate from this range based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

title: Sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere til ny mobil sundhedsindsats
description:
I Norddjurs Kommune ønsker vi at styrke de borgerrettede sundhedsindsatser ude i nærområderne, som et led i den kommende folkesundhedslov. Vi udvikler og igangsætter derfor et nyt mobilt sundhedstilbud, som skal danne grundlag for at folkesundheden øges. Vores ambition er, at den mobile løsning giver mange flere borgere mulighed for at få vejledning om, hvordan de kan fremme egen sundhed selv, eller ved at deltage i tilbud i kommunen eller civilsamfundet.

Derfor søger vi i Sundhed Norddjurs to sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere, der brænder for at arbejde opsøgende og møde borgerne i øjenhøjde ude i nærområderne. Nærområder skal forstås bredt, idet der både kan være tale om små lokalsamfund, virksomheder, boligområder mv. Her skal I invitere ind til samtaler og vejledning om sundhed, samt bygge bro til eksisterende indsatser i såvel kommune som civilsamfund.

Vi forestiller os, at det mobile sundhedstilbud skal være en dynamisk enhed, hvor indholdet i tilbuddet kan suppleres med andre tiltag, hvis det findes relevant for at fremme borgernes sundhed. Derudover kan den nye folkesundhedslov få indflydelse på indholdet i tilbuddet.

Nedenfor kan du se et udpluk af dine arbejdsopgaver:
  • Planlægning af mobile indsatser i nærområder, som borgerne oplever meningsfulde
  • Promovering af indsatser så de efterspørges af borgerne
  • Udføre helbredssamtaler med vejledning og rådgivning i forhold til borgerens fysiske, mentale og sociale sundhed
  • Udføre sundhedstjek med måling af blodtryk, lungefunktion, bioimpedans, screening for diabetes, gangfunktion mv.
  • Informere om og støtte borgerne i at fremme egen sundhed, eksempelvis ved at gøre brug af digitale redskaber såsom Helpii og Exorlive
  • Brobygning og samarbejde med civilsamfundet
  • Dokumentation og evaluering af indsatsen
  • Planlægning og integration af nationale kampagner i nærområder

Du får stor indflydelse på udvikling af dine arbejdsopgaver og den mobile sundhedsindsats. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du er proaktiv, kreativ og opsøgende for at vi kan lykkes med at få sundhedstilbud ud i nærområderne til gavn for borgerne.

Vi forestiller os, at du har:
  • En uddannelsesmæssig baggrund som fysioterapeut, sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Drive og energi til at arbejde proaktivt og opsøgende
  • Stærke sundhedspædagogiske kompetencer, herunder erfaring med den motiverende samtale eller andre relevante samtalefærdigheder
  • Viden og erfaring med forebyggende indsatser indenfor sundhed, risikofaktorer og kronisk sygdom. Du kan omsætte din faglige viden til handlinger i samarbejde med borgerne
  • Erfaring med at skabe gode relationer til borgere med forskellige ressourcer og viden om sundhed
  • Gode samarbejdsevner og blik for at koble til eksisterende tilbud i såvel kommune som civilsamfund
  • Et godt overblik, kan arbejde selvstændigt og komme i mål
  • Praktisk håndelag og er indstillet på at bidrage til opstilling, nedpakning og håndtering af udstyr i forbindelse med den mobile sundhedsindsats

Du bliver en del af Sundhed Norddjurs, hvor vi varetager borger- og patientrettet forebyggelse. Du vil få base i Sundhedshuset i Grenaa på Sygehusvej 15, 8500 Grenaa, men du skal være klar på, at en stor del af din arbejdstid foregår på forskellige lokationer rundt omkring i kommunen. Det er derfor også et krav, at du har kørekort.

Vi kan tilbyde dig 37 timer pr. uge i en 2-årig periode. Arbejdstiden er primært placeret på hverdage i dagtimerne, men der kan forekomme aktiviteter sidst på eftermiddagen eller først på aftenen, når det giver de bedste muligheder for at understøtte sundhed for borgerne.
Vi har lukket to uger i sommerferien samt mellem jul og nytår.

Hvis du har de rette kompetencer og trives i en hverdag, hvor du sammen med et lille team bestående af dig, en makker og projektleder skal lave opsøgende arbejde og fremme sundhed gennem involvering af borgere, så er det lige dig, vi søger.

Hvis du er interesseret i at høre mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte:
Afdelingsleder Dorthe Bligaard, tlf. 23 22 72 91
Teamkoordinator Rikke Larsen Rasmussen, tlf. 29 13 98 92

Ansøgningsfrist d. 25. august 2026

Samtaler afholdes d. 27. august 2026

Vores Norddjurs
I Norddjurs kommune arbejder vi ud fra værdierne tillid, ordentlighed, udvikling og fællesskab, som er beskrevet i vores organisations- og ledelseskodeks Vores Norddjurs.

De fire værdier er grundlaget for organisationens virke og er med i alt, vi gør. Kodekset sætter en fælles retning og er dét, der binder os sammen. Værdierne lever i den daglige praksis og i den måde vi arbejder og samarbejder på. Værdierne udspiller sig på alle ledelses- og medarbejderniveauer, samt i mødet med borger og omverden.

title: Vakituinen varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomi, Piikinmäen päiväkoti
description:
Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomia vakituiseen tehtävään Piikinmäen vuorohoitoa tarjoavaan päiväkotiin.

Varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomina toimit 2-5 vuotiaiden lasten ryhmässä kasvatusvastuullisena jäsenenä yhdessä varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan ja lastenhoitajien kanssa. Työaikasi on pääsääntöisesti päivätyötä. Työssäsi hyödynnät sosiaalipedagogista osaamistasi ja tarkastelet arkea lapsen hyvinvoinnin, osallisuuden ja yhdenvertaisuuden näkökulmista. Tuet lasten osallisuutta arjen tilanteissa ja vahvistat yhteisöllisyyttä niin lapsiryhmässä kuin työyhteisössä.

Teet tiivistä kasvatusyhteistyötä perheiden kanssa ja huomioit monenlaiset kieli- ja kulttuuritaustat. Työhösi kuuluu myös perheiden hyvinvoinnin tukeminen sekä oikea-aikaisen tuen vahvistaminen yhteistyössä eri toimijoiden kanssa. Osallistut varhaiskasvatus- ja esiopetussuunnitelmien mukaiseen toiminnan suunnitteluun, toteutukseen, arviointiin ja kehittämiseen yhdessä tiimin ja muun henkilöstön kanssa.
Lisäksi tehtävään voi kuulua työskentely monialaisissa verkostoissa, joissa sinulla on mahdollisuus tuoda esille omaa sosiaalipedagogista asiantuntemusta.

Etsimme sosionomia, joka innostuu yhteistyöstä ja haluaa tuoda omaa osaamistaan rohkeasti osaksi tiimiä. Arvostamme oma-aloitteista ja kehittämismyönteistä työskentelytapaa sekä kykyä kohdata lapset ja perheet lämpimästi ja ammatillisesti. Toivomme sinulta joustavuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä positiivista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta. Sitoutuminen kasvatustyöhön ja halu kehittää pedagogiikkaa yhdessä muiden kanssa ovat meille tärkeitä. Kuulemme mielellämme myös mahdollisesta aiemmasta varhaiskasvatuksen työkokemuksesta vuorohoidon parissa.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
· Mahdollisuuden olla aktiivinen osa yksikkömme toimintaa ja tukea lapsia heidän kasvussaan ja kehittymisessään
· Kannustavan ja innostavan työympäristön, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen ammattitaitoa, vahvuuksia ja uusien ideoiden esille tuomista.
· Lämminhenkisen, huumorilla höystetyn yhteisöllisen työporukan
· Mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kehittymiseen koulutusten ja tapahtumien kautta.
· Hyvät työterveyshuoltopalvelut Terveystalossa.
· Riihimäen kaupungin muut työsuhde-edut (mm. Epassi 150€ vuodessa, Eduhouse koulutukset, henkilökohtainen hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaneuvonta, liikuntaryhmiä, Kotaniemen virkistyspaikka).

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on varhaiskasvatuslain 540/2018, 27 §:n mukainen varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomin kelpoisuus: vähintään sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto, johon sisältyy vähintään 60 op varhaiskasvatukseen ja sosiaalipedagogiikkaan suuntautuneita opintoja, tai sosionomin tutkinto täydennettynä näillä opinnoilla. Kelpoisuuden tulee täyttyä hakuajan päättymiseen mennessä.
Ennen työsopimuksen allekirjoittamista valitun henkilön tulee esittää voimassaoleva rikosrekisteriote (504/2002).

Työ alkaa 1.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika on 38 h 15 min / viikko. Tehtävän täytössä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.
Työsuhteen ehdot ja palkkaus määräytyvät KVTES:n mukaan.
Tehtävän tasopalkka on alkaen 2846,42 euroa/kk. Sen lisäksi voit saada aikaisempaan työkokemukseesi perustuvaa työkokemuslisää (3 % tai 8 % tehtävän tasopalkasta) sekä 6 kk kuluttua aloituksesta työsuorituksen arviointiin perustuvaa henkilökohtaista lisää.

Vapaamuotoinen hakemusteksti on erittäin tärkeä osio hakemuksessasi - kuulemme mielellämme osaamisestasi sekä siitä mikä tässä tehtävässä motivoi, ja mikä sai hakemaan juuri tätä tehtävää.

Hakuaika päättyy 19.8.2026 klo 12.

Hakemukset pyydämme ensisijaisesti sähköisesti osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi. Jos hakemuksen jättäminen Kuntarekry-järjestelmän kautta ei ole mahdollista, voit toimittaa kirjallisen hakemuksen osoitteella Riihimäen kaupunki, Kirjaamo, PL 125, 11101 Riihimäki.

title: Security Officer
description:
Our General Manager Security is looking to recruit an experienced Security Officer to join their highly skilled team at our new Tamworth Logistics site.

Effective security plays a vital role within the DPD UK Operation, given the nature of our business and our commitment to providing outstanding customer service. Security within the business also extends to the requirement to ensure that our employees and property are safeguarded at all times.

Key Duties and Accountabilities will include;

  • Ensuring safety and security of our building and assets by carrying out all duties in full adherence of site Assignment Instructions, Daily KPI’s and daily Security job cards .
  • Writing complete and accurate Incident Reports and taking appropriate action as required on all reports.
  • Claim Reduction - Investigate missing packages via CCTV & the DPD Internal Tracking system in order to determine area of concern/loss.
  • Working as part of a team to deliver excellent security and customer service.
  • Coordinating activities between contractors, employees and visitors.
  • Liaising with emergency services and other third-party organisations.
  • Conduct periodic testing of Fire Alarm, CCTV systems, Door Access and Shutter Security
  • Monitoring CCTV, Access Control System, and thermal monitoring systems.
  • Uploading and maintaining Facial Recognition system on a daily basis
  • Conducting Vehicle Gatehouse duties
  • Answering calls and supporting the DPD Security Supervisor with any requested duties / tasks.
  • Managing an airport style search area, completing full searches of all staff and visitors as they leave the building
  • Targeted searches of staff and trailers
  • Internal & external foot patrols
  • Incident support and management

What we’re looking for

As the successful candidate will have previous security experience. We would welcome applications from candidates with armed forces, prison service or police experience.

Being a confident IT user is critical in this role as some of the IT systems you will be using will include; CCTV, Online Visitor Booking system, facial recognition plus the creation and completion of written reports. Use of Google docs, Google sheets, Google slides and any other innovation.

Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, are critical to succeed in this role as are excellent interpersonal skills as you will be dealing with members of the public, staff and visitors on a daily basis. You will be someone with a responsible and trustworthy attitude who takes pride in your day to day work

We will also expect you to have

  • The ability to use initiative and follow procedures and guidelines
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • A professional appearance and attitude at times
  • Flexibility towards working hours as working hours are varied to support operational needs
  • Proactive and supportive team player.
  • Demonstrate the core values of DPD DNA – Passion, Respect, Honesty, Flexibility, Caring and Accountability

About our benefits:

We recognise that our people are at the heart of our business, without them we wouldn’t be able to deliver our award-winning service to millions of customers across the country each day. It’s important to us that we demonstrate our recognition of you in providing you with more than just a salary and job stability. To name but a few…

  • Free Uniform
  • Holiday trading
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity package
  • Free life assurance of 4 x salary on joining the pension scheme
  • Free onsite car parking for all employees
  • Discounted shopping from 100’s of retailers including up to 5% off supermarket shopping
  • Milestone Days off to celebrate with your family and friends
  • For employees who regularly use a screen as part of their job we offer free eye tests and support with the cost of glasses

Joining DPD can lead to not just a stable job but also a career. DPD prides itself on recognising and developing talent alongside a desire to promote from within. As a continually growing and evolving organisation, we are proud to offer a great number of development and promotion opportunities.

If you identify with our aims and values and can help us deliver our customers' promises, then this is the job for you! Apply today.

title: Inspecteur Elektriciteit
description:
Bij ACMV vzw, het BELAC-geaccrediteerde keuringsorganisme binnen IFIRMA bouwen we elke dag aan een slimmere vastgoedwereld.
Als betrouwbare partner van vastgoedprofessionals bieden we een alles-in-één service: van plaatsbeschrijvingen en keuringen tot fotografie, video, energieverslagen en meer. Onze missie? De v astgoedprofessional ontzorgen, zodat zij kunnen focussen op wat écht telt: hun klanten.

We combineren technologie, snelheid en menselijke warmte in alles wat we doen. IFIRMA is geen klassieke speler: we groeien snel, denken anders en leggen de lat bewust hoog. Met een team van geëngageerde collega's verspreid over heel Vlaanderen, maken we van klantentevredenheid een topsport. Bij ons werk je in een omgeving die inzet op persoonlijke groei, ownership en plezier. We geloven in transparantie, wederzijds vertrouwen en elke dag een beetje beter doen.

Klaar om impact te maken? Welkom bij IFIRMA

Ben jij gepassioneerd door elektriciteit en wil je die expertise inzetten in een dynamische, snelgroeiende omgeving? Als Inspecteur Elektriciteit ben jij ons gezicht op de werkvloer en zorg je voor feilloze, veilige keuringen in residentiële panden. Met jouw scherpe blik en klantgerichte aanpak garandeer je de hoogste kwaliteit voor onze partners. In deze rol vorm je de cruciale schakel tussen de technische realiteit op locatie en de professionele rapportage naar onze klanten toe.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Keuringen & Veiligheidsinspecties
    • Je voert zelfstandig nauwkeurige elektriciteitskeuringen uit in uiteenlopende residentiële gebouwen.
    • Je controleert installaties conform de geldende wet- en regelgeving (AREI) en spoort proactief eventuele defecten of risico's op.
    • Je waarborgt de veiligheid en kwaliteit bij elk bezoek en neemt de volledige ownership over jouw inspecties.
  • Rapportage & Administratie
    • Je verwerkt de resultaten van je inspecties snel en efficiënt in heldere, gedetailleerde rapporten.
    • Je maakt gebruik van onze moderne digitale tools om de administratieve afhandeling vlot te laten verlopen.
    • Je zorgt ervoor dat vastgoedprofessionals snel over de juiste documenten beschikken.
  • Klantenservice & Advies
    • Je benadert klanten met menselijke warmte en fungeert als het betrouwbare aanspreekpunt ter plaatse.
    • Je geeft heldere tekst en uitleg bij je vaststellingen en beantwoordt vragen op een professionele, toegankelijke manier.
    • Met jouw glimlach en expertise til je de klantentevredenheid naar een nog hoger niveau.


Vereisten

  • Je hebt minimaal een diploma secundair onderwijs in een afstudeerrichting met een duidelijke affiniteit met elektriciteit.
  • Je bezit een sterke technische kennis en volgt de evoluties binnen jouw vakgebied op de voet.
  • Je werkt uiterst nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en hebt een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.
  • Je bent communicatief sterk en blinkt uit in klantvriendelijkheid en menselijke warmte.
  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands (kennis van het Frans en Engels is een sterke troef).
  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B en verplaatst je graag naar verschillende locaties.
  • Heb je reeds een eerste ervaring met residentiële elektriciteitskeuringen dan is dit een pluspunt.

Voordelen

  • Een voltijds contract van onbepaalde duur in een ambitieus en snelgroeiend bedrijf.
  • Een competitief en aantrekkelijk loonpakket dat meegroeit met jouw expertise.
  • Topmateriaal om je job vlot uit te oefenen, inclusief een MacBook, smartphone en toegang tot ons innovatieve CRM-systeem.
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief, persoonlijke groei en ownership binnen je functie.
  • Een plek in een dynamisch, enthousiast team waar hard werken en plezier hand in hand gaan.
Je hebt de keuze om te werken vanuit ons goed bereikbare regio-kantoor in Sint-Niklaas, gecombineerd met structurele mogelijkheden voor thuiswerk.


Wil jij de veiligheid en kwaliteit garanderen in de volgende groeifase van IFIRMA?

Solliciteer vandaag nog en maak als Inspecteur Elektriciteit het verschil voor de vastgoedwereld van morgen.

title: CSR-rekryterare med fokus på social hållbarhet
description:
Vill du göra skillnad på riktigt? Brinner du för rekrytering, social hållbarhet och att skapa möjligheter för människor att komma in på arbetsmarknaden? Då kan du vara den vi söker!

Vi söker nu en CSR-rekryterare för ett vikariat under en föräldraledighet. Rollen är en viktig del av vårt HR-team och vårt arbete med att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmarknad. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera rekrytering med ett starkt fokus på social hållbarhet och göra verklig skillnad – både för individer och för vår verksamhet.

Om rollen

Som CSR-rekryterare ansvarar du för att driva och utveckla rekryteringsprocesser med fokus på social hållbarhet. Du arbetar nära våra verksamheter och externa samarbetspartners för att skapa möjligheter för personer som står långt från arbetsmarknaden att få en väg in i arbetslivet.

Genom olika arbetsmarknadsstöd bidrar du till att hitta rätt kandidater och ge dem goda förutsättningar att utvecklas inom Boxflow. Du blir en viktig ambassadör för vårt hållbarhetsarbete och vår ambition att vara en inkluderande arbetsgivare.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Driva och utveckla CSR-inriktade rekryteringsprocesser för koncernens bolag.

  • Säkerställa att våra enheter har rätt förutsättningar att nå sina rekryteringsmål.

  • Rekrytera kollektiv personal med fokus på social inkludering.

  • Samarbeta med chefer för att identifiera kompetensbehov kopplade till verksamheten.

  • Bygga och utveckla samarbeten med Arbetsförmedlingen, leverantörer och andra relevanta nätverk.

  • Delta i employer branding-aktiviteter med fokus på social hållbarhet.

  • Följa upp och analysera statistik kopplad till mångfald, jämställdhet och social hållbarhet.

  • Medverka i interna HR- och hållbarhetsprojekt.

Vi söker dig som

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av rekrytering, HR eller arbetsmarknadsfrågor och drivs av att skapa möjligheter för människor. Du är van att bygga relationer, arbeta strukturerat och trivs med många kontaktytor.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Erfarenhet av rekrytering eller HR-arbete.

  • Kunskap om arbetsmarknadsinsatser och olika anställningsstöd är meriterande.

  • Erfarenhet av samarbete med Arbetsförmedlingen, kommuner eller liknande aktörer är ett stort plus.

  • God administrativ förmåga och vana att arbeta i digitala system.

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Som person

För att trivas i rollen är du engagerad, relationsskapande och har ett genuint intresse för människor. Du arbetar självständigt, tar egna initiativ och har ett strukturerat arbetssätt. Du är kommunikativ, lösningsorienterad och motiveras av att bidra till ett mer inkluderande arbetsliv.

Vi erbjuder

Hos Boxflow blir du en del av ett engagerat team där vi arbetar tillsammans för att skapa långsiktiga lösningar för både våra kunder och våra medarbetare. Du får en varierande roll med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka vårt fortsatta arbete inom social hållbarhet.

Om anställningen

  • Anställningsform: Vikariat under föräldraledighet

  • Omfattning: Heltid

  • Placering: Östra Ljungby

  • Tillträde: September

  • Vikariatets längd: Cirka 10 månader

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Skicka därför gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Rekryteringsprocess och ansökan

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller via Verifiera. Du får mer information om detta i ett tidigt skede av processen.

AI-baserade verktyg kan komma att användas som stöd i rekryteringsprocessen. Eventuell AI ersätter inte mänskligt beslutsfattande och bearbetar inte skyddade personuppgifter. Alla beslut fattas av våra rekryterare.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

Om Boxflow

Boxflow är ett av Sveriges snabbast växande logistikbolag och erbjuder tjänster inom tredjepartslogistik, sitelösningar, konsulttjänster samt bemanning av personal inom logistik och industri. Boxflow har verksamhet i Halmstad, Göteborg, Stockholm, Västerås Helsingborg, Malmö, Kristianstad och Perstorp.

Inom de närmsta åren beräknas Boxflow omsätta 1 miljard kronor och ha fler än 1100 anställda. Genom nära och långsiktiga samarbeten skapar Boxflow förutsättningar för hållbara och kostnadseffektiva logistiklösningar. Boxflows vision är att bli Norra Europas ledande logistikföretag.

title: IT-specialist inom datacenter
description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i en bred och viktig roll i en större kommunal IT-miljö där stabil drift är avgörande för att verksamhetssystem och digitala tjänster ska fungera varje dag. Här arbetar du nära den dagliga infrastrukturen i datacentret och bidrar till att skapa en säker, effektiv och hållbar plattform för många olika verksamheter.

Du blir en del av en etablerad driftsorganisation med ansvar för bland annat applikationsdrift, klientdrift, server- och nätverksdrift, lagring, backup och databashantering. Arbetet sker i team, med arbetssätt som bygger på PM3 och ITIL, och du får en viktig roll i dialogen med leverantörer samt i planering av kommande aktiviteter.

Det här är en roll för dig som vill arbeta brett i datacentermiljö och samtidigt ha verklig påverkan på en IT-infrastruktur som måste fungera varje dag.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Du ansvarar för daglig drift och underhåll av virtualiseringsmiljöer och tillhörande hårdvara.
  • Du arbetar med övervakning, larmhantering, felsökning och uppgraderingar för att säkra en stabil drift.
  • Du deltar i planering och förberedelser inför uppgraderingar inom servermiljö och databasplattform.
  • Du arbetar med drift och underhåll av backupmiljöer.
  • Du är en viktig kontakt i dialog med leverantörer och bidrar i planering av kommande arbeten.
  • Du håller driftsdokumentation uppdaterad och bidrar med tekniskt stöd i samband med upphandlingar.
  • Du arbetar i 3:e linjens support och stöttar i mer avancerade tekniska ärenden.
  • Du deltar i projekt där du bidrar med specialistkompetens inom datacenter och infrastruktur.
Krav
  • Akademisk utbildning om minst 180 hp, gärna med IT-inriktning, eller erfarenhet som bedöms likvärdig.
  • Minst 3 års erfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter.
  • Erfarenhet av virtualiseringsmiljöer såsom VMware.
  • Erfarenhet av databaser, främst SQL-databaser såsom Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Erfarenhet av Microsoft Windows Server.
  • Erfarenhet av backuplösningar såsom Commvault.
  • Erfarenhet av lagringslösningar.
  • Goda scriptkunskaper i Powershell.
  • Möjlighet att genomgå och godkännas i en säkerhetsprövning (kräver svenskt medborgarskap, dubbla medborgarskap medges ej)
Vi erbjuder
  • Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
  • Tjänstepension
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år
Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: Order Fulfillment Specialist
description:
The Order Fulfillment Specialist is responsible for ensuring timely, accurate, and efficient processing of customer orders from our warehouse and delivery systems. The focus is on delivering service that supports order accuracy and efficiency, and long-term customer satisfaction and retention

Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Order Processing

    1. Receive, verify, and process customer orders, ensuring all items meet the specifications and delivery timeliness.

    2. Check Sales Order status and plans target dispatch and/or delivery dates

    3. Review status of pending unserved SO and monitor SO-Aging & collaborate with Sales & production for allocation & depletion, if any.

    4. Monitor and tracks status of booked Sales Orders from processing until delivery to customer

    5. Collaborate with concerned departments/teams (Production, Supply Chain, Sales, Warehouse and Logistics), on issues affecting order fulfillment to prevent delays and ensure on-time customer order delivery.

  1. Fulfillment Governance

    1. Maintain data on Perfect Order Fulfilment (POF) to regularly publish and report performance and supplementary KPIs to improve Business goals.

    2. Maintain data on differences between Average Order Volume versus Actual Orders in a per client level.

      1. Regularly publish performance on the said differences, and the reasons on gaps (if decreased) or improvements (if increased).

      2. For the volume decreases, escalate to Sales Manager and Distribution Manager in order to immediately bridge the gap with customers.

  1. Customer Retention: Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring their ongoing satisfaction with our products and services. Identify opportunities for repeat business and customer loyalty through personalized communication and follow-up.

  2. Inventory Management

    1. Collaborate with warehouse and logistics partners to ensure the accurate tracking and replenishment of stock levels for flour and non-flour products

    2. Collaborate with Warehouse and Logistics (W&L) Specialists to determine Order readiness & attainment

    3. Provide Orders Schedules to W&L Specialists to ensure effective execution

  3. Customer Communication: Act as the point of contact for order inquiries, providing updates on order status, and estimated delivery times, and resolving any issues that arise.

  4. Shipping & Logistics Coordination: Coordinate with logistics teams and third-party carriers to ensure timely shipping of orders and manage delivery schedules.

  5. Documentation: Maintain accurate records of order details, shipping documentation, and customer communications in the order management system.

  6. Problem Resolution: Proactively identify and resolve any fulfillment issues, such as stock shortages, backorders, or shipping discrepancies, in collaboration with other departments.

  7. Collaboration: Work closely with the sales, customer service, and production teams to ensure smooth order fulfillment, customer satisfaction, and support for customer retention initiatives.

  8. Continuous Improvement:

    1. Suggest process improvements to streamline order fulfillment processes, increase efficiency, and enhance customer experience to foster long-term loyalty.

    2. Actively participates in company programs and generates ideas on process improvement, quality and increasing customer satisfaction

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain management, or a related field preferred

Experience:

  • Experience: Minimum 1-2 years of experience in sales, order fulfillment, customer service, or supply chain management, preferably in the food or bakery industry.

License/s:

  • Not applicable

Other Requirements:

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Knowledge of inventory control, shipping logistics, and quality assurance processes

  • Customer-focused attitude, with an emphasis on building long-term customer relationships and improving retention rates.

title: Aloitteleva kirvesmies
description:
Etsimme kahta ahkeraa henkilöä saneeraustyömaalle Helsinkiin kantakaupungin alueelle. Työt koostuvat pääosin väliseinien, alakattojen ja palokatkojen rakentamisesta. Työt tehdään aluksi kokeneemman henkilön parina, joten itsenäiseen työhön sinun ei tarvitse vielä olla valmis. Olet kuitenkin suorittanut rakennusalan perustutkinnon ja/tai omaat aikaisempaa työkokemusta rakennusalalta, jotta perusasiat ovat selvillä. Tarkoituksena on, että työntekijästä kasvaa itsenäiseen työhön pystyvä kirvesmies.
Hyvä asenne ja fyysinen kunto ovat avaintekijöitä työssä suoriutumisessa. Edellytämme tehtävässä työturvallisuuskorttia, suomen kielen taidon sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuuden luemme eduksesi.
Työt alkavat sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä sopimuksen mukaan.

title: Salgsassistent til Q8 Skanderborg, 20 timer
description:
Er du interesseret i en stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at tage ansvar, udvikle dig og gøre en reel forskel for kunderne? Så kan det være, at dit livs måske vigtigste job venter på dig her hos os. Seriøst!

Hos Q8 bliver du en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi passer på hinanden og sørger for, at du trives i dit arbejde. Når du har det godt, kan du give kunderne den bedste oplevelse – og det er præcis det, vi brænder for. Vores gode samarbejde internt er samtidig med til at drive den udvikling, vi som virksomhed er i fuld gang med. Q8 står nemlig midt i en spændende transformation, hvor vi arbejder aktivt med at reducere vores klimapåvirkning. Lyder det som noget for dig? Så bliv en del af Q8‑familien.

Hvad kommer du til at lave?

Som salgsassistent får du en hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens. Du sørger for, at stationen altid er indbydende og klar til at tage imod kunderne. Det ene øjeblik hjælper du på forpladsen, det næste betjener du kunder ved kassen, tilbereder og serverer mad eller fylder varer op. Der er fart på – men også plads til grin med kollegaerne og tid til at give kunderne en god service.

Det praktiske

  • Ansættelsesform: timelønnet
  • Omfang: Ca. 20 timer pr. uge
  • Arbejdstid: Vagterne vil primært ligge i hverdagene i dagstimerne - dog med undtagelse af arbejde hver 3. weekend. Der vil være mulighed for at tage flere timer - også i aftentimerne.
  • Start: Efter aftale
  • Løn: Grundløn for ufaglærte: 142,17 kr. Grundløn for faglærte: 151,53 kr. Derudover får du aften-, nat-, weekend- og helligdagstillæg i henhold til butiksoverenskomsten.
  • Pension: 10,7% firmabetalt pension gennem PFA. Gælder efter 3 måneders ansættelse og for medarbejdere over 20 år – med mindre du allerede er omfattet af en pensionsordning, så får du pension fra start.

OBS! Du skal kunne fremvise en straffeattest, hvis du går videre i processen.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

  • En arbejdsplads med alsidige opgaver og mulighed for at lære nyt hver dag
  • Et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det sjovt
  • En medarbejderapp med mulighed for fleksibel lønudbetaling, indflydelse gennem vores ungeministerium samt gode fordele og rabatter
  • En struktureret onboardingproces, der sikrer, at du kommer godt fra start – understøttet af vores medarbejderapp, hvor du finder guides, træning og nyttige værktøjer

Hvis du vil vide mere om, hvordan det er at være medarbejder i Q8, så læs mere på karrierestationen.

Hvem passer jobbet til?

Vi leder efter dig, der har lyst til at tage ansvar og give kunderne en god oplevelse. Erfaring er ikke afgørende – det vigtigste er din energi og dit engagement.

OBS! For at søge skal du være fyldt 18 år og tale flydende dansk, da kundekontakt er en stor del af jobbet.

Klar på at blive en del af Q8?

I ansøgningen har du flere muligheder, men for at vi kan lære dig bedre at kende, så skal du besvare nogle enkelte spørgsmål. Derudover skal du optage en kort video, hvor du fortæller om dig selv og hvorfor du gerne vil arbejde hos Q8. Vi ved godt, at det kan lyde lidt grænseoverskridende, men det behøver ikke at være perfekt eller professionelt, og du kan bare filme på mobilen.

Du kan også vedhæfte dit CV, hvis du har et, men det er helt frivilligt. Vi håber at høre fra dig!

Det kan være dit livs måske vigtigste ansøgning - seriøst.

title: Solution Engineer - Germany
description:
Solution Engineer - Germany

About Neural Concept

Engineering is at an inflection point. The teams defining the next generation of aircraft, electric vehicles, and consumer products are not just designing faster. They are designing fundamentally differently, with AI embedded at the core of their workflows.

Neural Concept builds the Engineering AI platform that makes this possible. We help the world's leading engineering teams accelerate development, improve product outcomes, and scale engineering capacity, turning months of simulation into days and engineering intuition into data-driven insight.

We work with elite engineering teams in Automotive, Aerospace, High-Tech and Electronics, and advanced manufacturing, where the stakes are high, the complexity is rising, and the pressure to innovate has never been greater. We are changing how engineers work. Come build that future with us.

About the Role

As a Solution Engineer, you sit at the intersection of engineering credibility and strategic influence. You are the person in the room who can connect a VP's business challenge to a concrete, well-scoped AI solution, and who knows Neural Concept's platform and roadmap well enough to make that connection land with confidence.

This is not a purely technical role, and it is not a pure sales role. You are a trusted advisor: someone who earns credibility through engineering background and product depth, and who builds long-term account relationships by consistently framing the right problems and the right solutions at the right moment. You drive the full pre-sales motion, from discovery to demo to signed Statement of Work, and you remain the account's technical compass through the client lifecycle, identifying and shaping expansion opportunities.

What you will do

  • Position NC as a long-term strategic partner and trusted engineering advisor across engineering teams, managers, and VPs

  • Lead structured discovery sessions to identify where NC creates the most impact, framing use cases that are technically feasible and commercially grounded

  • Define the AI strategy and technical roadmap for each account, translating NC's capabilities and product direction into a multi-horizon vision

  • Create and deliver compelling, client-tailored demos and presentations grounded in the client's engineering workflows, technically credible and aligned with the vision

  • Create and co-own the Statement of Work, with deep understanding of the technical building blocks and how these transform the client's existing workflows

  • Prepare and run Steering Committees, connecting engineering challenges to strategic outcomes

  • Drive user adoption and engagement across technical users, managers, and designers, ensuring NC is embedded in daily workflows and engineering champions emerge

  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities from account knowledge and commercial signals, and shape them into well-scoped proposals

  • Collaborate with the Sales team to advance and close deals, with the Forward Deployed Engineering team to ensure smooth pre-sales to delivery transitions, and surface client insights to Product and R&D to inform roadmap priorities

Who you are

  • You hold an engineering degree (mechanical, aerospace, automotive, industrial, or similar) and have a solid understanding of CAD and CAE workflows, including where bottlenecks lie and what it takes to transform those workflows with AI

  • You are naturally curious and people-driven. You earn trust through genuine interest in client challenges and make engineers and executives feel understood

  • You are proactive and commercially driven. You move accounts forward without being asked, spot opportunities early, and bring structure to ambiguous situations

  • You are a confident challenger. You ask uncomfortable questions, reframe assumptions, and guide clients toward better outcomes even when it requires pushing back

  • You are an outstanding communicator: you own executive conversations, drive narrative with clarity, and connect engineering problems to strategic outcomes

  • You understand AI and machine learning applied to engineering at a conceptual level, and are comfortable creating demos and prototypes using AI-assisted tools with working knowledge of Python and modern development practices

  • You have experience in a client-facing role: pre-sales, solutions consulting, technical account management, or engineering consulting

  • Professional fluency in German and English.

What Will Set You Apart

Candidates who bring the following will be able to take on a wider scope and go deeper with the most technically complex accounts:

  • You have deep, hands-on simulation experience: full pipelines from CAD to post-processing, solver experience, and workflow automation

  • You are a strong programmer: you write clean Python, build data pipelines, and are comfortable in ML/DL frameworks including model training, evaluation, and deployment

  • You can go deep in technical discovery: dive into customer toolchains, data environments, and simulation setups to assess feasibility at the level a simulation engineer would respect

  • You can build end-to-end engineering workflow demos from scratch, rapidly prototyping the full arc from design generation and simulation to data pipelines, model training, and application deployment using agentic development tools

Nice-to-Have

  • Strategic or technical consulting background, executing digital transformations

  • Previous experience working in engineering software companies or using engineering software tools (e.g., Ansys, Altair, Siemens, Dassault Systèmes, or Autodesk)

  • Background in ML/DL research or development in an engineering context

  • Experience automating CAE workflows (scripting, batch processing, surrogate model pipelines)

What You Get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Safety and Wellbeing Business Partner
description:
• Full-time, Ongoing position at HEW Level 8
  • Hawkesbury campus with flexible working arrangements.
  • Salary: $118,969 – $132,069 per annum, plus 17% Super and Leave Loading

Support safe, compliant and risk-aware operations across education, research and external engagement activities.

The Opportunity
The Safety and Wellbeing Business Partner – External Engagements, Education and Research is responsible for supporting the delivery of proactive, safe, compliant and risk aware practices across External Engagements, Education and Research Divisions in the identification, management, and reduction of physical and psychosocial risks.

The role supports the implementation of the University’s Work Health and Safety Management System and contributes to the development of a positive safety culture. This position plays a key role in injury prevention, workers compensation support, and compliance assurance. Working closely with operational leaders, HR Business Partners and the broader Safety and Wellbeing team, you will help embed practical and proactive safety practices that support both strategic objectives and day-to-day operations.

A key aspect of the position is supporting diverse and evolving operational environments. You will provide guidance on risks associated with fieldwork, plant and equipment, contractor activities, emerging technologies including Large Multimodal Models, and psychological safety factors. Through education programs, workshops and targeted awareness activities, you will build safety capability across the divisions and help foster a culture of accountability, wellbeing and informed decision-making.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Implement and monitor the WHS Management System to ensure legislative compliance and effective risk management.
  • Deliver risk assessments, incident investigations and corrective actions that improve safety outcomes.
  • Provide trusted advice on physical, psychosocial and operational safety risks across diverse environments.
  • Deliver engaging safety and wellbeing education programs that strengthens capability and awareness.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships that support a culture of safety, accountability and continuous improvement.


Please refer to the Position Description for full details.

About You

  • A degree in Work Health and Safety, Risk Management or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in WHS risk management within environments such as student experience, education & research divisions.
  • Knowledge of WHS legislation, codes of practice, injury management frameworks and workers compensation processes.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication and stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence and build relationships.
  • Demonstrated understanding of complex research risks, including research integrity, ethics, foreign interference, security, operational and fieldwork-related risks, and the ability to assess and manage their potential impacts.
  • Well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and develop practical risk-based solutions.


Benefits
We invest in the people who make our mission possible. Alongside a rewarding career, we offer a range of benefits designed to support your financial, personal and family wellbeing.

  • Financial benefits: Access to staff-only products and offers with selected banking partners, salary sacrifice options for onsite parking, and novated motor vehicle leasing.
  • Health and wellbeing support: Free Employee Assistance Program (EAP), complimentary annual flu vaccination, eligibility for Fitness Passport membership, and access to discounted private health cover.
  • Onsite childcare: Long day care and early learning services operate at our Campbelltown, Hawkesbury, Parramatta, and Penrith campuses. Staff may be eligible for discounted fees and salary packaging, with places subject to centre capacity.


Application Details

  • Position Enquiries: Direct to Hiring Manager, Paolo Spinetti, Director, Safety and Wellbeing via P.Spinetti@westernsydney.edu.au Please include the job reference code REF1673U
  • Closing Date: 11:59pm Wednesday 19th August 2026
  • Working Rights: You must provide evidence of full-time working rights in Australia at application.
  • How to Apply: Please note that only applications submitted via the University’s online recruitment system will be considered. As part of your online application, you will be asked to respond to screening questions addressing the key qualifications, experiences and skills required for this position.


Belonging at Western
We are committed to substantive equality as outlined in our Equal Opportunity Policy. We actively encourage applications from Indigenous Australians, candidates of all gender identities and expressions, people of all abilities, and those from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds.

For Reasonable Adjustments during the application process, please contact talentacquisitionteam@westernsydney.edu.au.

About Western
This is your opportunity to be part of something bigger. By joining Western Sydney University, you become a valued member of our community. As our region changes, so too does our university. Western is boldly different, energetic, global, diverse, dynamic, and youthful.

Our mission is to deliver student success, impactful research, and stronger communities. As part of our team, you will have a stake in shaping the future of education, broadening horizons, and changing lives. Making a difference starts at Western.

Som projektleder bliver du en nøgleperson på Arkils anlægsentreprise på et større projekt i Odense de næste cirka 1,5 år. Her får du en selvstændig rolle med ansvar for at koordinere projektets mange snitflader, skabe fremdrift og sikre, at produktionen altid er et skridt foran. 



Du bliver en del af et stærkt projektteam, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med en erfaren projektchef. Han har det overordnede ansvar for projektets økonomi og de strategiske beslutninger, men i det daglige får du stor frihed til at træffe beslutninger og drive projektet fremad. Projektchefen fungerer derfor primært som sparringspartner - ikke som en leder, der skal godkende hver eneste detalje, tværtimod. 



Målet er klart: Du skal udvikle dig til selv at stå med det fulde projektansvar som projektchef, når du er klar til det. 



Dine primære opgaver 




Koordinere produktionen og sikre, at tidsplanen understøtter formandens arbejde på pladsen, så han kan fokusere på fremdrift på pladsen med sine folk. 





Sikre fremdrift, kvalitet og struktur gennem hele projektforløbet 





Planlægge flere uger frem og forudse de udfordringer, der kan påvirke produktionen 





Følge op på kontrakter, tillægsarbejder og projektets økonomi 





Deltage i tekniske møder, byggemøder og den daglige dialog med bygherre 




Hvem er du? 



Du har erfaring fra anlægsbranchen og er vant til at skabe overblik i komplekse projekter. Du tager ansvar, arbejder struktureret og motiveres af at finde løsninger, før udfordringerne opstår. 



Du kan f.eks. være projektleder, entrepriseleder eller have en lignende rolle og være klar til næste skridt mod en rolle som projektchef. 



Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er mindre vigtig. Det afgørende er, at du forstår anlægsprojekter, egenproduktion og trives tæt på byggepladsen. 



Derfor skal du vælge Arkil 



Hos Arkil bliver du en del af en anlægsafdeling, hvor samarbejde, høj faglighed og ordentlighed går hånd i hånd. Mange af medarbejderne har været med til at opbygge afdelingen gennem en årrække, og kulturen er præget af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden på tværs af projekter. 



Du får: 





En unik mulighed for at udvikle dig fra projektleder til projektchef 





En central rolle på et større anlægsprojekt de næste cirka 1,5 år 





Mulighed for at fortsætte på nye anlægsprojekter i Arkils anlægsafdeling efterfølgende 





Stor frihed under ansvar og en erfaren projektchef som sparringspartner 





Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår med 13 % arbejdsgiverbetalt pension, 10 % fritvalgskonto og mulighed for firmabil 




Om Arkil 



Arkil er en af Danmarks største entreprenørvirksomheder med omkring 2.300 medarbejdere og mere end 80 års erfaring med anlægs- og infrastrukturprojekter for både offentlige og private bygherrer.

title: Software Engineer – AI-Assisted Full-Stack Developement
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer – AI-Assisted Full-Stack Development based in Ireland.

This role offers the opportunity to build modern software solutions while leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering workflows.
You will contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of scalable full-stack applications.
The position combines backend engineering, frontend development, cloud technologies, automation, and AI-powered coding practices.
You will work in a remote, agile environment alongside engineers, product teams, QA specialists, and data professionals.
By combining strong engineering principles with emerging AI capabilities, you will help deliver reliable and maintainable digital solutions.
This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced engineers and talented developers looking to grow in a forward-thinking technology environment.

Accountabilities

The Software Engineer – AI-Assisted Full-Stack Development will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining reliable software solutions while using AI-assisted tools to improve productivity, quality, and engineering efficiency.

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable web applications using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js.
  • Build and maintain REST or GraphQL APIs, including authentication, authorization, validation, schemas, resolvers, and error handling.
  • Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code or similar tools to accelerate development while ensuring code quality, security, maintainability, and test coverage.
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases, including data modeling, migrations, query optimization, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Implement asynchronous processing solutions using message queues such as RabbitMQ.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues, complex bugs, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation covering APIs, system behavior, and implementation decisions.
  • Develop and maintain automated tests, including unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.
  • Validate AI-generated code through testing, security reviews, performance analysis, and engineering best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to consistent quality standards across development processes.
  • Support CI/CD workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions or similar platforms.
  • Contribute to application deployment and maintenance within cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or DigitalOcean.
  • Work with infrastructure concepts including containers, environment configuration, secrets management, networking, and deployment pipelines.
  • Monitor applications using logging, observability, error tracking, and performance tools such as Grafana and Sentry.
  • Collaborate within Agile Scrum teams, participating in planning, refinement sessions, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a software engineer with strong full-stack development foundations, curiosity for AI-assisted engineering, and the ability to deliver reliable solutions in a remote environment.

    • Practical software development experience gained through professional work, internships, academic projects, open-source contributions, or strong technical portfolios.
    • Experience using AI coding assistants or similar AI development tools to build, debug, test, or maintain software.
    • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with FastAPI or similar Python web frameworks.
    • Experience developing frontend applications using React and JavaScript or TypeScript.
    • Experience building backend services using Python, Node.js, or both.
    • Understanding of REST or GraphQL API design principles.
    • Experience writing unit and integration tests and applying testing practices throughout development cycles.
    • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
    • Familiarity with Git, GitHub, pull requests, and code review workflows.
    • Understanding of software engineering principles including modularity, maintainability, security, and separation of concerns.
    • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and communication skills.
    • Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote environment.
    • Professional working proficiency in English.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred, though equivalent practical experience and strong portfolios are also considered.

      • Nice-to-have skills:

      • Experience designing GraphQL schemas, queries, mutations, subscriptions, and resolvers.
      • Familiarity with GraphQL libraries such as Strawberry, Graphene, Ariadne, Apollo, or similar technologies.
      • Experience with Playwright or other end-to-end testing frameworks.
      • Knowledge of CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
      • Experience deploying applications on cloud platforms such as DigitalOcean, AWS, Azure, or GCP.
      • Familiarity with Docker and container-based deployments.
      • Experience with observability and production support tools.
      • Experience with message queues such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Redis.
      • Experience integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into production applications.
      • Knowledge of authentication, role-based access control, API security, secrets management, and data protection practices.
      • Experience working in Agile Scrum product development environments.

        • Benefits

        • Fully remote work opportunity within the United Kingdom or compatible EU time zones.
        • Flexible remote-first working environment.
        • Opportunity to work with modern AI-assisted development practices.
        • Exposure to full software development lifecycle activities, from design to production support.
        • Collaboration with international engineering and product teams.
        • Opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies and scalable architectures.
        • Continuous learning environment focused on innovation and technical growth.
        • Contractor FTE engagement model.
        • Opportunity to contribute to impactful software solutions using emerging technologies.

title: Senior IT Administrator
description:
As a Senior IT Administrator (m/f/d), you will be a key part of our Production & Assembly Team, supporting the local manufacturing of advanced drone systems in Romania. Together with our World-Class Team, you will play an empowering role in delivering systems for one of Romania's most significant defense procurement programs, with drone assembly taking place entirely in Romania under the European SAFE initiative. The Romanian production site will not only support local defense programs but will also contribute to fulfilling customer orders across Europe and support the delivery of mission-critical systems for Ukraine, reinforcing Quantum Systems' commitment to strengthening European security and defense capabilities. An article about Quantum

You will be working closely with stakeholders from the Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain departments to ensure excellence in production and delivery. As Quantum Systems continues to expand its industrial footprint in Romania, your mission will be to help build mission-critical technology trusted by NATO forces and deployed in demanding operational environments across Europe and Ukraine while pushing the boundaries of drone technologies.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Operate and improve Windows and Linux server environments.

  • Support Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints.

  • Manage Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, Jamf, and Hyper-V.

  • Configure and troubleshoot networks, firewalls, switches, routers, VLANs, and VPNs.

  • Automate IT processes using PowerShell and scripting.

  • Strengthen infrastructure security through system hardening, access management, patching, and monitoring.

  • Secure and maintain ground control stations and other critical systems.

  • Resolve complex infrastructure, hardware, software, and network issues.

  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support.

  • Evaluate and implement new infrastructure solutions.

  • Maintain technical documentation and collaborate with international IT teams.


What you bring to the team:

  • Degree or professional qualification in computer science, IT, or system integration.

  • Several years of experience in IT administration or infrastructure operations.

  • Strong knowledge of Windows, Linux, Microsoft 365, Azure, and Intune.

  • Experience with Hyper-V, PowerShell, networking, and IT security.

  • Experience with macOS and Jamf is an advantage.

  • Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style.

  • Strong communication skills and professional fluency in English.

  • Romanian language skills are an advantage.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside the box, and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

About us:

Quantum Systems develops advanced autonomous systems for defense and security operations across multiple domains, powered by integrated software and AI.

Quantum Systems is at the forefront of AI-powered aerial, ground, naval robotics, developing a family of smart systems that go far beyond traditional drones. Built on a foundation of in-house hardware, software and AI, our systems transform data into critical insights, empowering decision-making across security, defense and public safety, as well as for the commercial, industrial and GIS sectors. Our vertically integrated system with industry leading endurance, enable seamless interoperability and software interconnectivity. On-board AI powers multi-modality sensing, autonomous navigation, anti-jamming, swarm operations and more.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: Technisch trainer bedrijfsscholen 24 - 40 uur
description:
Maak impact in de werkplaats van morgen

Sta jij stevig in je technische schoenen én krijg je energie van het overdragen van jouw vakkennis? Wil jij leerlingen en zij-instromers klaarstomen voor een toekomst in de autotechniek? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Bij Innovam leid jij in onze praktijkgerichte bedrijfsscholen de nieuwe generatie vakmensen op. Met jouw ervaring uit de werkplaats en jouw passie voor techniek maak je elke dag het verschil.

Dit ga je doen

Opleiden in onze bedrijfsscholen

In onze bedrijfsscholen leiden we scholieren en zij-instromers op tot vakmensen op niveau 2 en 3. Onze trainers komen zelf uit de branche: professionals die weten hoe de moderne werkplaats eruitziet en die hun kennis met enthousiasme delen.

Ons onderwijs is praktijkgericht, actueel en versterkt met gastcolleges en extra praktijktrainingen. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deelnemers niet alleen hun diploma halen, maar écht klaar zijn voor de praktijk van vandaag én morgen.

Verzorgen van technische trainingen

Naast je rol binnen de bedrijfsscholen verzorg je, afhankelijk van jouw expertise, technische trainingen voor zowel jonge talenten als ervaren professionals.

Jij:

  • Legt uit, demonstreert en begeleidt.

  • Zorgt dat lesmateriaal en praktijkopstellingen perfect voorbereid zijn.

  • Ziet precies wat een cursist nodig heeft om verder te groeien.

  • Adviseert over vervolgstappen en ontwikkelkansen.

  • Je draait op je best wanneer je kennis kunt delen en anderen ziet groeien.

Meebouwen aan modern onderwijs

De techniek verandert razendsnel – en ons onderwijs beweegt mee. Jij levert een actieve bijdrage aan het vernieuwen van onze leervormen, zoals blended learning. Samen met collega-trainers ontwikkel je slimme combinaties van online leren, klassikale lessen en praktijktrainingen.

Zo zorgen we ervoor dat we dé opleider blijven voor een leven lang leren in de mobiliteitsbranche.

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent een vakmens met actuele kennis van moderne autotechniek. Je weet wat er speelt in de werkplaats en deelt die kennis met zichtbaar plezier.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een passende technische opleiding, bij voorkeur binnen de personenautotechniek.

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau (door opleiding of ervaring).

  • Didactische ervaring óf een sterke affiniteit met lesgeven. Een lesbevoegdheid (zoals PDG) is mooi meegenomen of je bent bereid die te behalen.

  • Brede kennis van moderne voertuigsystemen en actuele technieken.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een natuurlijk verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.

  • Een klantgerichte, ondernemende en flexibele instelling.

Je standplaats is Nieuwegein, maar je vindt het geen probleem om ook op andere Innovam-locaties les te geven.

Hier gebeurt het

Binnen het team Bedrijfsscholen | Personenauto’s werk je in het hart van de mobiliteitsbranche. Wij ondersteunen universele autobedrijven, dealerholdings en retailorganisaties met een compleet en actueel aanbod aan opleidingen.

Onze organisatie groeit mee met technologische ontwikkelingen én veranderende opleidingsbehoeften. We zijn vooruitstrevend, praktijkgericht en dé partner in technische ontwikkeling binnen de personenautomarkt.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Bij Innovam krijg je ruimte om te groeien. Als opleider investeren we net zo graag in onze eigen mensen als in onze cursisten.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband bieden wij:

  • een salaris €5250- €6000 bruto per maand o.b.v. 40 uur

  • 24 vakantiedagen op jaarbasis, de dag na Hemelvaart én de dag na kerst vrij

  • een persoonlijk budget waarmee je de bovenste 5,26 % van je salaris naar eigen inzicht kan gebruiken om bijvoorbeeld extra verlofdagen te kopen

  • aantrekkelijke mogelijkheden voor opleiding en ontwikkeling, waaronder een volledige vergoeding van opleidingskosten tot € 2.000

Solliciteren

Leuk! Solliciteer dan met jouw CV en korte motivatiebrief. Doe vooral niet te formeel. Wij zijn benieuwd naar jou! Deel alles waarvan je denkt dat wij het moeten weten. Projecten waar je trots op bent, je favoriete hobby… Kom maar door!

Wil je eerst meer informatie over de functie? Neem dan contact op onze recruiter Linda via werken@innovam.nl

Solliciteren kan tot 16 augustus. In de week van 17 augustus komen wij bij je terug.

title: Credit Controller
description:
At LKAB, we are leading the transformation of our industry toward a sustainable future. Just as we aim to reshape the world, we are committed to developing every individual on our team, both personally and professionally. Are you ready to help shape the future of the mining and mineral industry?

Your Role

As a Credit Controller at LKAB Minerals UK, you will play a key role in safeguarding the company’s cashflow, ensuring that customer accounts are managed effectively and that outstanding debt is collected in a timely, professional, and controlled manner. Working within the Central Finance team, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate customer ledgers, resolving account queries, and supporting the wider business in managing credit risk.

Your role will focus on the full credit control cycle, including customer account setup, credit checks, debt monitoring, proactive customer contact, dispute resolution, and cash allocation. You will contribute to maintaining high‑quality financial information that supports month‑end close activities and provides clear visibility of debtor performance across the business.

This position supports the financial operations of multiple UK manufacturing sites, as well as giving credit management assistance to other group entities based in the EU, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and clarity in all credit‑related activities. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to ongoing improvements in processes and controls, helping to strengthen the efficiency and effectiveness of the transactional finance function.

The Finance Department at LKAB Minerals is structured around two strategic pillars, designed to balance strong financial governance with effective operational support. This structure ensures that our financial processes are both robust and responsive to the needs of the business.

As a Credit Controller, you will be part of the Central Finance pillar — the operational core of our finance function. This team is responsible for delivering accurate, efficient, and well‑controlled transactional processing across the organisation. You will work within a motivated and supportive group that values clarity, consistency, and continuous improvement.

You will be part of the Transaction Processing Team, led by the Head of Transaction Processing, who is committed to developing the team, embedding best‑practice processes, and fostering a culture where individuals feel empowered to take ownership of their work.

This environment provides a strong foundation for learning and development, offering exposure to high‑quality financial processes and opportunities to contribute to improvements that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the transactional finance function.

Responsibilities and Key Work Tasks

Credit Control & Debt Management

  • Monitoring customer accounts to ensure timely collection of balances, proactively chase overdue payments, maintain accurate and up‑to‑date records and escalation of high‑risk or long‑overdue accounts

Customer Account Administration

  • Setting up customer accounts, ensuring all required documentation and credit checks are completed. Review and update customer credit limits, maintain accurate customer master data

Query Resolution & Customer Support

  • Investigate and resolve invoice disputes, short payments, and account discrepancies and provide customers with copy invoices, statements, and supporting documentation as required.

Cash Allocation & Ledger Maintenance

  • Allocate customer payments promptly and accurately, reconcile bank postings and customer accounts and support month‑end close activities by providing debtor analysis and ensuring ledger accuracy.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Prepare aged debt reports and highlight areas of concern to management, support the monitoring of debtor performance and cashflow forecasting and contribute to process improvements that enhance efficiency, accuracy, and credit risk management.

Candidate Requirements

  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Confident communicator with the ability to build positive relationships with customers and internal teams.
  • Comfortable managing challenging conversations and negotiating payment arrangements professionally.
  • Good IT literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with finance or ERP systems.
  • Experience in credit control or a similar finance role is desirable, though not essential for motivated applicants with strong communication and administrative skills.
  • An interest in developing further finance knowledge or pursuing a recognised accounting or credit management qualification (e.g., CICM) is advantageous.

Characteristic Requirements

  • A proactive, continuous‑improvement mindset, with the ability to identify and suggest enhancements to processes and workflows.

title: MEL Data Automation officer
description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips more than 4 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across ten countries that together are home to more than two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase her income and assets on supported land by more than 40 percent, while permanently improving her climate resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 8,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions.

To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

About our Internship Program

Join the One Acre Fund 2026 Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) Internship Program to jump-start your career. We empower you as you grow in this program which is especially designed for motivated young professionals.

When joining, you will participate in an onboarding program and receive training on how to accomplish your assigned projects. Over the period of your internship, you will also receive opportunities to learn directly from inspiring leaders to build foundations for your future career.

You will gain exposure to real-world data challenges and opportunities to generate actionable insights. You will work as a part of our dynamic MEL team and will directly report to the MEL Leads.

This is a JL3 internship position with a 6-month fixed-term contract. No extension will be offered.

Your responsibilities may include one or more of the following

  • Clean and analyze primary data collected from the farmers and markets.

You have

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address.
