title: Studentermedhjælper inden for ESG og bæredygtighed
description:
Studentermedhjælper inden for ESG og bæredygtighed  
 Arbejdsgiver Quantified Impacts ApS Copenhagen Student 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
          Salary
           DKK 160 - DKK 180 per hour  
   
  
 
   
 
  
 
   
 
 
 
   
 Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel i den grønne omstilling? Bliv en Impacter. 

 
  
 Jobintroduktion 
 Vi leder efter en engageret studentermedhjælper, der brænder for ESG og bæredygtighed. Hos Quantified Impacts hjælper vi virksomheder med at navigere i en stadig mere kompleks bæredygtighedsdagsorden, hvor krav til rapportering, dokumentation og compliance udvikler sig hurtigt. Vores mission er at skabe større gennemsigtighed i værdikæder og gøre bæredygtighed til et strategisk forretningsværktøj frem for en administrativ byrde. 

 Som studentermedhjælper bliver du en integreret del af vores konsulentteam og får en reel rolle i arbejdet med ESG-rapportering, klimaregnskaber og compliance. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med erfarne konsulenter om rigtige kundeprojekter og får hurtigt ansvar for opgaver, der skaber værdi for vores kunder. 

 Hos os bliver du ikke sat til rutineopgaver. Du kommer til at arbejde med de samme standarder, reguleringer og værktøjer som resten af teamet og får praktisk erfaring med blandt andet VSME, GHG-protokollen, PPWR, UPA, EUDR, CBAM, REACH og LCA/EPD. Samtidig får du mulighed for at bidrage til videreudvikling af vores platform, hvor vi bygger datainfrastrukturen til at håndtere de komplekse bæredygtighedskrav som virksomheder står over for. 

 
  
 Om Quantified Impacts 
 Vi er grundlagt i slutningen af 2022 og er en kombineret konsulent- og platformsvirksomhed. Ved at samle miljøingeniører, produktionsingeniører og softwareudviklere under ét tag udvikler vi både digitale løsninger og leverer specialiseret rådgivning. Den tværfaglige tilgang giver os bredde i vores rådgivning og dybde i vores platform. 

 Vi hjælper virksomheder på tværs af brancher, men har særligt fokus på produktionsvirksomheder. Blandt vores kunder er både ambitiøse SMV'er og internationalt kendte virksomheder, som ønsker at styrke deres bæredygtighedsarbejde og leve op til stigende lovgivnings- og markedskrav. 

 Vi tror på, at fremskridt starter med data, og at bæredygtighed skal være et aktiv for forretningen, ikke blot en rapporteringsøvelse. 

 
  
 Dine opgaver 
 Som studentermedhjælper bliver du en aktiv del af vores konsulentteam og kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med: 
 
 
 Udarbejdelse af klimaregnskaber efter GHG-protokollen. 
 

 
 ESG-rapportering efter VSME. 
 

 
 Dataindsamling, kvalitetssikring og analyse af bæredygtighedsdata. 
 

 
 Udarbejdelse af rapporter, ESG-dokumentation og compliance-notater. 
 

 
 Kundekommunikation og koordinering af dataindsamling. 
 

 
 Compliance-opgaver relateret til blandt andet PPWR, UPA, EUDR, CBAM og REACH. 
 

 
 Bidrage til mindre LCA-screeninger og produktrelaterede klimaberegninger, hvor det er relevant. 
 

 
 Bidrage med faglig sparring til den fortsatte udvikling af vores platform. 

 
  
 
  Hvem leder vi efter? 
 Vi forventer ikke, at du kender alle standarder eller reguleringer på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, analytisk og har lyst til at lære. Vi forestiller os, at du: 
 
 
 Er i gang med en relevant bachelor- eller kandidatuddannelse inden for bæredygtighed, eksempelvis på DTU, KU eller CBS, eller en tilsvarende uddannelse med fokus på ESG, miljø eller regulatorisk compliance. 
 

 
 Har interesse for ESG, klimaregnskaber og regulatorisk compliance. 
 

 
 Har kendskab til eller interesse for GHG-protokollen og ESG-rapportering. 
 

 
 Har lyst til at arbejde med regulatoriske områder som VSME, PPWR, UPA, EUDR, CBAM og REACH. 
 

 
 Har kendskab til LCA eller har lyst til at lære det. 
 

 
 Arbejder struktureret og analytisk og trives med data og komplekse problemstillinger. 
 

 
 Kommunikerer klart og professionelt på dansk. 
 

 
 Bruger AI som et forudsætning i dit arbejde. 

 
  
 
  Hvorfor Quantified Impacts? 
 Hos os bliver du en del af et lille, ambitiøst og fagligt stærkt team, hvor du får ansvar fra første dag og mulighed for at udvikle dig hurtigt. 

 Du kommer til at arbejde med virkelige kundeprojekter for både ambitiøse SMV'er og internationalt kendte virksomheder. Du får indsigt i nogle af de mest aktuelle problemstillinger inden for ESG, klimaregnskaber og regulatorisk compliance og lærer de metoder og værktøjer, der anvendes i praksis. 

 Vi arbejder tæt sammen, hjælper hinanden og tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes gennem nysgerrighed, høj faglighed og en vilje til hele tiden at gøre tingene smartere. Hos os bliver du en Impacter. Du får ansvar, udvikler dig hurtigt og kan se den konkrete forskel, dit arbejde gør for vores kunder. 

 
  
 Praktisk 
 Deltid: 30-60 timer om måneden med fleksibilitet i forhold til dit studie. 

 Arbejdssted: Vores kontor i Valby. 

 Samtaler: Afholdes løbende. 

 Opstart: September/oktober 2026. 
   
 
   For more information or questions please contact us at   sbm@quantifiedimpacts.com

title: Freelance Full-Stack Web App Developer
description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Full-Stack Web App Developers (JavaScript/TypeScript + Python or Node) to join the Tendem project () and build interactive browser-based applications for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your full-stack engineering expertise to design, build, and maintain functional, robust, and user-friendly web applications. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in modern frontend frameworks, backend APIs, databases, and shipping interactive web products end-to-end.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Full-Stack Web App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine browser-based applications with real logic, state, persistence, and user input — from habit trackers and budgeting tools to internal dashboards, mini-SaaS tools, and AI-powered apps. You may also work on standalone Python applications and data-processing scripts that sit alongside or behind these products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build interactive web applications with frontend (React, Next.js, Vue, or similar) and a backend API (Python/FastAPI/Flask or Node/Express).
  • Design and implement data models, schemas, and persistence layers using SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite) or NoSQL stores.
  • Implement authentication, sessions, and basic role-based access where needed.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and AI/LLM services (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into product features.
  • Handle state management, user input validation, error states, and loading states cleanly.
  • Build standalone Python tools and scripts where required by the task (data processing, API clients, lightweight backend utilities).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor full-stack applications to improve correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Write clear, testable code and debug end-to-end issues across frontend, backend, and database.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in full-stack web development or shipping interactive web applications (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in full-stack web development, modern frontend frameworks, backend architecture, and building interactive browser-based applications end-to-end. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work across frontend, backend, databases, and APIs, design robust application logic, and build production-ready web applications. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently architect and ship complete features are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or similar).
  • Solid backend experience in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and/or Node.js (Express, NestJS).
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and basic schema design.
  • Experience implementing REST APIs, request validation, error handling, and authentication flows.
  • Familiarity with deployment platforms (Vercel, Netlify, Render, , Railway, or similar).
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or other AI services into product features is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable with version control (Git) and basic testing practices.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to building working, robust products — not demos.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to architect, build, and ship features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped web applications (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

title: Service Data Analyst
description:
Every day, more than 2,000 technicians around the world rely on our systems to support dairy farmers. Behind every support ticket, question, or release, there is data that helps us understand what is really happening in the field. You make sure that insight leads to better decisions.

This role helps take our service support organization to the next level through better use of data. You help the TSS Milking team make more informed decisions by turning service data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

You are the person colleagues turn to when they want to understand what the data is telling them. You advise team members on how to use dashboards, reports, and analyses to their advantage, helping them make better decisions in their daily work.

Alongside your analytical work, you contribute to improving the quality and availability of our data. You work closely with data specialists, engineers, and service teams to strengthen our data sources, ensuring the team can rely on accurate information and gain valuable insights from it.

Key responsibilities include:

  • You work within the TSS Milking team and help them make better decisions using data in their daily work.
  • You take ownership of service dashboards and ensure they reflect reality and are actively used by the team.
  • You analyze data such as support tickets and release data to identify patterns, anomalies, and underlying causes.
  • You combine quantitative data with input from technicians and service teams to build a complete picture.
  • You sit with colleagues to understand their questions and help translate them into meaningful insights.
  • You turn insights into concrete improvements and support the team in applying them in their daily work.
  • You work with data specialists and engineers to improve data quality and availability where needed.

You enjoy turning data into insights that help others make better decisions. You have a strong drive to improve and know how to bring others along with your ideas, recommendations, and way of thinking. By combining analytical skills with clear communication, you make sure your insights lead to action and lasting improvements.

Additionally, you bring:

  • At least 3 years of experience in a data analyst or similar business-focused role.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to uncover patterns and root causes.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI and solid SQL skills.
  • The ability to clearly communicate insights and influence decisions across teams.
  • Comfort working with data that includes human input and is not always fully structured.
  • An interest in working closely with operational or service teams.

You recognize yourself in most of these points, even if not all. If this role sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply.

For this position, we can only consider candidates who already have the unrestricted right to work in the Netherlands. Applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship, including Highly Skilled Migrant sponsorship or a search year residence permit, will not be considered.

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You contribute to making the agricultural sector future-proof, and we make sure that you get all the space, resources and support you need to do so.

  • An international working environment with opportunities for own initiative and entrepreneurship.
  • Excellent working conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a good pension scheme.
  • A salary within the scale of € 3.841,- to € 4.600,- gross per month, in which we like to see opportunities for growth from your starting salary towards the future .
  • You have the option to participate in a preventive medical examination.
  • During the Christmas period, Lely closes its door for two weeks.
  • Good growth opportunities: you are in control of your development and can choose from various training courses through our Lely Academy, from personal development to job-specific training.
  • Our modern Lely Campus offers daily access to extensive sports facilities: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, an outdoor basketball and volleyball court, table tennis and table soccer. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training - and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
  • Enjoy fresh coffee and tea from our own barista, with milk straight from our farm, as well as a healthy and affordable company restaurant.
  • A healthy work-life balance thanks to our hybrid work policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible working hours and plenty of room to spend extra time on site (between 06:00 and 20:00).
  • A free shuttle bus will take you to and from the metro in Maassluis, so your workday starts and ends smoothly.
  • Successes need to be celebrated: from anniversaries to Christmas parties - at Lely we know how to do it!

Recruitment & selection agency, consultancy, and/or secondment agency?
We appreciate the interest, but we are looking for all our candidates directly. We understand that you, as an intermediary, want to present candidates for our great positions and thus contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how we have set up our recruitment. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered on Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

Du bliver vores nye servicemedarbejder og sørger for, at vores kunders ejendomme fremstår rene, velholdte og indbydende. Dine opgaver spænder bredt inden for ejendomsservice og vedligehold. Du får masser af variation og frihed til at planlægge din egen arbejdsdag.

Hos WP Service er vi ikke bare kolleger – vi er et team. Vi har en flad struktur, hvor alles idéer tæller, og hvor vi har det sjovt, mens vi gør en forskel.

Frihed under ansvar – vi stoler på dig og dine evner
Fleksible arbejdstider – vi ved, at livet er mere end bare arbejde
Attraktiv løn og kort vej til ledelsen
Et stærkt fællesskab – vi holder sociale arrangementer og fejrer vores succeser
Mulighed for at vokse – både personligt og fagligt

Måske er du mellem studier, i et sabbatår eller bare på udkig efter noget nyt. Du vil gerne have et job med ansvar, variation og frisk luft.

Har kørekort (almindelig bil)
Taler og forstår dansk
Er stabil, selvstændig og møder til tiden
Har lyst til et job, hvor du kan se resultatet af dit arbejde

Send en kort ansøgning til kontakt@wpejendomsservice.dk senest 16. August – og fortæl lidt om dig selv og hvorfor du søger.

Har du spørgsmål? Så tøv ikke med at kontakte os – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

Hos WP Service siger vi, hvad vi gør – og vi gør, hvad vi siger.
Vi tror på ærlighed, grundighed og fællesskab. Her er der plads til at være sig selv – og blive hørt.

title: Senior Strategy Consultant- Private Equity - Paris - F/H
description:
Who we are:

Indefi is a fast-growing strategy consulting firm that serves financial investors (private equity specialists, generalist asset managers, wealth managers, etc.). Established in 2007, we are a team of 80+ consultants headquartered in Paris, Lyon and Madrid.

We are operating through three business units:

  • Sustainability: We help our clients define and deliver their Responsible Investment strategy and operating model. We work across the value chain to support investors and portfolio companies to define and embed their chosen approach to ESG and sustainability impact

  • Private Equity: We help private equity firms make better investment decisions at every stage of the deal life cycle and build greater returns. We also advise on investment firm strategy and development, creating value through improved performance.

  • Corporate strategy: conducting strategic development projects for global asset managers including business strategy, market entry, distribution strategy, new product development, non-organic growth and investment process enhancement

As part of our continued development, we are looking for Senior Strategy Consultants - Private Equity to join our Paris office.

Mission:

You will contribute to a variety of international projects covering a broad range of strategic topics, primarily strategic due diligences. You will progressively take ownership of client relationships and have the opportunity to contribute to business development initiatives alongside Managers and Partners.

As a Senior Strategy Consultant, your responsibilities will include:

  • Executing projects involving data analysis, market research, and interviews with senior decision-makers;

  • Analysing and interpreting research findings and translating them into clear, actionable strategic recommendations;

  • Developing expertise in selected sectors, including healthcare, consumer products and retail, B2B services, education, and transport;

  • Supporting senior executives in the formulation and delivery of strategic recommendations;

  • Coaching and supporting junior consultants by sharing best practices, providing guidance, and contributing to team knowledge-sharing initiatives through regular internal meetings;

  • Participating in internal projects aligned with your interests and aspirations, including skills-based volunteering initiatives in partnership with non-profit organisations;

  • Contributing to the firm's development by taking part in recruitment activities and supporting business development efforts and proposal preparation.

Your profile

We are looking for outstanding individuals combining intellectual rigor, analytical excellence, and strong business judgement.

Successful candidates typically have:

  • A degree from a leading business school, engineering school, or university;

  • 3 to 6 years of experience in strategy consulting, investment banking or private equity;

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities;

  • Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and strong Excel skills;

  • A solid understanding of Private Equity and investment-related topics;

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;

  • Full professional fluency in both French and English;

  • Additional European languages are a plus.

Above all, we value candidates who demonstrate curiosity, ownership, entrepreneurial spirit, leadership potential, and a desire to make an impact.

Why join us

  • Work with a talented, multicultural team that shares strong values: collaboration, curiosity, impact, and entrepreneurship;

  • Career development through a structured onboarding program, individual mentoring and coaching, and tailored career paths;

  • Direct exposure to clients and easy access to leadership;

  • Possibility to get involved in mentoring initiatives;

  • Social: regular team events, offsites, summer and winter parties, and more;

  • Prime location: modern offices in the heart of Paris (8th arrondissement).

I REMA 1000 giver vi dig et godt introforløb. Derfor laver du og købmanden allerede fra starten en personlig uddannelsesplan. Din købmand er din daglige sparringspartner, som også har tæt samarbejde med skolen. På den måde sikrer vi, at både din dagligdag i butikken og din uddannelse på skolen går, som den skal. 
 
 
 
I REMA 1000 har vi lidt over 450 elever fordelt på mere end 430 butikker i hele Danmark. På vores skoleophold kommer du til at gå sammen med andre REMA 1000 elever fra hele Danmark. Det er den samme klasse, du kommer til at følge gennem hele forløbet.  
 
 
 
Løn under uddannelse 
 
Du får selvfølgelig løn under hele din uddannelse, når du har en uddannelsesaftale med REMA 1000. Efter endt elevuddannelse har du mulighed for at søge ind på vores talentuddannelse. Her uddanner vi de personer, som har en drøm om at få deres egen REMA 1000 butik.  
 

 
Under din elevuddannelse kommer du til at arbejde med alle aspekter inden for dagligvarehandel: 
 
 
 
• Produktkendskab  
 
• Disponering  
 
• Teamudvikling 
 
• Drift  
 
• Service 
 
• Personligt salg  
 
• Discount med holdning 
 
• Store management  
 
• Markedsføring 



 Og meget, meget mere.
 
 
 
Start som elev i REMA 1000
 
Detailhandelsuddannelsen varer som udgangspunkt 2 år, og du kan starte direkte som salgselev, hvis du har bestået en EUD/GF2 (detail), EUX eller en HHX. Har du en baggrund med STX, HTX eller HF, kræves der dog et EUDS 5 ugers forløb. Hvis du ikke har den nødvendige uddannelsesbaggrund - hvis du for eksempel kommer direkte fra 9. eller 10. klasse - så kan du blive Ny Mesterlære elev, hvor uddannelsesaftalen derimod som udgangspunkt vil vare 3 år. Er du over 25 år, så vil du blive anset som voksenelev, og her afhænger adgangskravene og varigheden på aftalen af en RKV (en realkompetence vurdering), som skolen udarbejder.
 

 
Lyder det som noget for dig? - så klik på linket. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. 



   



 Vi vurderer ansøgningerne løbende, og jobannoncen kan derfor blive fjernet inden ansøgningsfristen, hvis vi har tilstrækkeligt med ansøgere til stillingen.

title: Programme Associate, Ex-Artillery Officer
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

This role is specifically aimed at current or former UK artillery officers, air defence officers, fires officers, targeting officers or similar, especially those from the Royal Artillery, who want to bring operational military judgement into a high-paced defence startup.

You will sit close to business development, programmes, engineering and senior leadership, helping translate operational requirements into executable plans, customer material, programme structure and real capability.

It is a role for someone who understands fires, targeting, operational effect and the UK defence environment, and wants to apply that knowledge to building new capability fast.

If you want to bring operational judgement into a small, elite team building sovereign hypersonic capability for Europe and NATO, and help move critical defence technology faster than the traditional system allows, we should speak.

What you'll do

  • Support the delivery of UK defence programmes and major workstreams, helping maintain pace across schedules, priorities and execution.
  • Help translate UK military requirements, battlefield context and operational need into clear plans, milestones, presentations and actions.
  • Work closely with business development, engineering, programme, operations and leadership teams to keep workstreams moving.
  • Support customer meetings, programme reviews, workshops, trials, demonstrations and military engagements.
  • Track progress, risks, actions and dependencies, identifying problems early and helping drive resolution.
  • Prepare concise programme material: briefs, meeting packs, action trackers, customer summaries, decision papers and internal updates.
  • Support proposal, capture and programme activity where operational context is critical.
  • Help the team understand operational use cases, employment concepts, deployment considerations, user priorities and battlefield relevance.
  • Travel regularly for customer meetings, trials, workshops and programme activity.
  • Take ownership of defined workstreams and grow into broader programme responsibility over time.

    • Who you are

  • You are likely a Captain or Major, or equivalent, with strong operational judgement and credibility.
  • You understand how military users think, how requirements form, and how operational need translates into capability.
  • You are capable of project or programme management, even if that experience was gained in a military rather than commercial environment.
  • You can structure ambiguity, write clearly, track actions and turn messy inputs into executable plans.
  • You are comfortable working with engineers, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and military users.
  • You have high ownership, strong judgement and low ego.
  • You are willing to travel and be close to the customer, the team and the mission.
  • You are not looking for a slow organisation, rigid hierarchy or process-heavy environment.
  • You are motivated by sovereign European defence capability and the need to move faster than traditional defence.

    • What we offer

  • A mission-driven environment working on one of Europe’s most ambitious defence technology programmes.
  • The chance to work alongside leading experts in aerospace, propulsion, guidance, control, manufacturing and defence technology.
  • Exposure to the full lifecycle of complex defence programmes, from operational requirement and customer engagement through to engineering delivery and flight testing.
  • High ownership from day one, with real responsibility and direct impact on company outcomes.
  • A fast-paced, technically rigorous environment where decisions are made quickly and execution matters.
  • A culture built around clarity, integrity, high standards and practical problem solving.
  • Competitive compensation, including share options.
  • The opportunity to help build sovereign European hypersonic capability at a pivotal stage of company growth.

    • Security and Eligibility Requirement

  • Due to the nature of the work, applicants must be a British Citizen or Dual national with British citizenship, and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV).
    • At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
    Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
    You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Field Crew Operative
description:
Field Crew Operative - Leeds

We are seeking to recruit Field Crew Operatives, based from our office in Leeds (working throughout the UK). As a Field Crew Operative, you will work with teams on various wastewater and water projects around the UK & Ireland. The Field Crew Operative will be part of a small team installing and maintaining flow monitors, water quality instrumentation and auto-samplers into sewer pipes and rivers around the UK.

The work you do will contribute to improving our environment; you will be helping water companies to manage their sewer networks, and this will help to prevent flooding, reduce pollution and improve the health of rivers and bathing waters.

Typical Day of a Field Crew Operative

Your typical day will involve visiting various sites where you will support your Field Crew Leader in setting up safely and then carry out the installation, calibration or removal of our equipment – which is usually located inside a confined space or a river environment. This will include lifting and carrying equipment from the vehicle to the specified site.

We provide comprehensive training to ensure you succeed in this role - no prior experience necessary. Our training programme covers equipment operation, safety protocols, confined space procedures, and technical skills development.

The tasks you will undertake will include (but are not limited to):

• Field Operations - Install and retrieve monitoring equipment at client sites
• Data Collection - Conduct calibrations, collect water samples, and ensure accurate field measurements
• Quality Assurance - Perform in-situ equipment calibration and maintain project documentation
• Safety Compliance - Follow all company procedures and safety protocols
• Asset Management - Survey client infrastructure and maintain company equipment
• Professional Development - Participate in training programs and special projects

Travel across the UK is very common. Candidates must be open to working away from home during the week and accommodate night or evening shifts as needed.

To be successful in this role, you will be able to demonstrate:

• Flexibility towards hours and working away from home (accommodation and meals are paid for by the company). A flexible approach to working at night and some infrequent weekend work, is crucial
• Ability to work well within a team and with a variety of different people, as our teams swap and change
• Strong work ethic, positive and can-do attitude and ability to use your own initiative when faced with problems
• Comfortable working around raw sewage and in confined spaces
• Clean and valid driving licence
• Right to work in the UK

Why SOCOTEC?

Join a thriving community of over 2,000 industry professionals who are passionate about making a real difference. At SOCOTEC UK, we're not just delivering services - we're shaping the future of testing, inspection, and certification across the nation.

What sets us apart? Our people. We've built our reputation on attracting exceptional talent like you and empowering them to deliver excellence at every turn. Our comprehensive range of TIC services means you'll have the opportunity to work on diverse, challenging projects that truly matter.

In this role, you won't just be another employee - you'll be a key player in our continued success story. Your expertise will directly contribute to our mission of building a safer, more sustainable world, while you grow your career alongside some of the industry's finest professionals.

Your Career, Your Way

Build a traditional career path or explore opportunities across multiple disciplines - all within SOCOTEC. Your choice, your direction.

Work Your Way

Local, national, or global projects. Office-based, remote, or hybrid. We offer the flexibility that empowers you to perform at your best.

Committed to Your Growth

From day one, you'll have access to comprehensive training, mentorship, and development programs. We support every step of your professional journey. #YouGrowWeGrow

Think you've got what it takes to add value to our success? We would love to hear from you and look forward to receiving your application.

Building a safer and more sustainable world is the core mission we set out to achieve at SOCOTEC, it is at the heart of everything that we do. We are committed to acting as a key player in society, investing in innovative solutions to ensure social and environmental concerns are at the forefront of all of our business operations.

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

We're looking for a Frontend Engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a deep appreciation for well-crafted UIs and seamless user experiences. You'll be instrumental in building the features that make our powerful product feel intuitive and delightful to use.

Our users, legal professionals, operate under pressure and deal with high-stakes knowledge. Your mission is to build experiences that reduce cognitive load, guide users to the information they need, and help them fully leverage our product's capabilities.

You'll collaborate closely with our product team to translate vision into reality. This role goes beyond implementation. We value engineers who contribute strategic thinking about how features should work, not just how they should be built. Attention to detail matters here, from structure and architecture to animations and micro-interactions.

You'll have significant ownership over frontend architecture decisions and a real opportunity to shape how we build our product as we scale. This is a hands-on role where you'll write and ship production code daily, but also one where your voice matters in product discussions, architectural decisions, and the evolution of our design system.

We're looking for someone who brings both humility and strong opinions, someone who can advocate for their ideas while remaining open to feedback and different perspectives.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, performant frontend code in a production environment, ensuring high code quality, reusability, and long-term maintainability

  • Contribute to the frontend architecture and ensure that it scales

  • Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability

  • Participate in agile development processes

  • Collaborate with product, design, and other engineers to create, design, and translate product vision into implementation

  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies

  • Ensure UI decisions prioritize usability, accessibility, and reduced cognitive load for end users

  • Contribute to the evolution of the design system

  • Write tests and monitor frontend performance to ensure a reliable, fast experience

  • Proactively identify areas for improvement and contribute ideas beyond your immediate scope

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have 4+ years of experience building and maintaining production applications with real end users using modern frontend frameworks (we're using React)

  • Love creating consistent and enjoyable user experiences that guide users through legal research, document analysis, and workflow automation, delighting them at every interaction

  • Have solid TypeScript experience, are comfortable with generics, type inference, and building type-safe components

  • Have a sharp eye for pixel-perfect UIs and smooth micro-interactions that convey meaning and bring designs to life

  • Demonstrate strong communication skills, can clearly articulate technical and visual decisions, and enjoy in-depth discussions with other team members

  • Enjoy collaborating closely with the product team, understanding their vision, and elevating it by crafting user experiences that are both beautiful and functional

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with NextJS in production, including server-side rendering strategies, caching, and route architecture

  • Familiarity with Figma and design handoff workflows

  • Accessibility experience that ensures our product works for all user groups

  • Experience leading frontend initiatives or mentoring other developers

What you can look forward to:

  • Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site

  • Collaborative and supportive work environment

  • Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company

  • Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture

This would not be the right role for you if you:

  • View frontend as just "making things look pretty" rather than optimizing user experience and product value

  • Want strict requirements and prefer to work solely on what you are told

  • Prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating closely with design and product

  • You haven't yet owned significant frontend decisions, or you haven't developed strong opinions about frontend architecture

  • Prefer to work remote-first and don't value in-person collaboration

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

title: UAV Systems Engineer
description:
STARK is a European defence technology company founded in 2023, specialising in the development and production of advanced UAV systems for modern military operations. Our flagship platform, Virtus, is a next-generation VTOL loitering munition system that combines precision, autonomy, and reliability to deliver tactical superiority on the battlefield. The Hardware R&D Department is our company’s engineering "special forces," driving the future of UAV tech. We operate at the intersection of rapid prototyping and cutting-edge hardware, turning bold concepts into combat-proven, flight-ready hardware. Our team thrives on solving non-standard technical challenges, bypassing red tape, and pushing component performance to its absolute limits in extreme environments.

As our Systems Engineer, you will be the core architect linking this hardware power to the bigger picture. You’ll align aerodynamics, schematics, and embedded software into a seamless, high-reliability UAV platform. This role connects system architecture with practical implementation, focusing on how electronic and mechanical subsystems work together as one functioning aircraft. Ensure reliable integration of all hardware components of UAV platforms — from avionics and power systems to payload and communication modules.

System Design & Integration
  • Develop and maintain system-level architecture focusing on hardware components (power, communication, avionics, payload, propulsion).
  • Define and document electrical, mechanical, and data interfaces between subsystems.
  • Support selection and validation of key components — sensors, controllers, converters, antennas, and wiring.
  • Coordinate integration of electronic modules into the airframe together with mechanical and electronics teams.
  • Prepare and maintain wiring diagrams, interface control documents (ICDs), and BOMs.

Testing & Validation
  • Plan and supervise integration, bench, and flight tests of hardware systems.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to signal integrity, power distribution, or mechanical fit.
  • Work with QA and Test teams to validate performance and reliability of hardware assemblies.
  • Analyze telemetry and test data to confirm system behavior.

Cross-team Coordination
  • Collaborate with hardware, software, and production engineers to ensure system consistency.
  • Translate system-level requirements into implementable hardware tasks.
  • Participate in design reviews and contribute to risk analysis and mitigation.
  • 5+ years of experience in system integration or hardware development (UAVs, robotics, or embedded systems).
  • Strong understanding of electronics fundamentals — power, sensors, communication interfaces (CAN, UART, Ethernet).
  • Familiarity with autopilots, flight controllers, and UAV subsystems.
  • Experience with wiring, harness design, and hardware assembly documentation.
  • Ability to read and create schematics and mechanical drawings.
  • Hands-on experience with prototype testing and debugging.
  • Intermediate and higher level of English.
  • Experience with UAV flight testing or telemetry systems.
  • Knowledge of EMI/EMC principles and power management.
  • Familiarity with Altium, SolidWorks, or similar design tools.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettaja
description:
Tyrnävän kunta hakee varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajaa vakinaiseen toimeen 1.9.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Etsimme joukkoomme innostunutta, osaavaa ja yhteistyökykyistä varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajaa tukemaan lasten kasvua, oppimista ja hyvinvointia. Varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajana toimit varhaiskasvatuksen henkilöstön pedagogisena tukena sekä osallistut lasten tuen tarpeiden arviointiin, suunnitteluun, toteutukseen ja seurantaan yhteistyössä huoltajien sekä eri yhteistyötahojen kanssa.

Työ sisältää konsultoivaa ja ohjaavaa työotetta sekä työskentelyä eri varhaiskasvatusyksiköissä. Tehtävässä korostuvat vahvat vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot sekä lapsen yksilöllisten tarpeiden huomioiminen osana laadukasta ja inklusiivista varhaiskasvatusta.

Arvostamme:
- inklusiivisen toimintakulttuurin kehittämisosaamista
- hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
- kehittämismyönteistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta
- kykyä toimia moniammatillisissa verkostoissa

Tarjoamme
- merkityksellisen työn lasten kasvun ja oppimisen tukena
- osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön
- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää varhaiskasvatuksen tuen käytänteitä
- työhyvinvointia tukevia henkilöstöetuja

Varhaiskasvatuksen erityisopettajan tasopalkka on rekrytointihetkellä 3422,04 €/kk (tasolla C1), tasolisä pätevyydestä 268,05 € ja mahdollisesta maisteritutkinnosta 106,17 €. Lisäksi maksetaan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset pätevyys- ja työkokemuslisät.

Kelpoisuusvaatimukset määräytyvät varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukaan. Valitun on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilasta sekä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikostaustaote. Toimen täytössä noudatetaan 6 kuukauden koeaikaa. Kelpoisuuden osoittavat todistukset tulee esittää mahdollisessa haastattelutilanteessa.

Hakemus toimitetaan to 19.8.2026 klo 12:00 mennessä Kuntarekryn kautta.

title: Project Planner, Compute Nordic Finland
location: Mikkeli, Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, Finland
description:
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa Suomen tulevaisuuden datakeskuksia?

Haluatko päästä aikatauluttamaan ja ohjaamaan Suomen tulevia datakeskushankkeita kasvavassa kansainvälisessä yrityksessä? Compute Nordic etsii Project Planneria rakentamaan huomisen digitaalista infrastruktuuria.

Tässä roolissa et seuraa vain yhtä projektia, vaan pääset mukaan rakentamaan useita Compute Nordicin datakeskuksia Suomessa. Aloitat työskentelyn Mikkelin datakeskushankkeessa, jonka jälkeen osallistut myös yhtiön tuleviin kotimaisiin projekteihin. Tehtävä tarjoaa erinomaisen näköalapaikan suuriin investointihankkeisiin, projektiohjaukseen sekä nopeasti kasvavaan datakeskusalaan.

Compute Nordic rakentaa ja operoi energiatehokasta konesali- ja laskentainfrastruktuuria kansainvälisille asiakkaille. Keskitymme vastuullisesti tuotettuun digitaaliseen infrastruktuuriin, jossa yhdistyvät korkea käytettävyys, uusiutuva energia, tehokas jäähdytys ja modernit operointimallit.

Suomi on Compute Nordicille strateginen kasvumarkkina. Rakennamme tänne uutta organisaatiota ja datakeskuskapasiteettia palvelemaan nopeasti kasvavaa AI- ja pilvilaskennan kysyntää. Meillä pääset mukaan kansainväliseen kasvuyhtiöön, jossa oma työ näkyy konkreettisesti ja jossa pääset vaikuttamaan toimintatapojen sekä projektien kehittämiseen jo varhaisessa vaiheessa.

Työsuhde on vakituinen, ja tehtävässä voi työskennellä etänä Suomessa.

Tehtävän kuvaus

Project Plannerina vastaat projektiaikataulujen suunnittelusta, ylläpidosta ja seurannasta koko hankkeiden elinkaaren ajan. Varmistat, että projektiorganisaatiolla on jatkuvasti ajantasainen näkyvyys projektien etenemiseen, kriittisiin vaiheisiin sekä mahdollisiin aikatauluriskeihin.

Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä projektijohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan, rakentamisen, käyttöönoton sekä urakoitsijoiden kanssa. Työsi avulla projektien päätöksenteko perustuu luotettavaan ja ajantasaiseen tietoon.

Työtehtävät

- Projektien aikataulujen laatiminen ja ylläpito Primavera P6 -ohjelmistolla
- Projektien etenemisen seuranta sekä aikataulupoikkeamien analysointi
- Kriittisen polun ja aikatauluriskien tunnistaminen
- Viikko- ja kuukausiraporttien laatiminen projektijohdon tueksi
- Eri projektiosapuolten aikataulujen yhteensovittaminen
- Muutosten sekä viivästysten vaikutusten arviointi
- Korjaavien toimenpiteiden ja aikataulujen kiinniottosuunnitelmien valmistelu
- Projektien aikataulutilanteen esittely sisäisille ja ulkoisille sidosryhmille

Odotamme sinulta

- Soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta
- Kokemusta projektien aikataulusuunnittelusta ja projektiseurannasta
- Hyvää Primavera P6 -osaamista
- Ymmärrystä projektinhallinnan ja projektikontrollien menetelmistä
- Vahvoja analysointi- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja
- Järjestelmällistä ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
- Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Arvostamme kokemusta datakeskus-, teollisuus-, energia-, infrastruktuuri- tai muista vaativista rakennusprojekteista.

Tarjoamme

- Mahdollisuuden osallistua Compute Nordicin tulevien datakeskushankkeiden toteuttamiseen Suomessa
- Näkyvän ja vaikuttavan roolin kasvavan projektiorganisaation ytimessä
- Kansainvälisen toimintaympäristön ja merkittävät investointihankkeet
- Vastuullisen asiantuntijaroolin, jossa pääset hyödyntämään ja kehittämään osaamistasi
- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa yhtiön mukana pitkäjänteisesti
- Osaavan ja yhteistyöhön kannustavan työyhteisön

Lisätietoja

Henkilö työllistyy suoraan Compute Nordic Finland Oy:n palvelukseen. Työ on pääosin etätyötä, mutta sisältää tarvittaessa matkustamista projektikohteisiin Suomessa.

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää rekrytointiprosessista tai tehtävästä, voit olla yhteydessä Barona Engineeringin Seniorikonsulttiin Katri Hyppäseen +358 50 439 9785 (ma-ti ja pe klo 10-14)

title: Speciallogopæd til dagtilbudsområdet i PPR i Lyngby-Taarbæk Kommune
description:
PPR i Lyngby-Taarbæk Kommune søger en logopæd til en fast stilling på 32-37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller senest den 1. november 2026.

Om jobbet
Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blive kommunens fire kompetence- og ressourcegrupper på dagtilbudsområdet. Derudover får du ansvar for tilsyn med hjemmetræning efter servicelovens § 32.

Kompetence- og ressourcegrupperne er specialiserede tilbud placeret i almene dagtilbud med egne rammer og personale. Der er fokus på at understøtte børnenes deltagelse i almenfællesskaber gennem brobygning, fælles aktiviteter og inkluderende læringsmiljøer. Børnene har ofte kommunikative og sproglige udfordringer samt vanskeligheder relateret til kognition, sanseintegration, affektregulering og sociale deltagelse. Derfor arbejdes der målrettet med struktur, visualisering, forudsigelighed og tæt voksenstøtte. Som logopæd bliver du en central fagperson i arbejdet med alternativ og supplerende kommunikation (ASK), herunder tolkning af barnets udspil og signaler, billedkommunikation, udpegningsplader, PECS, tegn til tale og IKT-hjælpemidler. Du bliver en del af et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med forældre, dagtilbud og det tværfaglige team fra PPR for at skabe optimale udviklingsmuligheder for børnene.

PPR i Lyngby-Taarbæk Kommune er en del af Center for Uddannelse og Pædagogik. Du bliver en del af en logopædgruppe med 11 engagerede kolleger. Derudover samarbejder du tæt med PPR-kollegaer i form af flersprogskonsulenter, psykologer, specialpædagogiske konsulenter, specialpædagoger, fysioterapeuter og ergoterapeuter.

Logopædgruppen betjener dagtilbud og skoler i otte distrikter og er organiseret i teams med specialer inden for de forskellige logopædiske discipliner. Vi har bl.a. et tværfagligt udtaleteam, et stammeteam og et stemmeteam. Du vil komme til at indgå i det speciallogopædiske team.

Vi samarbejder med kommunens dagtilbud og skoler både omkring enkeltsager og om at understøtte børns sprogudvikling generelt. Vi indgår desuden i en distriktsbaseret samarbejdsmodel, hvor logopæderne, som en del af PPR, samarbejder med faste skoler eller dagtilbud og deltager i konsultativ sparring og netværksmøder.

Om os
Logopædgruppen er veletableret, fagligt stærk, engageret og nysgerrig. Vi prioriterer faglig sparring højt og lægger vægt på et arbejdsmiljø præget af respekt, humor og hjælpsomhed.

Vi gør meget ud af at hjælpe nye kolleger godt på plads, og vi vægter tilgængelig og nærværende ledelse. Din nærmeste leder har logopædfaglig baggrund, og vi lægger vægt på, at du får muligheder for at bringe din faglighed i spil og udvikle med i samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer.

Vi forventer, at du:
  • er uddannet logopæd med lærer-, pædagog- eller universitetsbaggrund
  • kan varetage logopædiske undersøgelser og undervisning af børn i alderen 0-18 år
  • arbejder selvstændigt og kan planlægge og prioritere dine opgaver
  • formidler klart og tydeligt både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • yder rådgivning og vejledning ud fra et konsultativt, systemisk og inkluderende perspektiv
  • har erfaring og lyst til at arbejde med det speciallogopædiske område
  • trives i et tværfagligt samarbejde
  • kan holde oplæg og bidrage til kompetenceudvikling på sprogområdet.

Praktisk
Ansøgningsfrist mandag den 7. september 2026.
Vi holder samtaler torsdag den 17. september 2026.

Du ansættes efter gældende overenskomst. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg.

Da opgaverne foregår på flere matrikler, er det nødvendigt, at du har mulighed for egen transport.

PPR har base i PPR- Huset, Lundtofte Skolestræde 6, 2800 Kgs. Lyngby.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte leder af sprogområdet, Henriette Keil på telefon 24 75 41 85 eller mail henke@ltk.dk eller logopæd Gitte Møllenberg på telefon 22 19 39 43 (tirsdag-torsdag) eller mail gmoel@ltk.dk.

I Lyngby-Taarbæk bliver du del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med høje ambitioner i en organisation med ca. 4.000 medarbejdere, der alle arbejder med det fælles mål – at skabe værdi for borgere og erhvervsliv. Vi lægger vægt på god ledelse, trivsel, faglige og personlige udviklingsmuligheder, kreativitet og nytænkning samt balance mellem arbejdsliv og fritidsliv. Vi ser mangfoldighed som en ressource og værdsætter, at medarbejdere hver især bidrager med deres særlige baggrund, personlighed og evner.

title: Specialist Informatiebeveiliging
description:
Bouw mee aan een veilige digitale toekomst voor vluchtelingen

VluchtelingenWerk Nederland ondersteunt jaarlijks duizenden vluchtelingen en asielzoekers. Daarbij verwerken we grote hoeveelheden gevoelige informatie. Juist daarom is informatiebeveiliging voor ons geen ondersteunend proces, maar een essentiële voorwaarde om onze maatschappelijke opdracht goed te kunnen uitvoeren.

Als Specialist Informatiebeveiliging (CISO) ben jij dé inhoudelijke expert en het centrale aanspreekpunt voor informatiebeveiliging binnen VluchtelingenWerk Nederland. Je werkt vanuit de concern afdeling in een zelfstandige rol met veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Tegelijkertijd sta je er niet alleen voor. Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van ICT, Informatiemanagement, Privacy, Datamanagement en de Integrale Veiligheidsadviseur.

De komende jaren zetten we grote stappen in de verdere digitalisering van onze dienstverlening. We ontwikkelen een omnichannel dienstverlening waarin cliënten, vrijwilligers en medewerkers via verschillende kanalen veilig toegang hebben tot informatie en ondersteuning. Daarnaast willen we steeds meer datagedreven werken, waarbij betrouwbare data, een goed ingericht datalake en veilige gegevensuitwisseling cruciaal zijn. Dat brengt uitdagende vraagstukken met zich mee rondom informatiebeveiliging, privacy, risicobeheersing en compliance. Er lopen voortdurend DPIA's op nieuwe applicaties, processen en digitale ontwikkelingen. Jij zorgt ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging hierbij vanaf het begin goed wordt meegenomen.

Daarnaast is er veel aandacht nodig voor bewustwording binnen de organisatie. Samen met de Integrale Veiligheidsadviseur help je medewerkers, managers en teams om veilig gedrag vanzelfsprekend te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt het informatiebeveiligingsbeleid en het Information Security Management System (ISMS);

  • Je bewaakt de uitvoering van beveiligingsmaatregelen en rapporteert periodiek over risico's, voortgang en verbeteringen;

  • Je adviseert bestuur, directie, management en projectteams gevraagd en ongevraagd over informatiebeveiligingsvraagstukken;

  • Je bent een belangrijke gesprekspartner voor de ICT-afdeling bij de ontwikkeling, inrichting en beveiliging van informatiesystemen;

  • Je adviseert bij digitaliseringsprojecten, cloudoplossingen, applicatie-implementaties en innovaties;

  • Je begeleidt en beoordeelt DPIA's en vertaalt uitkomsten naar concrete maatregelen;

  • Je ondersteunt de verdere ontwikkeling van datagedreven werken en adviseert over de beveiligingsaspecten van data-uitwisseling, dataplatformen en het datalake;

  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen op het gebied van cybersecurity, NIS2, ISO27001 en relevante wet- en regelgeving en vertaalt deze naar de praktijk van VluchtelingenWerk;

  • Je ontwikkelt bewustwordingsactiviteiten en werkt hierin nauw samen met ICT en de Integrale Veiligheidsadviseur;

  • Je formuleert verbetermaatregelen en begeleidt de implementatie daarvan binnen de organisatie;

  • Je draagt actief bij aan audits, risicoanalyses en managementrapportages.

Wat neem je mee?

Je bent zelfstandig, analytisch sterk en ziet snel verbanden tussen beleid, techniek, processen en menselijk gedrag. Je bent in staat om complexe vraagstukken helder uit te leggen en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau;

  • Een relevante opleiding op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging, cybersecurity, informatiemanagement of vergelijkbaar;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met informatiebeveiliging en ISO27001;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met beleidsontwikkeling én implementatie;

  • Kennis van ICT-architectuur, informatievoorziening en digitale dienstverlening;

  • Affiniteit met privacyvraagstukken, DPIA's en risicomanagement;

  • Sterke adviesvaardigheden en overtuigingskracht;

  • Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke vaardigheden;

  • Een proactieve en ondernemende houding;

  • Bij voorkeur een securitycertificering zoals CISSP, CISM of vergelijkbaar.

Wat maakt deze functie bijzonder?

  • Je krijgt een sleutelrol in de verdere professionalisering van informatiebeveiliging binnen een maatschappelijke organisatie met grote impact;

  • Je werkt op het snijvlak van informatiebeveiliging, digitalisering, privacy, datagedreven werken en organisatieontwikkeling;

  • Je hebt veel ruimte om richting te geven aan beleid, processen en bewustwording;

  • Je vervult een zelfstandige expertrol met directe invloed op strategische keuzes;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met ICT, Informatiemanagement, Datamanagement, Privacy en Veiligheid;

  • Je draagt eraan bij dat vluchtelingen en medewerkers kunnen vertrouwen op veilige en betrouwbare dienstverlening.

  • Je helpt mee aan een menswaardige opvang en een sterke basis voor de toekomst van vluchtelingen in Nederland.

Verder krijg je:

  • Salaris tussen € 4.004 en € 6.321 bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur (schaal 10 van de cao Sociaal Werk).

  • Contractduur van 12 maanden, met mogelijkheid tot verlenging.

  • Individueel keuzebudget (IKB) van 16,5% van je bruto maandsalaris.

  • Loopbaanbudget van 1,5% van je bruto maandsalaris.

  • Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn.

  • Laptop en mobiele telefoon.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Thuiswerkvergoeding.

VluchtelingenWerk als inclusieve organisatie

Wij hechten waarde aan diversiteit, inclusiviteit en gelijkwaardigheid en moedigen iedereen aan om te solliciteren ongeacht achtergrond. Wij vinden het belangrijk om onze doelgroep te betrekken en een kans te geven voor een betaalde baan binnen onze organisatie. Mensen met een vluchtachtergrond worden daarom van harte uitgenodigd om te solliciteren.

title: Data Scientist - iwocaPay Risk Squad
description:
Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the iwocaPay Risk Squad

You'll own credit models that decide who iwocaPay can safely fund and on what terms. The team is small, the product is growing, and you'll shape how risk modelling is built – not just maintain what exists.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The function

iwoca's Data Scientists specialise in supervised machine learning, statistical inference and exploratory data analysis, focusing on tabular and time series data. Our work emphasises quantitative predictions through the analysis of conditional probabilities and expectations, using medium-sized datasets.

The team

iwocaPay is iwoca's B2B Buy Now Pay Later product. The Risk Squad owns the automated credit decisioning and fraud prevention models that influence every lending decision the product makes. The squad also handles counterparty risk, portfolio-level strategy, and ongoing monitoring of losses, chargebacks, and segment performance.

The role

You'll co-own the full credit modelling stack with one other data scientist. You’ll collaborate on model design, review each other's work, and choose what to prioritise. Your models directly control which small businesses get access to funding, on what terms, and how far the product can grow.

What you'll get out of it:

Complex problems to solve

Work on interesting, open modelling problems rather than maintenance. Improving how the model performs across segments, test more advanced approaches, and build models from scratch for new products.

Real influence

You own the models end to end, and your decisions carry commercial weight.

Room to develop

A small team on a growing product means broad remit, fast growth, and a say in how the team's pipelines, monitoring, and processes get built.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Expertise in supervised machine learning on tabular data, with experience building and iterating production models end to end (exploration through deployment and monitoring).

  • Strong statistical foundations in probability, uncertainty quantification, model calibration, and in reasoning about where a model is likely to be wrong.

  • Ability to work independently in a messy, early-stage environment – scoping problems, building infrastructure, and shipping models without well-defined tasks handed to you.

  • Pragmatism about what ‘good enough’ looks like commercially, balanced with rigour on high-stakes models.

  • Data engineering capability – building pipelines and managing datasets alongside the modelling work.

  • AI fluency – using AI to build, automate, and accelerate substantive analytical and engineering work.

  • Clear communication – you can adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues working in product, risk, and leadership.

Bonus:

  • Experience with credit risk modelling or financial services lending.

  • Familiarity with transfer learning, domain adaptation, or techniques for combining datasets of different sizes and relevance.

  • Experience with non-linear models (gradient boosting, neural networks on tabular data) in production settings.

  • Python proficiency – it's what the team uses day to day.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 – £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option buy up to ten more days or up to five, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Senior Databasadministratör – Mainframe och PostgreSQL
description:
Vill du arbeta med verksamhetskritiska databasmiljöer i en av Sveriges största banker? Nu söker vi en erfaren Database Administrator som vill ta en central roll i utveckling och förvaltning av våra Db2 for z/OS och PostgreSQL-databasmiljöer. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera stordatorteknik med moderna distribuerade databasmiljöer, samtidigt som du arbetar nära utvecklare, arkitekter och andra DBA-kollegor i en agil organisation.

Ditt team

Inom vår grupp ansvarar vi för kort-relaterade API-tjänster till våra privat och företagskunder samt även till vår kontorspersonal. Gruppen består av cirka 17 medarbetare med kompetens inom bland annat frontend- och backendutveckling i Java, tekniskt test och UX-design. Vi arbetar i två agila team med produktägare och teamcoach i respektive team.

Vi är samtidigt en del av ett större utvecklingståg med totalt cirka 70 medarbetare i åtta agila team som tillsammans utvecklar och förvaltar Handelsbankens korttjänster och kortbetalningar. I vår organisation har vi Db2 på stordator i kärnverksamheten men samtidigt bygger nya lösningar på PostgreSQL. Vi söker därför en senior DBA som trivs i en hybrid miljö. Som DBA kommer du att ha ett särskilt nära samarbete med två andra DBA:er inom tåget. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för den övergripande databasförvaltningen, delar kunskap, driver förbättringar och stöttar varandra i både operativa och strategiska frågor.

Vi planerar gemensamt var tolfte vecka och arbetar i tvåveckorssprintar enligt Scrum, med stort fokus på samarbete, kvalitet och kontinuerlig förbättring.

Våra kontor finns på Valhallavägen i centrala Stockholm.

Din roll

Som senior databasdministratör blir du en nyckelperson i förvaltningen och utvecklingen av våra verksamhetskritiska databasmiljöer. Rollen erbjuder en spännande kombination av traditionella stordatormiljöer och moderna databasteknologier där hög tillgänglighet, säkerhet och prestanda är avgörande.

Du arbetar både operativt och strategiskt, med ansvar för den dagliga databasmiljön samtidigt som du deltar i tekniska förbättringsinitiativ, migreringar och moderniseringsprojekt. Rollen innebär också ett nära samarbete med utvecklings- och arkitektteam där du fungerar som rådgivare inom databastekniska frågor.

I rollen ingår att:

  • Administrera, övervaka och vidareutveckla organisationens Db2 for z/OS- och PostgreSQL-miljöer.
  • Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, prestanda och säkerhet i databasmiljöerna.
  • Planera och genomföra uppgraderingar, migreringar och tekniska förbättringar.
  • Implementera, testa och vidareutveckla backup-, recovery- och disaster recovery-rutiner.
  • Utföra SQL-reviews av applikationers databasanrop och batchprocesser.
  • Ge tekniskt stöd och rådgivning till utvecklings- och applikationsteam.
  • Dokumentera tekniska lösningar, rutiner och databas arkitektur.
  • Bidra till den långsiktiga strategin och utvecklingen av kort-områdets databasmiljöer

Din profil

Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av databasadministration och som trivs i en roll där du får kombinera tekniskt djup med samarbete och rådgivning.

Krav:

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av IBM Db2 for z/OS.
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av PostgreSQL i Linux-miljö.
  • God kunskap inom prestandaanalys och prestandatuning.
  • Erfarenhet av backup-, restore- och disaster recovery-processer.
  • Goda kunskaper inom SQL samt optimering av SQL-frågor.
  • Erfarenhet av Db2 Utilities såsom REORG, RUNSTATS, COPY och RECOVER.
  • Förmåga att dokumentera lösningar, rutiner och tekniska miljöer.
  • God kommunikativ förmåga på både svenska och engelska.

Meriterande:

Db2 for z/OS

  • Kunskap om Db2 Data Sharing.
  • Erfarenhet av RACF och säkerhetsadministration i z/OS.
  • Kunskap om JCL, TSO/ISPF och z/OS-miljöer.

PostgreSQL

  • Erfarenhet av High Availability-lösningar.
  • Kunskap om replikering, exempelvis streaming replication och logical replication.
  • Erfarenhet av pgAdmin, pgBackRest eller motsvarande verktyg.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.

Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.

TA Partner: Vendela Brisfors, vendela.brisfors@handelsbanken.se
